title: Senior SRE / Production Reliability Engineer
description:
We're building a multi-brand iGaming platform that helps operators run their business in regulated markets worldwide. It brings together three main products — Player Account Management (PAM), Sportsbook, and Casino — all built on a modern microservices architecture using Scala, with a React/TypeScript back office.

We're looking for a Senior SRE to join our team and help us build and maintain reliable, observable, and scalable infrastructure. You'll work closely with developers, own reliability practices, and contribute to the team's DevOps culture.

Requirements

Must Have: Technical Skills

  • Linux — confident troubleshooting in terminal, logs, processes, networking basics, resource usage.
  • Kubernetes / GKE — strong hands-on understanding of workloads, pods, services, ingress/gateway, probes, RBAC, resources, autoscaling, and troubleshooting.
  • GCP — practical experience with cloud infrastructure, especially around GKE, IAM, networking, load balancing, artifact registry, and production diagnostics.
  • Docker / Containers — images, registries, runtime debugging, container lifecycle.
  • Helm — understands Helm releases, values, deployment state, and rollback.
  • GitOps / FluxCD — able to understand and troubleshoot GitOps deployment flow, drift, image automation, and Git-based rollback.
  • CI/CD understanding — can investigate failed pipelines and deployment issues; does not need to be the main pipeline builder if DevOps owns that.
  • Observability — Prometheus, Alertmanager, Grafana; understands metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, alerting, and production monitoring.
  • Networking fundamentals — DNS, load balancers, ingress, gateways, TLS, routing, firewall/security rules.
  • SLI / SLO / SLA — can define and apply reliability targets, not just explain the terms.
  • Incident response — experience with production incidents, rollback, service recovery, RCA/postmortem.
  • Databases / messaging operational basics — PostgreSQL, Couchbase, Kafka, Elasticsearch/ELK or similar; enough to monitor health, migrations, indexes, topics, and failure signals.
  • Security / compliance basics — secrets, IAM/RBAC, audit trail, release/change evidence.

Must Have: Reliability / Operational Skills

  • Can assess if a release is technically safe to proceed.
  • Can define what should be monitored during and after deployment.
  • Can verify production health after release.
  • Can prepare or validate rollback plans.
  • Can lead or support post-release watch.
  • Can improve runbooks and incident response procedures.
  • Can identify gaps in dashboards, alerts, deployment checks, and release evidence.
  • Can work with DevOps without duplicating their ownership.

Must Have: Soft Skills

  • Ownership and accountability — follows production issues through to closure.
  • Calm under pressure — can operate clearly during incidents, failed deployments, and rollbacks.
  • Clear communication — gives concise updates: impact, current action, ETA, risk, decision needed.
  • Structured troubleshooting — breaks issues down by app, infra, network, database, config, release diff, external dependency.
  • Risk awareness — can say when a release is risky and explain why.
  • Collaboration — works well with Dev, QA, Product, Support, Release Manager, and DevOps.
  • Documentation discipline — maintains runbooks, rollback steps, incident timelines, and operational evidence.
  • Blameless mindset — focuses on root cause and prevention.
  • Proactivity — finds missing alerts, dashboards, runbooks, and process gaps before incidents.
  • Prioritization — separates real production impact from alert noise.

Nice To Have

  • Terraform / IaC experience.
  • Advanced GCP infrastructure design.
  • ArgoCD or other GitOps tools.
  • Advanced database or performance tuning.
  • Service mesh experience.
  • On-call rotation experience with PagerDuty/Opsgenie or similar.
  • Experience facilitating RCA/postmortem sessions.
  • Betting/gaming domain experience.
  • Good written English for incident updates, release notes, and audit evidence.
  • Basic understanding of AI-related concepts: agents, skills, MCP.

Responsibilities

  • Own production reliability practices together with DevOps and engineering teams.
  • Monitor production health and improve observability.
  • Support releases, hotfixes, rollback, and post-release watch.
  • Validate deployment readiness and rollback readiness.
  • Participate in incident response and RCA/postmortem.
  • Maintain runbooks, dashboards, alerting rules, and operational documentation.
  • Ensure release evidence is traceable and audit-ready.
  • Coordinate with Dev, QA, Product, Support, Release Manager, and DevOps during production events.

title: Sr Program Manager, XB DEX
description:
Stay local, shop global! Amazon Cross Border allows customers to easily discover a wide selection of international products available from Amazon’s websites around the world, offering simplified customs, faster delivery, local language and payment support, and a world-class customer service. Cross Border has presence in multiple countries and will continue to stay at the forefront of Amazon’s global expansion strategy. We are looking for an entrepreneurial, analytical, and creative program leader to drive our initiatives around improving delivery experience across stores.

In this role, you will use a combination of thought leadership, analytical skills, cross-functional partnership, business judgment, and strategic thinking to innovate on behalf of our cross-border customers. You will thrive working with latest technology and be able to build a strong understanding of cross-border shoppers and their needs to scale the program globally. You will have the opportunity to lead work-streams across , cross-border delivery experience, Finance, Legal, Operations, SCOT, Global Logistics, to name a few. You should be comfortable with a degree of ambiguity that’s higher than most projects and relish the idea of solving cross-border/ cross-regional problems. You will tackle novel, challenging situations every day and given the size of this initiative, you’ll have the opportunity to work with multiple supply chain, logistics product and technical teams at Amazon in different international locations.

Key job responsibilities
• Identify and fix supply chain challenges across all aspects of Amazon's cross-border business — spanning demand forecasting, inventory placement, buying, fulfillment, and delivery speed — to drive measurable improvements for international customers
• Own and drive the program roadmap to improve cross-border placement efficiency across key marketplaces and strategic XB nodes, partnering with SCOT, supply chain, and fulfillment teams to scale solutions globally
• Lead cross-functional initiatives to optimize inventory positioning and reduce end-to-end delivery times for international customers, working across Operations, Logistics, Finance, Legal, and Marketplace teams
• Partner with an AI-focused team to build intelligent, data-driven solutions that automate and accelerate cross-border supply chain decisions — from forecasting to fulfillment
• Define and track key performance metrics (e.g., in-stock, delivery speed, placement accuracy) and develop mechanisms to identify gaps, root causes, and corrective actions at scale
• Navigate ambiguity in a fast-moving, cross-regional environment — driving clarity, alignment, and execution across multiple concurrent work-streams

Collins Aerospace is a leader in technologically advanced, intelligent solutions that help redefine the aerospace and defense industry. With a comprehensive portfolio and deep technical expertise, we help customers meet the demands of the global market. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense.

We are seeking a highly motivated Principal Electrical Engineer to join the Computing Products Department within the Displays, Computing & Networking Directorate. This department is responsible for the development and sustainment of state-of-the-art avionics hardware products including ruggedized mission computers, video processing modules, and network products used in commercial and military aircraft platforms. This role is onsite, in Cedar Rapids, Iowa.

This role supports all phases of the hardware development lifecycle—program pursuit, design, integration, verification, and factory transition.

The selected candidate will collaborate closely with cross-functional partners, including Systems, Software, Mechanical, Environmental Effects, Manufacturing/Operations, and Design-to-Cost teams, to ensure all product requirements are successfully achieved. Strong expertise in high-speed digital circuit board design, EMI control, manufacturability, testability, and thermal management is essential

What You Will Do:

  • Design and analyze Circuit Card Assemblies (CCA) for Avionics Computers (Processors, Memory, interfaces)

  • Work with lab equipment for integration testing of hardware designs

  • Schematic capture of digital/analog mixed signal electrical circuit designs

  • Avionics I/O (Ethernet, ARINC 429, MIL-STD 1553, PCIe

  • Oversight of Printed Circuit Board (PCB) layout

  • Design to Cost (DTC), Design for Manufacturing (DFM), Design for Test (DFT)

  • Mentoring and delegating tasks to less experienced engineers

Qualifications You Must Have:

  • Typically requires a degree in Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics (STEM) and minimum 8 years prior relevant experience or an Advanced Degree in a related field and minimum 5 years of experience

  • Hands-on troubleshooting experience

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills

Qualifications We Prefer:

  • Ability to work collaboratively with team members and independently on assigned tasks

  • Experience in the Defense or Aerospace industry

  • EMI/EMC, Lighting protection circuits and testing

  • Demonstrated use of software tools for electrical circuit simulation and/or Printed Circuit Board layout

  • Experience with Avionics regulatory and certification requirements: TSO, DO-160, or DO-254, MIL-STD-461

  • Demonstrated ability to perform root cause analysis and drive corrective actions

What We Offer:

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance

  • Three weeks of vacation for newly hired employees

  • Generous 401(k) plan that includes employer matching funds and separate employer retirement contribution, including a Lifetime Income Strategy option

  • Tuition reimbursement program

Join us in creating solutions that connect the world, one flight at a time. Start your application today.

Vil du stå i spidsen for et engageret team af driftsteknikere og være med til at sikre en stabil og sikker drift af Danmarks gasnet? 



Hos Evida søger vi en driftsleder til vores lokation i Middelfart, hvor du får ansvaret for ledelsen af ca. 20 kørende driftsteknikere. Du bliver en del af den lokale driftsledelse og får en central rolle i planlægningen og gennemførelsen af opgaver i gasnettet - med fokus på sikkerhed, kvalitet og effektiv drift. 



Bliv en del af Field Operations 



Du bliver en del af driftsledelsen i Middelfart, som består af to ledere med et tæt samarbejde om både personaleledelse og den daglige planlægning af opgaver. Sammen sikrer I, at arbejdsordrer i gasnettet bliver planlagt, prioriteret og gennemført effektivt, samtidig med at medarbejderne har de bedste forudsætninger for at lykkes. 



Du bliver samtidig en del af ledergruppen i Field Operations, hvor du bidrager til udviklingen af området og samarbejder på tværs af organisationen om fælles initiativer og forbedringer. 



Dine primære opgaver 



Som driftsleder får du ansvar for både mennesker og drift. Dine opgaver omfatter blandt andet: 



	

	
Personaleledelse af ca. 20 driftsteknikere. 

	




	

	
Planlægning, koordinering og opfølgning på arbejdsordrer i gasnettet. 

	




	

	
Prioritering og afvikling af driftsopgaver med fokus på sikkerhed, kvalitet og effektiv ressourceudnyttelse. 

	




	

	
Tæt koordinering med den lokale driftsleder for Net om bemanding, planlægning og den daglige drift. 

	




	

	
Bidrag til udviklingsopgaver og tværgående samarbejde i Field Operations og resten af Evida. 

	




	

	
Sikring af et godt arbejdsmiljø og fortsat udvikling af medarbejdere og samarbejde.

title: Project and Knowledge Management Analyst (Home-Based) (Open to Tier 0, 1 and 2 applicants)
description:
Tiered Approach

In line with the commitment to safeguard capacity and support personnel already in the Organization, a majority of UNDP UNCDF/UNV vacancies are advertised using a tiered application process whereby:

  • Tier 0: UNDP/UNCDF/UNV IP staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed-term (FTA) appointments, whose posts will be abolished, or contracts will be terminated or not renewed during 2026.
  • Tier 1: Other UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed-term (FTA) appointments
  • Tier 2: UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding temporary appointments (TA), personnel on regular PSA contracts, and Expert and Specialist UN Volunteers
  • Tier 3 or no tier indicated: All other contract types from UNDP/UNCDF/UNV and other agencies, and other external candidates

Please make note of the Tier(s) indicated in the vacancy title, if any, and ensure that you satisfy the eligibility to apply.

Office/Unit/Project Description

UNDP is the knowledge frontier organisation for sustainable development in the UN Development System and serves as the integrator for collective action to realise the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). UNDP's policy work carried out at HQ, Regional and Country Office levels, forms a contiguous spectrum of deep local knowledge to cutting-edge global perspectives and advocacy. In this context, UNDP invests in the Global Policy Network (GPN), a network of field-based and global technical expertise across a wide range of knowledge domains and in support of the signature solutions and organizational capabilities envisioned in the Strategic Plan.

UNDP’s 2026–2029 Strategic Plan reaffirms our continued commitment to achieving the Sustainable Development Goals by accelerating structural transformations that advance poverty eradication, reduce inequalities, strengthen resilience, and drive sustainable, climate-aligned development.

Within the GPN, the Bureau for Policy and Programme Support (BPPS) has the responsibility for developing all relevant policies and guidance to support the results of UNDP's Strategic Plan. BPPS's staff provides technical advice to Country Offices; advocates for UNDP corporate messages, represents UNDP at multi-stakeholder fora including public-private dialogues, government, and civil society dialogues, and engages in UN inter-agency coordination in specific thematic areas.

As part of GPN in BPPS, the Planet Hub promotes and scales up an integrated approach to deliver UNDP’s environment portfolio across nature, climate, energy, and chemicals and waste, supporting countries in advancing implementation of the Paris Agreement, the Kunming-Montreal Global Biodiversity Framework, and related multilateral environmental agreements. It coordinates UNDP’s flagship offers—Nature Pledge, Climate Promise, and Energy Moonshot, and Cooling, Circularity and Pollution Prevention initiatives—to meet strong country demand across more than 140 countries. The Hub enables joined-up policy, programming, and financing solutions that accelerate low-emission, nature-positive, and pollution-free development, while strengthening resilience and advancing sustainable, inclusive growth in line with the Strategic Plan.

UNDP has developed its new Strategy for Food Systems to focus its vision and enhance its support to transform Food Systems.

Food Systems are fundamental to the sustainable development of the 170 countries UNDP supports. Food Systems are often the largest contributor to their economies; food and nutrition is fundamental for citizen health; and Food Systems have a key role to play in achieving the SDGs. Yet, Food Systems are in crisis and need to be radically transformed to become sustainable. UNDP, building on its experience, has for the first time consolidated its Food Systems support and vision into this Strategy. The challenges and need for change related to Food Systems have been highlighted by a suite of reports by many research and international organizations and think tanks. The production practices and consumption patterns of food and agricultural commodities are taking these systems on an unsustainable trajectory with multiple impacts on human development, the environment, and economies; from ecosystem degradation, conflicts over land and natural resources, reduced capacity and resilience to climate and other shocks, persistent poverty, food insecurity and related people displacement and migration, to malnutrition including overweight and obesity. There is a clear need to work in a systemic and integrated manner to transform the Food Systems towards sustainability.

UNDP´s Vision for Food Systems 2030 is, through partnerships, to transform food and agricultural commodity systems into resilient; equitable; healthy, inclusive; environmentally, socially, and economically sustainable systems. Working on Food Systems will contribute to not only recovery from the COVID19 crisis, by creating sustainable and resilient livelihoods for many along the Food and Agriculture Commodities supply chains, but also to preventing further zoonoses from emerging in the future. This will require a change in the current paradigm of agricultural production focusing on maximizing productivity to a new paradigm based on diversified agroecological systems which work simultaneously on achieving economic, environmental, social, and health outcomes, with smallholders as a key part of the solution in their role as the engine of economic development. A Food Systems team has been established within UNDP´s Planet Hub, which is tasked to support UNDP Country Offices with food systems related challenges in a way that is aligned with UNDP´s strategy.

Scope of Work

The Project and Knowledge Management Analyst will perform the following tasks:

1. Programme Coordination Support

  • Support day-to-day coordination of global food systems initiatives, contributing to effective collaboration among internal teams and partners.
  • Assist in the organization of programme activities and virtual engagements, including preparation of materials, documentation, and follow-up on agreed actions.
  • Provide coordination support to project teams to help ensure activities are implemented in line with agreed plans and timelines.

2. Monitoring, Reporting, and Tracking Support

  • Assist in monitoring programme and project workplans, including collecting and consolidating inputs from teams and partners.
  • Help maintain and update programme tracking tools, dashboards, calendars, and related internal systems.
  • Contribute to the preparation of summaries, brief updates, and inputs to reports on programme progress and implementation status.

3. Knowledge Management, Learning, and Community Support

  • Support knowledge management and learning activities by organizing information, documenting lessons learned, and compiling good practices from food systems initiatives.
  • Assist with coordination and moderation of communities of practice and collaborative digital platforms, including supporting engagement across partners and country teams.
  • Provide support for learning and knowledge-sharing activities, such as surveys, presentations, and internal briefings.

4. Stakeholder and Partnership Support

  • Support coordination with UN agencies, country offices, regional teams, and external partners through communications, scheduling, and follow-up activities.
  • Help maintain partner and membership databases, contact lists, and records related to food systems initiatives and task forces.
  • Contribute to stakeholder mapping and basic outreach activities under guidance from senior team members.

5. Research, Analysis, and Resource Mobilization Support

  • Undertake background research and data collection to support programme activities, partnerships, and resource mobilization efforts.
  • Assist in drafting and compiling inputs for concept notes, presentations, and internal documents.
  • Support analysis of linkages and alignment across food systems initiatives and UNDP priorities.

The incumbent performs other duties within their functional profile as deemed necessary for the efficient functioning of the Office and the Organisation

Institutional Arrangement

  • The incumbent will work remotely from his/her home-base;
  • The incumbent will be supervised by the Project Analyst.
  • The incumbent will take part in the Food Systems team meetings and liaise with the UNDP Food Systems team members, other UNDP staff both at global and country office level, partners agencies focal points and donors.
  • The incumbent will be given access to relevant information necessary for execution of the tasks under this assignment.
  • The incumbent will be responsible for providing her/his own workstation (i.e. laptop, internet, phone, scanner/printer, etc.) and must secure access to a reliable internet connection.
  • Given the global consultations to be undertaken during this assignment, the incumbent is expected to be reasonably flexible with his/her availability for such consultations taking into consideration different time zones.

Competencies Core

  • Achieve Results: LEVEL 1: Plans and monitors own work, pays attention to details, delivers quality work by deadline
  • Think Innovatively: LEVEL 1: Open to creative ideas/known risks, is pragmatic problem solver, makes improvements
  • Learn Continuously: LEVEL 1: Open minded and curious, shares knowledge, learns from mistakes, asks for feedback
  • Adapt with Agility: LEVEL 1: Adapts to change, constructively handles ambiguity/uncertainty, is flexible
  • Act with Determination: LEVEL 1: Shows drive and motivation, able to deliver calmly in face of adversity, confident
  • Engage and Partner: LEVEL 1: Demonstrates compassion/understanding towards others, forms positive relationships
  • Enable Diversity and Inclusion: LEVEL 1: Appreciate/respect differences, aware of unconscious bias, confront discrimination

Cross-Functional & Technical competencies

Business Development - Knowledge Generation

  • Ability to research information and to turn it into useful knowledge, relevant for context, or responsive to a stated need. Ability to apply existing concepts to new situations, and to develop new concepts to generate workable solutions and new approaches.
  • Knowledge of relevant concepts, conceptual models, and theories that can be useful in addressing new situations.

Business Management - Communication

  • Communicate in a clear, concise and unambiguous manner both through written and verbal communication; to tailor messages and choose communication methods depending on the audience.
  • Ability to manage communications internally and externally, through media, social media and other appropriate channels

Business Management - Partnership Management

  • Build and maintain partnerships with wide networks of stakeholders, Governments, civil society and private sector partners, experts and others in line with UNDP strategy and policies

Business Management- Monitoring & Evaluation

  • Ability to systematically monitor results of strategies, programmes, and activities with a view to make sure that they are being implemented effectively; Ability to provide managers and key stakeholders with regular feedback and reporting on the consistency or discrepancy between planned activities and programme management and results.
  • Ability to make independent judgment of the management and results of strategies, programmes and activities based on set criteria and benchmark, keeping in mind the needs and concerns of client, current and upcoming.
  • Knowledge and understanding of monitoring and evaluation frameworks, concepts, methodologies, systems, processes, and tools. Ability to make an independent judgement based on set criteria and benchmarks. Ability to anticipate client's upcoming needs and concerns.

2030 Agenda - Planet Nature

  • Ecosystems and Biodiversity: Green commodities

Digital- Data Analysis

  • Ability to extract, analyze and visualize data to form meaningful insights and aid effective business decision making

Required Skills and Experience

Min. Academic Education

  • An advanced university degree (Master´s degree or equivalent) in Anthropology, Development Studies, Agriculture, Economics, Environment Science, or other related fields is required; or
  • A first-level university degree (Bachelor’s degree) in the above fields, in combination with two additional years of relevant experience will be given due consideration in lieu of the advanced university degree.

Min. years of relevant Work experience

  • Applicants with a Master’s degree (or equivalent) in a relevant field of study are not required to have professional work experience.
  • Applicants with a Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) are required to have minimum of two years of professional work experience in sustainable development project management support-related functions (planning, communications, reporting, research).

Desired additional skills and competencies

  • Experience in coordination of projects and initiatives related to food systems, agriculture, and systems change, with a focus on cross-sectoral integration (e.g. resilience, gender and climate linkages)
  • Proven experience and strong understanding of food systems transformation agendas, including pathways related to sustainability, resilience, equity, and climate-smart agriculture.
  • Demonstrated research experience on policy-relevant research and applied analysis on food systems transformation.
  • Proven experience coordinating multi-donor/ flexible funding mechanism projects including operational follow-up, reporting, and stakeholder engagement.
  • Experience coordinating inter-agency collaboration mechanism, such as UN coordination platforms, task forces and global working groups.
  • Experience supporting knowledge management and knowledge-sharing platforms such as communities of practice or similar related to food systems transformation, including moderation of digital platforms, virtual events and learning exchanges.
  • Experience supporting communication, knowledge, and resource mobilization efforts, including drafting summaries, briefs, analytical notes, talking points, and strategic materials for partner engagement and fundraising purposes.
  • Experience with UNDP.

Required Language(s)

  • Excellent command of the English language is required;
  • Fluency in another UN Language such as Spanish or French is desirable

Equal opportunity

As an equal opportunity employer, UNDP values diversity as an expression of the multiplicity of nations and cultures where we operate and, as such, we encourage qualified applicants from all backgrounds to apply for roles in the organization. Our employment decisions are based on merit and suitability for the role, without discrimination.

UNDP is also committed to creating an inclusive workplace where all personnel are empowered to contribute to our mission, are valued, can thrive, and benefit from career opportunities that are open to all.

Sexual harassment, exploitation, and abuse of authority

UNDP does not tolerate harassment, sexual harassment, exploitation, discrimination and abuse of authority. All selected candidates, therefore, undergo relevant checks and are expected to adhere to the respective standards and principles.

Right to select multiple candidates

UNDP reserves the right to select one or more candidates from this vacancy announcement. We may also retain applications and consider candidates applying to this post for other similar positions with UNDP at the same grade level and with similar job description, experience and educational requirements.

Use of AI by candidates

Applicants are invited to read UNDP’s guidance for candidates on using AI responsibly in UNDP recruitment and selection

Scam alert

UNDP does not charge a fee at any stage of its recruitment process. For further information, please see www.undp.org/scam-alert.

    • Address regional challenges and opportunities by adapting GTM strategies to fit local requirements and preferences.
    • Facilitate the sharing of best practices and success stories across regions to drive consistency and excellence.
    • Oversee the annual planning process and partner with regional leaders and the broader revenue operations team to ensure alignment on planning initiatives.
    • Steward analytics resources to ensure regional leaders have the support and resources they need to make data driven decisions when running their businesses.
  • Performance Tracking and Reporting:
    • Establish and monitor KPIs to assess the effectiveness of GTM strategies and initiatives.
    • Prepare and present regular performance reports and strategic recommendations to senior management.
    • Implement continuous improvement processes based on performance data and feedback.
    • Spearhead a regular business review cadence for regional leaders with support of revenue analysts.
  • Team Management and Collaboration:
    • Manage a local analyst dedicated to supporting regional leaders, and work with the broader analyst team to generate new data sets to support insights
    • Foster a collaborative and high-performance work environment, setting clear goals and performance metrics for team members.
    • Ensure effective communication and alignment between the central GTM operations team and regional leaders.
  • Rhythm of the Business
    • Support the QBR Process
    • Support the forecasting and pipeline cadence
    • Perform other duties as assigned

You have:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Analytics, or a related field; MBA or advanced degree preferred.
  • 8+ years of experience in GTM strategy, business analytics, or a related field, with a demonstrated track record of success.
  • Proven experience in leading and managing teams, with a strong ability to mentor and develop talent.
  • Exceptional analytical skills with the ability to translate complex data into actionable insights.
  • Strong understanding of market dynamics, customer segmentation, and competitive analysis.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and manage multiple priorities effectively.
  • Proficiency in analytics tools and platforms, such as Tableau, Snowflake, or similar.
  • Legally eligible to work in the United States on an ongoing basis

Current US Perks & Benefits:

  • Employer subsidized medical/vision and dental coverage for full-time employees
  • 401k Match to help you save for your future (50% of your contribution up to the first 6% of your eligible pay)
  • Monthly stipend to support your work and productivity
  • Flexible Time Away Program, plus Sick Time Off
  • US employees are automatically covered under Smartsheet-sponsored life insurance, short-term, and long-term disability plans
  • US employees receive 12 paid holidays per year
  • Up to 24 weeks of Parental Leave
  • Personal paid Volunteer Day to support our community
  • Opportunities for professional growth and development including access to Udemy online courses
  • Company Funded Perks, including a counseling membership, local retail discounts, and your own personal Smartsheet account
  • Teleworking options from any registered location in the U.S. (role specific)

Smartsheet provides a competitive base salary range for roles that may be hired in different geographic areas we are licensed to operate our business from. Actual compensation is determined by several factors including, but not limited to, level of professional, educational experience, skills, and specific candidate location. In addition, this role will be eligible for a market competitive incentive opportunity.

US Base Salary Pay Range
$165,000—$210,000 USD

Get to Know Us:

At Smartsheet, your ideas are heard, your potential is supported, and your contributions have real impact. You’ll have the freedom to explore, push boundaries, and grow beyond your role. We welcome diverse perspectives and nontraditional paths—because we know that impact comes from individuals who care deeply and challenge thoughtfully. When you’re doing work that stretches you, excites you, and connects you to something bigger, that’s magic at work. Let’s build what’s next, together.

Equal Opportunity Employer:

title: Bilingual Real Estate Appointment Setter (Job ID: LUIRIC1)
description:
IMPORTANT - Watch this quick Loom video on how to get hired:

C1 ENGLISH LEVEL IS REQUIRED, THE SELECTED CANDIDATE WILL BE SPEAKING STRICTLY IN ENGLISH DURING THEIR WHOLE SHIFT.

PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR RESUME AND AUDIO RECORDING IN ENGLISH

Real Estate Appointment Setter
Job ID:LUIRIC1
Industry:Real Estate / Sales
Location:LATAM (Spanish needed)
Job Status:Part Time 20 hours a week
Work Schedule: Monday to Friday 2PM to 6PM PST
Salary: $7 per hour + commissions
Target Start Date: ASAP

ROLE OVERVIEW

About the Client:

The client is a growing real estate team based in Southern California, specializing in Spanish-style architecture and serving a predominantly Hispanic client base. Through engaging social media content, digital marketing, and relationship-focused sales strategies, they generate a high volume of inbound buyer leads while building lasting relationships with prospective and past clients. Their mission is to deliver an exceptional home-buying experience by maintaining consistent communication, creating strong community connections, and generating referrals through outstanding customer service.

About the Role:

The client is seeking a proactive and relationship-driven Real Estate Virtual Assistant to manage lead follow-up throughout the sales pipeline, maintain an organized CRM, and support long-term client relationships. This role is responsible for nurturing new and existing leads through every stage of the customer journey, from initial connection to long-term community engagement, by qualifying prospects, coordinating appointments, managing Follow Up Boss, supporting social media lead follow-up, and maintaining organized communication systems. The ideal candidate is bilingual, highly organized, tech-savvy, coachable, and passionate about delivering an exceptional client experience.

Key Responsibilities

Sales Pipeline Management

  • Manage leads throughout the company's sales pipeline: Connection, Commitment, Closing, and Community.
  • Ensure every lead receives timely and consistent follow-up.
  • Move prospects through each stage while maintaining accurate CRM records.

Database Management

  • Organize, clean, and maintain a database of 1,000+ contacts in Follow Up Boss.
  • Ensure records remain accurate, organized, and up to date.
  • Remove duplicate or incomplete records as needed.

Lead Management and Qualification

  • Monitor and manage inbound leads received through the company's CRM.
  • Contact new leads promptly via phone, text, and email.
  • Qualify buyers by identifying their purchase timeline, financial readiness, and overall buying potential.
  • Identify high priority opportunities and schedule appointments with the sales team.
  • Soft-qualify buyers based on urgency, motivation, and financial readiness.
  • Email Marketing & Lead Generation: Must have hands-on experience with Canva, DeskFlo, and similar email marketing/newsletter platforms to create and distribute engaging quarterly newsletters to nurture leads, with bonus consideration for candidates experienced in designing lead magnets, digital freebies, and social media lead generation campaigns.

CRM Management and Automation

  • Manage and maintain accurate records in Follow Up Boss.
  • Build and optimize automated email and text message follow up campaigns.
  • Keep all lead statuses, notes, and communication history updated.
  • Create reminders and workflows that improve consistency across the sales process.
  • Utilize ChatGPT or similar AI tools to improve communication and productivity.
  • Manage social media lead follow-up workflows.

Lead Nurturing

  • Maintain regular communication with prospects who plan to purchase in the future.
  • Develop personalized follow up strategies that keep buyers engaged over time.
  • Re engage inactive leads and maintain long term relationships.

Past Client Engagement

  • Maintain ongoing communication with previous clients to encourage repeat business and referrals.
  • Coordinate reminders for birthdays, anniversaries, home purchase anniversaries, and other relationship building opportunities.
  • Help develop systems that strengthen client retention and referral generation.

Administrative Support

  • Assist with CRM organization and database management.
  • Track appointments and follow up activities.
  • Provide reminders and updates to the sales team regarding important client activities.
  • Recommend process improvements that increase efficiency and lead conversion.
  • Utilize Microsoft Word and Excel for administrative tasks and reporting.
  • Assist as needed with obtaining client documents during the loan process such as verification of employment, Home owners insurance, Escrow and title documents, appraisal ordering.

Qualifications & Skills

Must

  • 2+ years of experience in real estate, lead nurturing, inside sales, appointment setting, customer relationship management, or virtual assistance.
  • Previous experience using Follow Up Boss.
  • Bilingual English and Spanish (excellent verbal and written communication skills).
  • Experience communicating professionally through phone, text, and email.
  • Experience managing CRM databases and maintaining accurate records.
  • Comfortable using Microsoft Word, Excel, and AI tools such as ChatGPT.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred

  • Experience working with residential real estate teams or brokerages.
  • Experience building CRM automations and follow-up campaigns.
  • Knowledge of mortgage terminology, financing basics, debt-to-income ratios, loan-to-value ratios, and buyer qualification.
  • Experience supporting social media lead follow-up.
  • Experience generating referrals and maintaining long-term client relationships.

Personality Traits

  • Coachable and eager to learn.
  • Proactive and self-motivated.
  • Detail-oriented.
  • Friendly and approachable.
  • Strong team player.
  • Relationship-driven.
  • Highly organized.
  • Dependable and accountable.
  • Positive attitude.
  • Solutions-oriented.

title: Lead, Logistics Performance
description:
We are seeking a strategic and experienced leader to join our regional logistics team as the Lead, Logistics Performance.

In this role, you will lead a dedicated team of Specialists, owning the design, analysis, and optimization of logistics performance, rider payments, and incentive strategies across our 17 diverse markets. You will own the strategic roadmap for rider payments and incentives, acting as the bridge between high-level business goals and on-the-ground operational reality. You will treat rider compensation as a critical operational lever. You will use it to optimize fleet behavior, improve delivery times, and solve supply challenges while ensuring financial sustainability and fleet stability.

  • Team Leadership & Development: Lead and mentor a high-performing team of Specialists. Build a culture of analytical rigor and curiosity, encouraging the team to challenge the status quo
  • Strategic Roadmap & Governance: Define the long-term strategy for rider payments and incentives. Develop and enforce regional frameworks that allow for necessary local adaptations while maintaining consistency and financial discipline across the markets. Ensure compensation models align with broader business goals, logistics performance KPIs (e.g., delivery time), and profitability targets
  • Budget Management & Efficiency: Oversee the rider payment and incentive budget and continuously monitor cost-per-order (CPO) trends. You will drive initiatives that improve cost-efficiency while ensuring sufficient rider supply and fleet retention
  • Rollout of Models & Automation: Own the regional implementation of advanced data science models and automated tools
  • Experimentation & Testing: Drive the testing and rollout of new pay components (e.g., dynamic pricing, surge models, quest incentives) to enhance fleet efficiency and order acceptance rates, ensuring every initiative is optimized for maximum ROI and operational impact
  • Product Collaboration: Partner with the Central Product team to influence the development of payment-related features. You will translate business requirements into product requests, participate in testing, and ensure the successful adoption of new product capabilities across the region
  • Stakeholder Management & Market Partnership: Act as the primary partner to Local Logistics Directors, Finance Leaders, and Product Managers. Build strong relationships with local market teams to understand their unique operational challenges and translate complex data into clear, actionable strategic recommendations for senior leadership
  • Experience: 5+ years of professional experience in high-growth tech, logistics, strategy consulting, or investment banking. Experience specifically in gig-economy, marketplace dynamics, or logistics is a strong plus
  • Leadership: Proven track record (1-2+ years) of managing direct reports or leading complex cross-functional project teams
  • Education: University degree in STEM, Economics, Business, or a related quantitative field
  • Technical Fluency: Strong proficiency in SQL and Excel is required to audit team work and dive into data when needed
  • Communication: Exceptional English communication skills, both written and spoken. You are comfortable effectively challenging the status quo, and negotiating with senior stakeholders and leadership
  • A dynamic and challenging work environment.
  • A company committed to developing you personally and professionally.
  • A great working atmosphere with regular company and team events.
  • A vibrant and international team committed to diversity and inclusion.
  • Responsibility from day one in a fast growing and global company.
  • Other benefits include free food, health and dental insurance, and learning and development opportunities!

foodpanda is operated by Delivery Hero Group (“DH Group”) - the world’s leading local delivery platform, operating in 70+ markets across Asia, Europe, Latin America, the Middle East, and Africa. Delivery Hero started as a food delivery service in 2011 and now employs 40,000+ people globally. Additionally, Delivery Hero is pioneering quick commerce, the next generation of e-commerce, aiming to bring groceries and household goods to customers in under one hour and often in 20 to 30 minutes. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany, Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index.

title: Sushi Kock
description:
Vi söker nu en kock på heltid till vårt team. Vi letar efter dig som är noggrann, serviceinriktad, ansvarstagande och har förmågan att hantera stressiga situationer i ett högt arbetstempo.

Som kock hos oss kommer du att arbeta tillsammans med erfarna kollegor på en av de mest eftertraktade restaurangerna i Landskrona. Om du är snabb, engagerad och har ett stort intresse för matlagning kommer du att trivas hos oss.

Vi söker dig som har minst två års erfarenhet av arbete som kock och som vill fortsätta utvecklas och växa inom yrket.

Arbetstiderna är varierande, kvällar och helger. Anställningen är en tillsvidareanställning, på heltid, med tillsättning omgående.

Vi tillhandahåller arbetskläder och som anställd hos Okaasan AB kan du känna dig trygg. Alla våra anställningar omfattas av kollektivavtal, vilket innebär avtalsenliga villkor gällande semester, lön, pension, sjukfrånvaro med mera.

Välkommen med din ansökan!

Kunskaper i vietnamesiska är meriterande.


We are currently looking for one full-time Chef to join our team. We are seeking someone who is detail-oriented, service-minded, responsible, and able to work efficiently in a fast-paced and sometimes stressful environment.

As a chef with us, you will work alongside experienced colleagues at one of the most popular restaurants in Landskrona. If you are quick, dedicated, and have a strong passion for cooking, you will enjoy working with us.

We are looking for someone who has at least two years of experience working as a chef and is motivated to continue developing and growing in the profession.

Working hours vary, evenings and weekends. The employment is a permanent employment, full-time, with immediate appointment.

We provide workwear, and as an employee at Okaasan AB, you can feel secure. All our positions are covered by collective agreements, which ensure contractual terms regarding vacation, salary, pension, sick leave, and other employment benefits.

Welcome with your application!

Knowledge of Vietnamese is considered an advantage.

title: HR Partner til ny strategisk nøglefunktion i international vækstvirksomhed - Precision Technic Defence Group i Svenstrup - Hviid & Larsen
description:
HR Partner til ny strategisk nøglefunktion i international vækstvirksomhed - Precision Technic Defence Group i Svenstrup - Hviid & Larsen
        
        
        
        

        
        

        

        
        
        
        
        
        
        

        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        

        

        

        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
    
    
            
        

    

                    
            
        Hviid & Larsen
    


HR Partner til ny strategisk nøglefunktion i international vækstvirksomhed - Precision Technic Defence Group i Svenstrup

            
    


    

        
        

            
Vil du være med til at bygge HR-fundamentet i en international koncern med høje ambitioner, komplekse markeder og stor vækst?

Precision Technic Defence Group søger en erfaren og forretningsorienteret HR Partner, der kan etablere og udvikle koncernens HR-processer og samtidig fungere som strategisk sparringspartner for ledelsen på tværs af organisationen.

Dette er en nyoprettet rolle med stor indflydelse og frihed til at forme HR-indsatsen i en virksomhed, hvor mennesker, kompetencer og organisation skal understøtte fortsat vækst og international udvikling.

Om rollen

Som HR Partner får du en central rolle i organisationen og bliver den naturlige rådgiver for ledelsen på tværs af lande og funktioner. Du refererer direkte til Group CEO og samarbejder tæt med den øvrige ledelse.

Du bliver ansvarlig for at opbygge og professionalisere en række HR-processer, samtidig med at du understøtter ledere i både strategiske og operationelle HR-relaterede problemstillinger.

Virksomheden beskæftiger cirka 70 medarbejdere fordelt på Danmark, Storbritannien, USA, Sverige og Australien, og du skal derfor trives i et internationalt miljø, hvor kulturforståelse, samarbejde på tværs af landegrænser og kendskab til forskellige ansættelsesforhold er afgørende.

Stillingen indebærer rejseaktivitet til virksomhedens lokationer.

Dine primære ansvarsområder

Du kommer blandt andet til at:

Etablere og implementere centrale HR-processer, -politikker og -værktøjer på tværs af koncernen

Udvikle og sikre en professionel medarbejderrejse fra rekruttering og onboarding til udvikling og offboarding

Rådgive og sparre med ledere på alle niveauer omkring organisation, ledelse og medarbejderforhold og herunder sikre compliance og best-practice

Understøtte organisatoriske forandringer, vækstinitiativer og forretningsudvikling

Udarbejde strukturer for performance management, medarbejderudvikling og talent management

Sikre overblik over kompetencer, kritiske nøglepersoner og fremtidige kompetencebehov

Bidrage med HR-data og analyser, som understøtter ledelsens beslutninger

Samarbejde med lokale ressourcer og eksterne rådgivere om ansættelsesretlige forhold i de lande, hvor virksomheden opererer

Kontrakthåndteringer og dialoger med både ledere og eventuelle interesseorganisationer omkring løn- og medarbejderforhold

Medvirke til at skabe en stærk fælles kultur på tværs af geografi og funktioner

Hvem er du?

Du har solid erfaring med bred HR-Partnering og er vant til at arbejde tæt sammen med ledere og beslutningstagere.

Samtidig motiveres du af muligheden for at skabe struktur, bygge nye processer og gøre en synlig forskel i en organisation, hvor HR endnu ikke er fuldt etableret.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

Har flere års erfaring fra en tilsvarende strategisk HR-rolle

Har erfaring med at opbygge eller udvikle HR-processer og HR-strukturer

Har arbejdet i internationale organisationer og kender til HR på tværs af flere lande

Har erfaring med organisationsudvikling, forandringsledelse og lederrådgivning

Har god forståelse for ansættelsesretlige forhold i internationale miljøer

Kommunikerer ubesværet på dansk og engelsk

Er selvstændig, handlekraftig og trives med at skabe resultater uden at have formelt personaleansvar

Vi lægger særligt vægt på, at du

Har høj integritet

Kan udfordre ledelsen konstruktivt og skabe tillid gennem faglig tyngde

Arbejder pragmatisk og forretningsorienteret

Er relationsskabende og kan navigere på tværs af kulturer og interessenter

Trives i en rolle med stor frihed og stort ansvar

Vi tilbyder

En nyoprettet nøglefunktion med betydelig indflydelse

Muligheden for at sætte dit præg på HR-området fra starten

Tæt samarbejde med virksomhedens øverste ledelse

En international organisation med korte beslutningsveje

Et spændende arbejdsmiljø i en virksomhed med fokus på teknologi, innovation og vækst

Hos Precision Technic Defence bliver du en del af en arbejdsplads med et stærkt sammenhold og en uformel, åben kultur, hvor man hjælper hinanden og løfter i fællesskab. Du får en varieret hverdag med stor grad af selvstændighed samt gode ansættelsesvilkår, herunder en attraktiv lønpakke, pension, sundhedsforsikring og adgang til både kantineordning og fitness.

Sikkerhed

title: Petroleum Sampler
description:
The sampler takes samples of various petroleum or chemical products. The purpose of the sampling is to obtain a representative portion of products from ships, barges and shore tanks.

JOB FUNCTIONS

  • Always work in a safe manner and according to company and terminal procedures.

  • Learn and apply appropriate procedures associated with sampling and custody transfers.

  • Sample shore-based tanks or vessels according to established procedures to obtain representative samples using various methods imposed by the company and/or ASTM or API procedures.

  • Identify and correctly enter all required data on sample labels.

  • Communicate with Senior Petroleum Product Inspectors about work orders.

  • Assist Senior Inspectors with vessel sampling.

  • Ensure that all equipment is clean and properly calibrated and that the calibration data has been recorded before any equipment can be used.

  • Clean and maintain inspection equipment.

  • Ensure that all relevant data is correctly recorded in documents or files.

  • Read and review available API/ASTM procedures and manuals related to our business line.

  • Understand and follow terminal work order instructions for each sampling or custody transfer.

  • Follow the Senior Inspector’s or the Laboratory Supervisor’s instructions for cleaning sample bottles, removing samples and replenishing shelves with new or clean bottles.

  • Communicate with terminal representatives and monitor transfer activities or vessels to ensure tasks are completed in a timely manner.

  • Clean and maintain company trucks.

  • Ensure the cleanliness of workstations, equipment rooms, locker rooms and inspection rooms.

  • Various special or ad hoc projects could be assigned on occasion.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

  • Education: High School Diploma (or equivalent)
  • Experience: 0 to 1 year of relevant work experience required or equivalent experience through education.
  • Minimum 1 year of experience in a production or manufacturing sector role.
  • Valid local driver’s license, Class 5
  • Experience in a petroleum-related field would be an asset.
  • Excellent math skills would be an asset.
  • Must be meticulous and punctual when performing tasks associated with petroleum sampling.
  • Demonstrated willingness to work and learn more about the marine/petroleum industry, with a focus on the quantity and quality of sampling and the monitoring of custody transfers.
  • Must be able to read, understand and follow work instructions in a safe, accurate and timely manner.
  • Candidates must be proficient in using various types of computer software (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, etc.).
  • Demonstrates excellent verbal and written communication skills including grammar and composition.
  • Ability to work well with others & independently.
  • Proven time management skills and a strong attention to detail.
  • Works well under pressure.
  • Extended hours may be required from time to time.
  • Willingness to work irregular hours according to sample schedules (days, nights, weekends and holidays).
  • Available to work weekends and on call 24 hours a day.
  • Travel to other SGS locations may be expected from time to time.
  • Ensures full compliance with the company’s Health & Safety, Code of Integrity, and Professional Conduct policies.

SGS is an Equal Opportunity Employer, and as such we recruit, hire, train, and promote persons in all job classifications without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, age, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression and Indigenous status, or any other characteristics protected by law.

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily with or without reasonable accommodations. The requirements listed above are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities required.

This job description should not be construed as an exhaustive statement of duties, responsibilities, or requirements, but a general description of the job. Nothing contained herein restricts the company’s rights to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time.

Accommodations are available on request for qualified candidates during each stage of the recruitment process.

Please note that candidates applying for Canadian job openings should be authorized to work in Canada.

Vil du have praktisk erfaring med kontrakter, compliance, datakvalitet og regulatoriske krav i en af Danmarks største forsikringskoncerner?

GF Forsikring søger en struktureret og nysgerrig studentermedhjælper til Procurement-teamet i Odense. Stillingen er oplagt for dig, der læser jura eller erhvervsjura - og som har interesse for regulering, struktur, data og tværfagligt samarbejde.

Du bliver en del af et professionelt indkøbsmiljø, hvor du får indblik i samspillet mellem forretning, IT, jura, compliance og leverandører. Her får du mulighed for at omsætte teori til praksis og opbygge erfaring inden for et område i hastig udvikling.



Om jobbet



Som studentermedhjælper bliver du en vigtig del af vores team på fem medarbejdere. Du hjælper med at sikre struktur, kvalitet og compliance i vores kontrakt- og leverandørstyring.



Du kommer bl.a. til at arbejde med:



	
Register of Information (ROI) - registrering og vedligeholdelse i forbindelse med indrapportering til Finanstilsynet (DORA)

	
Kontraktstyring - arkivering, datakvalitet og administration i vores kontraktstyringssystem

	
Procesbeskrivelser - dokumentation af arbejdsgange

	
Håndtering af kontraktændringer, forlængelser og opsigelser

	
Understøttelse af vores Sourcing- og Contract Managers

	
Dialog med systemleverandører om optimering af vores kontraktstyringssystem

	
Ad hoc-opgaver inden for Procuremen




Når du har opbygget erfaring, får du mulighed for at bidrage til arbejdet med nye aftaler, leverandørsamarbejder og andre centrale aktiviteter.



Om dig



Du er studerende på en videregående uddannelse - f.eks. Jura, HA ((jur.) - Erhvervsøkonomi og erhvervsjura) eller Cand.merc.jur. (Erhvervsjura). Det vigtigste er, at du har interesse for struktur, jura, data, processer og samarbejde på tværs.

Du har gennemført de første år af dit studie og er klar til at omsætte din faglige viden til praktisk erfaring i et professionelt arbejdsmiljø.



Vi forestiller os, at du:



	
Arbejder struktureret og har sans for detaljer

	
Trives med administrative og datatunge opgaver

	
Er nysgerrig og tager ansvar

	
Har gode IT-kompetencer og lærer hurtigt nye systemer

	
Kan arbejde selvstændigt og samtidig bidrage positivt til teamet

	
Har lyst til at lære mere om kontrakter, leverandørstyring og regulatoriske krav




Som person er du initiativrig, opsøgende og kvalitetsbevidst. Du skaber struktur, finder løsninger og bidrager til fællesskabet med godt humør og engagement.



Vi tilbyder



	
Et relevant studiejob i en stærkt reguleret branche

	
Indsigt i Procurement, kontraktstyring og leverandørstyring

	
Faglig og personlig udvikling

	
Fleksible arbejdstider (8-20 timer pr. uge)

	
Et uformelt arbejdsmiljø med høj faglighed

	
Erfaring, der er attraktiv i både finanssektoren og erhvervslivet generelt

Send din ansøgning og dit CV via linket nedenfor. Vi behandler ansøgninger løbende.

Hos GF Forsikring tror vi på, at forskellige perspektiver skaber de bedste løsninger. Vi opfordrer alle kvalificerede ansøgere til at søge - for i GF Forsikring har vi overskud til hinanden.

For os handler det altid om at give vores medlemmer den hjælp og service, de har brug for, og med mere end 1.000 kolleger spredt over hele Danmark yder vi både digital og lokal, nærværende og empatisk rådgivning - uanset hvor i landet vores medlemmer befinder sig. title: Product Manager
description:
Location: Remote / Hybrid (UK)

Job Type: Full-time

Salary: Â£65k - Â£80k, dependent on experience

Shape the Future of Service Management


For more than 36 years, Marval has been at the forefront of Service Management innovation. As one of the original co-authors of ITIL, we've helped define the standards that organisations across the globe still rely on today. Now, we're building on that legacy.


Our intelligent, no-code ITSM, ESM and Managed Service Management solutions empower organisations worldwide to transform the way they deliver services. As we continue to evolve our platform and accelerate our product strategy, we're looking for an ambitious Product Manager who wants to make a real impact.

If you thrive in flexible, fast-paced environments, enjoy solving complex customer problems and want genuine ownership of product decisions, we'd love to hear from you.

The Opportunity


As a Product Manager at Marval, you'll own a key area of our product roadmap from discovery through to delivery, launch and continuous improvement. This isn't a role where you'll simply manage a backlog or write requirements. We're looking for someone who loves talking to customers, validating ideas, challenging assumptions and working side-by-side with Development, Customer Success and Sales to build products that solve real problems. You'll have the autonomy to make decisions, influence product strategy and help shape the future of our platform.


What You'll Be Doing


  • Own the full product lifecycle, from customer discovery through to launch and ongoing optimisation.
  • Work closely with customers and internal stakeholders to identify genuine business problems and opportunities.
  • Prioritise features based on customer value, business goals and technical considerations.
  • Create clear product specifications and user stories that enable successful delivery.
  • Collaborate with Development throughout the development lifecycle, making informed trade-off decisions where required.
  • Analyse product performance, customer feedback and usage data to continually improve the user experience.
  • Communicate roadmap priorities, progress and strategic direction across the business.
  • Help develop and improve Product Management processes, tooling and ways of working as we continue to scale.


Skills and Experience


We're more interested in how you think, solve problems and collaborate with others.


You'll ideally have:


  • At least four years' experience in Product Management within B2B SaaS, Enterprise Software or a similar technology environment.
  • A strong understanding of IT Service Management (ITSM), Enterprise Service Management (ESM) or Service Management solutions.
  • Experience delivering successful software features that have improved customer adoption, engagement, retention or revenue.
  • Experience working within Agile product development teams.
  • Strong communication skills with the confidence to influence technical and non-technical stakeholders alike.
  • A customer-first mindset with excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities.
We'd love it if you also have:


  • Experience with no-code or low-code platforms.
  • Experience working in a startup or scale-up environment or have that mindset.
  • Exposure to global customer markets.
  • A passion for modern product management and continuous improvement.


Why Join Marval?


This is an opportunity to join a business with a proud heritage while helping shape its future.


At Marval, you'll enjoy:


  • Real ownership of product decisions and roadmap priorities.
  • The opportunity to influence products used by organisations around the world.
  • Flexible remote and hybrid working.
  • A collaborative, supportive team that values innovation and fresh thinking.
  • The stability of an established software company combined with the pace and ambition of a growing technology business.
  • Ongoing opportunities for professional development and career progression.
About You


You're someone who:


  • Is comfortable making decisions without having every piece of information.
  • Enjoys asking "why?" and digging beneath customer requests to uncover the real problem.
  • Works well with ambiguity and enjoys creating clarity where none exists.
  • Values collaboration and constructive challenge.
  • Takes ownership, learns quickly and isn't afraid to adapt when priorities change.
  • Wants to build products that customers genuinely love using.

title: Porgera | Technician - Underground Ventilations
description:
Technician – Underground Ventilations (241480)


About Us

New Porgera Limited (NPL) is a leading mining company dedicated to sustainable practices and community engagement in Papua New Guinea. As the operator of the Porgera Gold Mine, we focus on extracting high-quality mineral resources while prioritizing the well-being of our employees, the environment, and the local communities. Our commitment to safety, innovation, and responsible mining ensures that we not only contribute to the economy but also support the development and prosperity of the regions we operate in. At NPL, we strive to create a positive impact, fostering strong relationships with stakeholders and promoting sustainable growth for future generations.

NPL now has a vacancy for a qualified and experienced individual to join our Mine Technical Services Department as a Technician – Underground Ventilations (241480).

About the role

Reporting to the Senior Drill and Blast Engineer, the Underground Ventilation Technician supports the planning, monitoring, and optimization of the underground mine ventilation system to ensure a safe, compliant, and productive working environment. The role involves conducting ventilation surveys, collecting and analyzing data, maintaining monitoring equipment, and assisting with ventilation planning and regulatory compliance.

In this role, you will:

• Conduct routine underground ventilation surveys, including airflow, pressure, gas, temperature, humidity, and dust measurements.
• Inspect ventilation controls such as stoppings, regulators, doors, seals, and ventilation fans.
• Verify that ventilation circuits operate according to approved ventilation
• Collect, record, and maintain accurate ventilation monitoring data.
• Prepare routine ventilation reports and trend analyses.
• Assist in updating ventilation models and mine ventilation plans.
• Support investigations into ventilation-related incidents or abnormalities.
• Assist ventilation engineers with short- and long-term ventilation planning.
• Support the implementation of ventilation changes associated with mining development.
• Maintain a high level of health and safety awareness and comply with the NPL Occupational Health & Safety Policy and all health and safety rules and procedures

About You

To succeed in this role, the ideal candidate will possess the following qualifications and experiences:

• Bachelor’s degree in mining engineering, or a related discipline (preferred).
• Underground mining induction and relevant site competencies.
• Experience working in an underground mining environment.
• Knowledge of underground ventilation principles.
• Ability to use ventilation monitoring equipment.
• Strong attention to detail and accurate record keeping.
• Good communication and teamwork skills.
• Computer literacy, including Microsoft Office and experience using ventilation software (e.g., Ventsim)

Mobilization Requirement

This is a PNG National position, a site-based role on a FIFO arrangement with a rotation of 21 days on and 14 days off. Candidates must successfully pass a pre-employment medical, including drug and alcohol screening (to be arranged only for successful candidates after the interview stage), and provide an up-to-date Police Clearance Certificate (acquired within the last 6 months). Candidates must be PNG Nationals and available to start immediately.

Join Our Team as a Technician – Underground Ventilations (241480)

Embark on a rewarding career with NPL as a Technician – Underground Ventilation. This role offers a unique opportunity to work with a dynamic team to contribute to NPL’s success. Enjoy a balanced work schedule, competitive compensation, and a chance to develop your career and technical expertise in a supportive and professional environment.

Note: This advert will be open until 15th August 2026. If you do not hear from NPL within next two (2) weeks following the closing date, please consider your application unsuccessful for this opportunity.

Har du erfaring fra fjernvarme- eller anlægsprojekter, og motiveres du af at skabe fremdrift, samle dit sjak og få den daglige produktion til at fungere? Så kan det være dig, vi søger.



Munck Forsyningsledninger a/s har godt gang i vores fjernvarmeprojekter, og vi søger derfor en erfaren formand, der kan være med til at sikre en god og effektiv udførelse.



Som formand får du en central rolle på vores fjernvarmeprojekter i Silkeborg/Århus og omegn.  Du står tæt på den daglige udførelse og har - sammen med projektledelsen - ansvar for, at arbejdet bliver planlagt og gennemført sikkert, effektivt og i den aftalte kvalitet.



Du bliver bindeleddet mellem projektledelsen og medarbejderne på pladsen og er med til at sikre, at både mennesker og opgaver kommer godt i mål.



Dine primære opgaver bliver blandt andet at:



	
lede og koordinere mandskab, maskiner og materialer på pladsen

	
planlægge den daglige produktion sammen med projektledelsen

	
følge op på fremdrift, kvalitet og ressourceforbrug

	
sikre den nødvendige kvalitetssikring og dokumentation

	
have fokus på sikkerhed, trivsel og et godt arbejdsmiljø

	
samarbejde med bygherre, kolleger, underentreprenører og øvrige samarbejdspartnere




Om dig



Du har formentlig erfaring som formand, sjakbajs eller lignende inden for fjernvarme, forsyning eller anlæg. Det vigtigste er, at du har praktisk erfaring fra tilsvarende projekter og forstår arbejdsgangene på pladsen. Erfaring med fjernvarmeprojekter vil være en klar fordel.



Du er vant til at tage ansvar og ved, hvordan du skaber struktur og fremdrift i en travl hverdag. Samtidig har du blik for medarbejderne og for, hvad der skal til for at få et sjak til at fungere godt sammen.



Som person er du tydelig, løsningsorienteret og god til at samarbejde. Du går foran med et godt eksempel, bevarer overblikket og bidrager aktivt til den gode tone og det gode humør på pladsen.



Det er en forudsætning, at du har kørekort kategori B. Du skal desuden være fleksibel i forhold til arbejdssted, da projekterne vil være placeret forskellige steder i Jylland, og der i perioder kan forekomme opgaver uden for området.



Vi tilbyder



Hos os får du et selvstændigt job med ansvar, frihed og mulighed for at få indflydelse på den daglige udførelse af vores fjernvarmeprojekter.



Du bliver en del af en arbejdsplads med korte beslutningsveje, en fri omgangstone og kolleger, der hjælper hinanden med at få opgaverne sikkert og ordentligt i mål.



Vi lægger vægt på faglighed, samarbejde og ordentlighed, og vores værdier - enkelhed, respekt og rettidig omhu - er en naturlig del af hverdagen.



Lyder det som noget for dig?

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

Vi udfører hoved-, total og fagentrepriser og har mange års erfaring med at indgå i rammeaftaler med kommuner og forsyningsselskaber. Gennem de seneste år har vi ligeledes stået i spidsen for udførelsen af en række store, tværfaglige anlægsprojekter, bla. Baltic Pipe og Viking Link.

  • Strong expertise in Avature configuration, including workflows, forms, fields, templates, user roles, permissions, security models, and platform governance.

  • Hands-on experience with Avature Junction integrations, including API-led integration architecture, data mapping, transformation rules, orchestration, and error handling.

  • Stay current with Avature product capabilities and recommend innovative features and best practices to enhance business outcomes.

Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field.
