title: Specialist, Domain Enablement Analyst
description:
Job Description

The Opportunity :

Based in Hyderabad, join a global healthcare biopharma company and be part of a 130- year legacy of success backed by ethical integrity, forward momentum, and an inspiring mission to achieve new milestones in global healthcare.

Be part of an organisation driven by digital technology and data-backed approaches that support a diversified portfolio of prescription medicines, vaccines, and animal health products.

Drive innovation and execution excellence. Be a part of a team with passion for using data, analytics, and insights to drive decision-making, and which creates custom software, allowing us to tackle some of the world's greatest health threats.

Our Technology Centers focus on creating a space where teams can come together to deliver business solutions that save and improve lives. An integral part of our company’s IT operating model, Tech Centers are globally distributed locations where each IT division has employees to enable our digital transformation journey and drive business outcomes. These locations, in addition to the other sites, are essential to supporting our business and strategy.

A focused group of leaders in each Tech Center helps to ensure we can manage and improve each location, from investing in growth, success, and well-being of our people, to making sure colleagues from each IT division feel a sense of belonging to managing critical emergencies. And together, we must leverage the strength of our team to collaborate globally to optimize connections and share best practices across the Tech Centers.

Role Overview :

Evaluate the business impact of data quality, resolve domain data issues and inquiries, curate business metadata for discoverability, and monitor adherence to business rules. Partner with governance and downstream teams to prioritize remediation and ensure datasets are accurate, understandable, and fit for business use.

This position is based in our Hyderabad location, and we follow a hybrid work policy.

What will you do in this role:

Primary job responsibilities include:

  • Business Impact Monitoring and Prioritization
    • Assess how domain quality affects key outcomes (e.g., time-to-market, fulfillment accuracy, margin, regulatory compliance, customer experience).
    • Quantify impact using clear metrics and scorecards; prioritize remediation based on business value, risk, and urgency.
    • Communicate findings, trade-offs, and recommendations via concise reports and dashboards to product, supply chain, commercial, and finance stakeholders.
  • Issue Resolution and Business Inquiries
    • Investigate and resolve disputes related to domain definitions, ownership, lineage, and completeness/accuracy.
    • Manage intake and triage of ad hoc inquiries from business users; provide timely, well-documented responses with root-cause analysis and actions.
    • Drive cross-functional resolution through governance forums; maintain decision logs and track follow-ups to closure.
  • Business Metadata Cataloguing and Curation
    • Curate and maintain business metadata for datasets: context, definitions, descriptions, owners/stewards, usage notes, quality expectations, and authoritative sources.
    • Ensure datasets are discoverable and understandable in the enterprise catalog; keep entries current with versioning and change histories.
    • Align semantic definitions, classifications, and hierarchies with enterprise MDM standards and enterprise taxonomies.
  • Business Rule Adherence and Governance Collaboration
    • Collaborate with governance/capability teams to define, monitor, and report on product business rule application (validation rules, identifier standards, hierarchy integrity, versioning/variant rules).
    • Track violations and exceptions; coordinate remediation plans, waivers, and timelines with accountable owners.
    • Provide periodic compliance summaries and escalate systemic issues through governance channels.
  • Measurement, Reporting, and Continuous Improvement
    • Create and maintain dashboards for product domain health (data quality scores, rule adherence, issue backlog, time-to-resolution, business impact realized).
    • Identify trends and recurring issues; recommend improvements to data capture, processes, and controls (e.g., DQ rules, validations, workflow changes).
    • Update playbooks, FAQs, and guidance to reduce future inquiries and improve self-service and literacy.

Education Minimum Requirement:

Bachelor of Science (or equivalent) in Data Science, Computer Science, Management Information Systems, IT, MBA, or an equivalent scientific/commercial discipline within the pharmaceutical industry.

Required Experience and Skills:

  • Strong business acumen with a keen ability to understand how data can be leveraged to inform critical enterprise decisions and actions. (3+ years).
  • Proven ability to analyse and assess the value of data assets.
  • Proven potential to effectively collaborate with a broad range of internal and external stakeholders.
  • Intellectual curiosity and ability to identify innovative approaches to addressing data needs.
  • Excellent presentation, analytics, and communication skills, both written and oral, are required to synthesize key issues and communicate/persuade constituencies towards specific actions and initiatives.
  • Ability to operate in dynamic, transforming environment.
  • Strong experience in data management (Data analysis, Data architecture, Data Modelling)
  • Strong experience of SQL, AWS cloud services (S3, EC2, RDS, Redshift), Oracle RDBMS, JIRA, Git, Databricks
  • Strong organizational, time management and project management skills
  • Self-motivated, proactive, with ability to work independently with minimum direction.

What should you have:

  • Experience with data management (Data analysis, Data architecture, Data Modelling).
  • Experience with SQL, AWS cloud services (S3, EC2, RDS, Redshift), Oracle RDBMS, JIRA, Git, Databricks.
  • Ability to ensure datasets are discoverable and understandable in the enterprise catalog.
  • Exposure of maintaining AI ready datasets and applying AI tools in the governance of data.

Desired/Optional Technology Exposure:

  • Ability to work both independently and collaboratively within a geographically dispersed team
  • Ability to learn and use new technologies
  • Ability to manage through complexity and ambiguity along with competing priorities.
  • Experience defining & maintaining AI ready datasets and applying AI tools in the governance of data
  • Experience with data governance and data quality
  • Entrepreneurial spirit, motivated by uncovering new opportunities to add value to the organization.

Who we are:

We are in the United state Rahway, New Jersey, USA in the United States and Canada everywhere else. For more than a century, we have been inventing for lives, bringing forward medicines and vaccines for many of the world's most challenging diseases. Today, our company continues to be at the forefront of research to deliver innovative health solutions and advance the prevention and treatment of diseases that threaten people and animals around the world.

What we look for:

Imagine getting up in the morning for a job as important as helping to save and improve lives around the world. Here, you have that opportunity. You can put your empathy, creativity, digital mastery, or scientific genius to work in collaboration with a diverse group of colleagues who pursue and bring hope to countless people who are battling some of the most challenging diseases of our time. Our team is constantly evolving, so if you are among the intellectually curious, join us—and start making your impact today.

title: Senior Product Manager (m/f/d)
description:
Senior Product Manager (m/f/d)
     
          
 
              
              
              
              
           

         

       

 
 
 
 Posted  31 July 2026  

 
        
 
            
 
                
 
         Requisition ID 
         

     76936
     
                 

             

         

     

 
        
 
            
 
                
 
         Location(s) 
         

     
			
 

					 Aarhus N, Region Northern Jutland, DK, 8200
					 

					 
									  Leça do Balio, Grande Porto, PT, 4465-671
					 

					 
									  Hamburg, HH, DE, 20097
					 
			 


			
     
                 

             

         

     

 
        
 
            
 
                
 
         Work experience 
         

     Management
     
                 

             

         

     

 
        
 
            
 
                
 
         Type of position 
         

     Full-Time

 Are you motivated by the opportunity to drive meaningful business impact in one of the world's leading renewable energy companies?  



 As a Senior Product Manager, you will play a pivotal role in defining the future direction of our onshore wind portfolio, translating market opportunities into sustainable growth and delivering value for customers, Vestas, and the energy transition. 



 Vestas Technology & Operations > Product Line Onshore > Product Management ONS  


 Product Line Onshore is the strategic driving force behind VTO’s product success, with end-to-end accountability for competitiveness, customer value, and business outcomes. Acting as the voice of the customer within VTO and the voice of VTO towards customers, the function ensures that market needs, customer insights, and business priorities are translated into a compelling product vision and roadmap. 


 It steers the product portfolio, investment decisions, budgets, and key cross-functional initiatives to maximize value creation and long-term performance. In essence, the Product Line function aligns the organization around clear priorities, enabling efficient execution, innovation, and sustainable growth while delivering superior customer value. 


   


 Responsibilities 


 As a Senior Product Manager, you will be responsible for the strategic direction, competitiveness, and business performance of key product families within the Vestas onshore portfolio. Working across the end-to-end value chain, you will connect customer needs, market insights, technology development, and business priorities to ensure we continue to deliver industry-leading solutions. 


 This is a highly visible role requiring strong business acumen, strategic thinking, and the ability to create alignment and drive results across a global organization. 

 

 Own the strategy, roadmap, and business performance of assigned product families, ensuring alignment with customer needs, market opportunities, and company objectives 


 Identify growth opportunities and define initiatives that strengthen competitiveness, improve customer value, and drive profitable business outcomes 


 Act as the voice of the customer by translating market insights and operational challenges into clear product priorities and value propositions 


 Lead cross-functional alignment across engineering, manufacturing, operations, sales, and service to ensure successful execution of strategic priorities 


 Drive informed decision-making priorities through robust business cases, performance tracking, and clear recommendations to senior leadership 

 

   


 Qualifications 

 

 Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Business, Economics, or a related field. 


 Minimum 10 years of experience in renewable energy, electric utilities, industrial manufacturing, or other complex technology-driven industries 


 Proven track record of leading strategic initiatives, products, portfolios, or businesses with measurable commercial impact 


 Strong business and financial acumen, including experience developing business cases, growth strategies, and investment recommendations 


 Experience working effectively across multiple functions and stakeholder groups in a global environment 


 Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to influence decisions at senior leadership levels 

 

   


 Competencies 

 

 Demonstrated ownership mentality with a focus on delivering measurable business results 


 Ability to lead through influence, creating alignment and momentum without formal authority 


 Strong decision-making capability, balancing data, business judgement, and customer value 


 Collaborative and resilient leader who thrives in complexity and drives progress through ambiguity 


 Strategic thinker with a strong customer and market orientation 

 

   


 What we offer 


 This is a unique opportunity to help shape the future of onshore wind energy while contributing to the global energy transition. In this role, you will take end-to-end ownership of strategic product decisions that directly influence customer outcomes, business performance, and portfolio direction. You will work closely with senior leadership and collaborate with some of the industry's foremost experts across technology, operations, and commercial functions, gaining broad exposure and insight. 


 The position offers a dynamic, high-performing international environment that encourages initiative, accountability, and continuous improvement. Guided by our core values of Collaboration, Simplicity, Accountability, and Passion, we foster an inclusive culture where diverse perspectives are valued and innovative ideas can come from anyone, anywhere. 


   


 Additional information 


 The primary work location for this position is Aarhus (Denmark), Porto (Portugal) or Hamburg (Germany). 


 Up to 60 days of travel per year. 


 We do amend or withdraw our jobs and reserve the right to do so at any time, including prior to the advertised closing date. Please be advised to apply on or before 30th August 2026. 


   

    
 

   


 Our commitment to a fair hiring. 


 At Vestas, we evaluate all candidates solely based on their professional experience, education, and relevant skills. To support a fair recruitment process, we kindly ask that you remove any photos, dates of birth or graduation, gender pronouns, marital status, or other personal information not relevant to the role before submitting your CV/resume. Your CV/resume should focus on your professional and educational background, along with the necessary contact details (email and phone number). We train our hiring teams in inclusive evaluation and regularly review process outcomes to ensure fairness. 


   



  
 At Vestas, we recognize the value of diversity, equity, and inclusion in driving innovation and success. We strongly encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply, particularly those who may hesitate due to their identity or feel they do not meet every criterion. As our CEO states, "Expertise and talent come in many forms, and a diverse workforce enhances our ability to think differently and solve the complex challenges of our industry". Your unique perspective is what will help us powering the solution for a sustainable, green energy future.

title: Principal Engineering - Overhead Transmission
description:
Our Power and transmission section in GCC India - Sweden is looking for an overhead transmission line Engineer to support our wide portfolio of power networks and generation, and infrastructure projects, with a focus on our ever-growing portfolio of projects and clients seeking support with overhead transmission line design. Members of our power and transmission team not only perform the line design, but directly interact with colleagues in our other engineering teams, and with clients and regulators to understand requirements and negotiate solutions.

Requirements, Technical:

  • Knows to Prepare Technical Abstract from feasibility study and Specification.
  • Prepare Sag tension calculations using PLS CADD with defined weathering conditions, clearance checks and loading conditions using PLS Tower, in line with the specifications as per international standards.
  • Prepare loading calculations in excel & as well as in PLS CADD (Power Line Systems - Computer Aided Design and Drafting) software.
  • Preparation of PLS tower models as per international codes.
  • Spotting of Towers with Lidar Data.
  • Preparing engineering documents related to transmission tower, foundation design calculations etc.,
  • Attend site meetings (virtual) and provide ongoing design drawing changes / support as required during project build.
  • Knowledge of all applicable engineering standards.

Key Competencies / Skills:

  • Proven experience in the design of UK or Nordics Overhead Line Circuits (Towers and/or Poles) at any voltage up to 400kV.
  • Experience with PLS Tower/PLS pole for Tower Development is required.
  • Tower Spotting using PLS CADD is mandatory. AutoCAD experience is required.

  • Eurocode experience is preferred.

  • Wood transmission line pole design, Structural Design experience is an advantage but not mandatory.

Desired Skills:

  • Ability to negotiate effectively with internal and external clients.
  • Deliver superior quality designs and deliverables that meet the technical schedule.
  • Good communication skills, Team work, experience in working with countries outside India.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Civil or Electrical engineering, 14+ years of experience in the domain of activities.

  • Professional Qualification or near Chartered members are preferred.

BGV:

  • Employment with WSP India is subject to the successful completion of a background verification (“BGV”) check conducted by a third-party agency appointed by WSP India.

  • Candidates are advised to ensure that all information provided during the recruitment process — including documents uploaded — is accurate and complete, both to WSP India and its BGV partner”.

title: Specialist, Contracts
description:
L3Harris is dedicated to recruiting and developing high-performing talent who are passionate about what they do. Our employees are unified in a shared dedication to our customers’ mission and quest for professional growth. L3Harris provides an inclusive, engaging environment designed to empower employees and promote work-life success. Fundamental to our culture is an unwavering focus on values, dedication to our communities, and commitment to excellence in everything we do.

L3Harris is the Trusted Disruptor in defense tech. With customers’ mission-critical needs always in mind, our employees deliver end-to-end technology solutions connecting the space, air, land, sea and cyber domains in the interest of national security.

Job Title: Specialist, Contracts

Job Code: 41761

Job Location: Open to: San Diego, CA; Carlsbad, CA; Bristol, PA; Clifton, NJ; Melbourne, FL; Salt Lake City, UT

Job Schedule: 9/80- employees work 9 out of 14 days- totaling 80 hours worked, and have every other Friday off

Job Description:

L3Harris has an opening for a Contracts Specialist within the Spectrum Superiority (S2) Sector with a focus on direct international commercial sales. This role requires effective oral and written communication skills and the individual will be responsible for interfacing with the internal and external customer. Additional responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Ability to interpret and execute contractual documents (request for proposal, contract awards, modifications, etc.)
    • Ability to interpret contract structures and types (FFP, CPFF, CPAF, FPIF, T&M, etc.) and differentiate associated risk levels
    • Ability to review all assigned proposals and bids, identify and include beneficial terms and conditions (including terms of payment, ITAR, taxes and duties, international considerations, etc.)
    • Ability to negotiate and interpret business agreements (teaming agreements, non disclosure agreements, export license agreements, etc.)
  • Identify contract issues in program performance, offer solutions and implement those solutions as agreed upon by the team while exercising good judgement with minimal supervision
  • Maintain positive internal and external customer relationships based on professionalism, responsiveness and ethical conduct
  • Working understanding of FAR/DFARS, specifically FAR Part 12, commercial items
  • Understand and implement company policies and procedures

Essential Functions:

  • Working knowledge and understanding of FAR, DFARS, ITAR, etc. and/or equivalent government regulations
  • Must be skilled in the art of communication, analysis, negotiations, evaluation and presentations, including respectful and professional behavior demonstrated at all times.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Word, Excel & Powerpoint

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree and a miminum of 4 years of prior relevant experience, or Graduate Degree and a minimum of 2 years prior related experience in the field of Accounting, Business Administration, Business Management, Contract Administration, Supply Chain Management, Economics, Business Law, Finance or other applicable field
  • In lieu of a degree, minimum of 8 years related experience in the area of Contracts Administration/Management

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience within the Aerospace and Defense industry and/or Federal Government/military
  • Juris Doctrate Degree
  • Practical knowledge of project/program management.

In compliance with pay transparency requirements, the salary range for this role in California, Massachusetts, New Jersey, Washington, and the Greater D.C, Denver, or NYC areas is $79,000 - $147,000. L3Harris also offers a variety of benefits, including health and disability insurance, 401(k) match, flexible spending accounts, EAP, education assistance, parental leave, paid time off, and company-paid holidays. The specific programs and options available to an employee may vary depending on date of hire, schedule type, and the applicability of collective bargaining agreements.

  Company description
PA Consulting er et globalt innovations- og transformationskonsulenthus med dyb ekspertise inden for forsvar, beredskab, offentlig sektor, energi, transport, sundhed og finanssektoren. Vi hjælper vores kunder med at skabe værdi og navigere i en verden præget af konstant forandring, nye teknologier og stigende kompleksitet.



Vi er 4.000 specialister på globalt plan, der kombinerer strategisk indsigt, teknisk ekspertise og kreativ tænkning for at skabe bæredygtige og meningsfulde resultater. Vi værdsætter mangfoldighed i både erfaringer og baggrunde - og fremmer en samarbejdskultur, hvor innovation kan blomstre.




    

  




    
        


  

    

      

  Job description
Vi udvider vores Defence & Security-team i København og søger erfarne data-profiler, der kan omsætte datafaglighed til konkret forretningsværdi i et komplekst sikkerheds- og teknologilandskab. Det kræver både teknisk dybde, stærk konsulentadfærd og evnen til at arbejde tæt med kunder i forsvarssektoren.



Det ændrede trusselsbillede og den stigende digitalisering af samfundet kræver nye tilgange til organisatorisk transformation, operationel effektivitet og sikker teknologiimplementering. Hos PA arbejder vi tæt sammen med vores kunder for at levere konkrete strategier, fremme innovation og sikre varige forandringer. 



Som konsulent i vores Defence & Security-team vil du arbejde med projekter, der har direkte indflydelse på fremtidens forsvar og nationale sikkerhed i Danmark. Du får mulighed for at samarbejde med interessenter på tværs af sektoren, lede kritiske forandringsinitiativer og bidrage til store programmer, hvor teknologi, mennesker og processer går hånd i hånd.



Vi arbejder blandt andet med:    


Udvikling af data- og analytics-løsninger, der styrker beslutningsstøtte og operative kapaciteter  



Design og etablering af tværgående dataplatforme  



Udarbejdelse af data- og digitaliseringsstrategier i samarbejde med nøgleinteressenter  



Etablering og modning af data governance, dataarkitektur og masterdata-processer  



Data engineering og arkitektur - design af dataplatforme, integrationer og pipelines  



Understøttelse af digital infrastruktur i operationelle miljøer via udvikling af IT-processer i en forsvarskontekst med et stort sikkerhedsfokus    



Konsulentarbejde i krydsfeltet mellem teknologi, organisation og mennesker.    


Du bliver en del af et tværfagligt team i tæt samarbejde med kunden, hvor vi identificerer udfordringer, designer løsninger og leverer konkrete, målbare resultater. I takt med vores udvikling vil du også have mulighed for at arbejde med forsvars- og sikkerhedsopgaver internationalt.    

  




    

  




    
        


  

    

      

  Qualifications

Erfaring med at arbejde med ovenstående i regi af forsvaret og/eller lignende operative miljøer    



Datafaglighed inden for ét eller flere områder: Ddata engineering, data science, data governance eller data strategi  



Solid teknisk forståelse og evne til at omsætte data til forretningsmæssig værdi  



Erfaring med projektledelse, interessenthåndtering og leverancer i komplekse miljøer  



Stærke analytiske og kommunikative evner samt flair for struktureret problemløsning  



Forretningsforståelse og evnen til at bygge bro mellem data, teknologi og organisation  



Relevant akademisk uddannelse, fx inden for data, IT, ingeniørfag, økonomi eller samfundsvidenskab  



Flydende dansk og engelsk er et krav    



Erfaring fra management- eller IT-konsulenthuse    



Dokumenteret erfaring med projektledelse, kundeudvikling og teammentoring

Vi tror på, at diversitet skaber en stærkere organisation, og vi arbejder målrettet for at skabe et inkluderende og dynamisk miljø, hvor alle har mulighed for at trives. En tydelig vej for udvikling og karriereprogression    



Muligheden for at gøre en reel forskel i en af samfundets mest betydningsfulde sektorer

title: Machine Learning Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Machine Learning Infrastructure Engineer – Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.
This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Machine Learning Infrastructure Engineer
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $105,000–$143,000 Annually
Experience Required: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking a Machine Learning Infrastructure Engineer to design, build, and operate high-performance, highly reliable inference platforms for serving large machine learning models in production. The role focuses on the systems engineering side of AI deployment, including request routing, batching, caching, autoscaling, GPU utilization, and end-to-end observability across diverse model workloads. The ideal candidate brings strong distributed systems and performance engineering expertise, has shipped serving systems at scale, and understands the trade-offs between latency, throughput, cost, and quality in ML serving.

Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related field.
  • Six or more years of experience in distributed systems, infrastructure, or ML platform engineering.
  • Strong proficiency in Python and a systems language such as Go, Rust, or C++.
  • Deep experience operating high-throughput, low-latency services in production.
  • Hands-on experience with LLM or large model inference frameworks such as vLLM or TensorRT-LLM.
  • Strong understanding of GPU architecture, memory hierarchies, and accelerator utilization.
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes, autoscaling, and modern cloud platforms.
  • Experience with observability stacks including metrics, tracing, and structured logging.
  • Solid grounding in performance engineering and capacity planning.
  • Strong communication and incident response skills.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Open-source contributions to model serving infrastructure.
  • Experience with multi-region or globally distributed AI serving.
  • Familiarity with model quantization, distillation, and compression techniques.
  • Exposure to FinOps for AI workloads and cost-efficient serving design.
  • Experience supporting external-facing AI APIs at scale.
How to Apply
Would you like to know more about this opportunity? For immediate consideration, please send your resume to
Vision Technologies is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

This commitment extends to all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, training, compensation, promotion, transfer, leaves of absence, termination, layoffs, and recall.

BV Teck expressly prohibits any form of workplace harassment or discrimination. Any improper interference with employees' ability to perform their job duties may result in disciplinary action up to and including termination of employment.

title: Waste Management Aide - Main Campus (Day Shift)
description:
About Us:

The people of Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center (MSK) are united by a singular mission: ending cancer for life. Our specialized care teams provide personalized, compassionate, expert care to patients of all ages. Informed by basic research done at our Sloan Kettering Institute, scientists across MSK collaborate to conduct innovative translational and clinical research that is driving a revolution in our understanding of cancer as a disease and improving the ability to prevent, diagnose, and treat it. MSK is dedicated to training the next generation of scientists and clinicians, who go on to pursue our mission at MSK and around the globe.

Service is at the heart of what we do, and we take pride in delivering outstanding customer service and providing a safe, clean, and welcoming environment for our patients. Memorial Sloan Kettering is seeking a Waste Management Specialist to follow established hospital procedures for handling, containment, and disposal of solid and infectious waste. This role will be located at our Main Campus Location.

Role Overview:

  • Accurately scanning, segregating, packaging, and transporting various types of regulated medical waste
  • Safely using equipment such as tuggers and scintillators during waste transport and screening
  • Collaborating with departments like Radiation Safety for specialized waste handling
  • Maintaining a clean, safe, and organized waste management environment
  • Supporting overall hygiene and safety standards through daily sanitation tasks
  • Ensure all waste is properly tagged and labeled per regulatory standards.
  • Clean and disinfect waste management bins, room floors and walls; disinfect facility mops and ensure waste areas remain free of debris.
  • Organize and prioritize waste bins and equipment for efficient processing and removal; maintain a tidy, hazard-free workspace.
  • Proper and safe removal of linen, cardboard, recycling, RMW and Chemo waste

Key Qualification & Core Skills:

  • Ability to read, write, and understand basic instructions
  • Comfortable working in a physically demanding, safety-sensitive environment
  • Willingness to handle regulated medical and pathological waste
  • Attention to detail and adherence to regulatory guidelines

Additional Information.

  • Schedule: Day. 8:00AM-4:00PM, Mondays-Fridays, alternate weekends and holidays.
  • Location - 1275 York Ave (Main Campus)
  • Report to Supervisor, Environmental Services

Helpful links:

  • Compensation Philosophy
  • Benefit

Pay Range: $23.49 - $32.46

FSLA Status: Non-Exempt

At MSK, we believe in fair, competitive pay that reflects your job, experience, and skills.

title: Senior Product Manager
location: Canada, Ireland, United Kingdom, United States
description:
Hornblower Group is a global leader in experience and transportation. Spanning a 100-year history, Hornblower Group’s portfolio of international offerings includes water- and land-based experiences and ferry and transportation services. City Experiences, Hornblower Group’s premier experience division, offers dining and sightseeing cruises and walking and food tours through the City Cruises, Walks, and Devour brands. City Ferry, part of Hornblower Group’s Ferry and Transportation Division, is the largest private operator of high-speed passenger and vehicle ferries in the United States, carrying more than 10 million passengers annually and operating services including NYC Ferry, Puerto Rico Ferry, and other regional ferry systems. Hornblower Group’s subsidiaries include Hornblower Marine, which provides vessel outhaul and maintenance services at Bridgeport Boatworks in Bridgeport, Connecticut, and Seaward Services, Inc., a full-service shipping, waterfront logistics and management company that specializes in the operation and maintenance of government and commercial vessels. Additionally, Anchor Operating System, LLC, a Hornblower Group subsidiary and independent entity, provides reservation, ticketing and website integration services for clients in the transportation, tourism and entertainment industries. Today, Hornblower Group’s global portfolio covers over 10 countries, over 50 U.S. cities and serves more than 20 million guests annually. Headquartered in Orlando, Florida, Hornblower Group’s additional corporate offices reside in San Francisco, California; Boston, Massachusetts; Chicago, Illinois; London, United Kingdom; New York, New York; Dublin, Ireland; and across Ontario, Canada. For more information, visit hornblowercorp.com.

Position Summary:

We're hiring a Senior Product Manager to drive strategy and execution for the technology behind Sales and Service at Hornblower. While you own the platforms the Sales, Service, and Contact Center teams sell and serve on, those teams own their operations and their people. This role is the IT-side product owner for the Sales & Service organizations, where you will serve as a peer to your Sales-org and Marketing-org counterparts. In this role you will need to land outcomes through partnership while leading through influence. On the Sales side you own the technology for every non-web channel — contact center sales, group and event sales, partners and third parties, and OTA bookings. On the Service side you own service technology for every channel, web and OTA included, from pre-booking inquiry through post-booking support. Web sales itself sits with the Digital team — because the guest journey crosses that line constantly, you'll partner closely with Digital wherever their surface and yours meet.The problems aren't fully framed yet, the stakeholder map is wide (Sales, Contact Center, Marketing, Digital, plus vendors like Anchor and Salesforce and several consultancies), and the right answer generally isn't sitting in anyone's backlog. You'll shape it as the first dedicated product owner for this scope, in close partnership with the Head of Product.

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Drive the enterprise roadmap for Sales and Service technology, framing the problems worth solving and sequencing the bets across channels, vendors, and internal teams.
  • Shape the technology strategy and the measurement approach behind it — define what good looks like for non-web sales (contact center, group/event, partners, OTA) and for cross-channel service, and the metrics we'll hold ourselves to.
  • Navigate the internal-and-vendor stakeholder map and lead without authority to a single coherent plan people can commit to.
  • Partner closely with the Digital team at the web/non-web seam — Digital owns the web sales surface, you own everything else in sales and all of service, and the guest journey crosses that boundary constantly. Make the seam invisible to the guest.
  • Influence senior partners across IT and the business to make the contested tradeoffs — build vs. buy, vendor vs. internal, sales-channel-specific vs. shared service capability — and own the rationale behind those calls.
  • Partner with engineering and vendor teams on architecture tradeoffs across a multi-platform ecosystem; bring a clear technical point of view to decisions about Anchor, Salesforce, and the integrations between them.
  • Drive execution against the roadmap across multi-quarter horizons, sequencing near-term wins in contact center, group/partner sales, OTA, and cross-channel service so they compound into the longer-arc strategy.

What success looks like (first 6–12 months)

  • You've published an enterprise roadmap for Sales and Service technology that the business, IT leadership, the Digital team, and key vendors are aligned to — and that holds up when priorities shift.
  • You've reframed at least one ambiguous problem in the scope (e.g., what "service" actually means across web, OTA, contact center, and partner bookings) and shipped a strategy others now plan against.
  • You've moved a meaningful metric in either non-web sales (including OTA) or cross-channel service, and can attribute the impact. You've built a working rhythm with the Digital team where web/non-web boundary calls — what belongs to Digital, what belongs to you, what's shared — get made cleanly and quickly, not relitigated.
  • Senior stakeholders across Sales, Contact Center, Marketing, and Digital bring you the hard tradeoffs instead of routing around the roadmap.

Requirements & Qualifications:

  • Multiple prior cycles of driving strategy and execution for an ambiguous, multi-stakeholder domain — you've done this more than once, not just adjacent to it.
  • A demonstrated ability to find and frame the right problems when the mandate is fuzzy and the stakeholder map is fragmented.
  • Experience building enterprise or cross-channel roadmaps that align internal business partners and external vendors to a shared plan.
  • A track record of landing cross-functional decisions with senior stakeholders you don't report to — functions that don't report into you or each other now move together because of how you ran the call.
  • A clear point of view on how to measure success for sales and service outcomes, and the data fluency to define metrics rather than just consume dashboards.
  • Able to engage engineering and vendor teams on architecture tradeoffs — integration approaches, platform choices, build-vs-buy — and explain the reasoning behind your position.

Nice to have:

  • Background in maritime, hospitality, travel, or experiences — particularly on the sales or service side.
  • Hands-on experience with Salesforce as a product surface.
  • Familiarity with ticketing platforms, especially Anchor or Ventrata.
  • Comfort in the Atlassian Suite (JIRA, Confluence) as your working environment.
  • Practical use of AI tools (Claude, Codex, or similar) in your PM workflow — research, synthesis, spec drafting, prototyping.

description:

Our employees are unified in a shared dedication to our customers’ mission and quest for professional growth. L3Harris provides an inclusive, engaging environment designed to empower employees and promote work-life success. L3Harris is the Trusted Disruptor in defense tech. With customers’ mission-critical needs always in mind, our employees deliver end-to-end technology solutions connecting the space, air, land, sea and cyber domains in the interest of national security.

Job Title: Associate Manager, Mechanical Engineering -Tooling

Job Code: 41668

Job Location: Huntsville, AL – AMF North and AMF South

Job Schedule: 4/10: Employees work 10 hour days, 4 days a week

Job Description:

The Missile Solutions Segment of L3Harris is excited to announce an opening for an Associate Mechanical Engineering Manager- Tooling at our Advanced Manufacturing Facilities (AMF) in Huntsville, AL. These facilities are the forefront of innovation, specializing in the fabrication and assembly of cutting-edge composite rocket motor hardware.

The Associate Mechanical Engineering Manager is responsible for technical and administrative leadership of the Tool Engineering group within Operations. This manager provides tool engineering process direction and leadership to tool engineers supporting production and new product components.

Essential Functions:

  • Provides tool engineering and tool design process direction and leadership to the tooling organization to support production and development programs.
  • Develop and utilize processes that promote continuous improvement using lean manufacturing and other Operational Excellence tools.

Job Title: Kundekoordinator


Kundekoordinator - kan du give topservice?


 


Danmarks største kæde af Oticon-certificerede hørecentre søger en kundeservicekoordinator til vores butik på Peter Bangsvej, Frederiksberg.



Audikas mission er at hjælpe flere mennesker med at høre bedre. Det gør vi ved at give vores kunder den bedste service og rådgivning omkring hørelse, så et besøg hos os bliver en god og positiv oplevelse.

Vi består af engagerede og dygtige hørespecialister og kundekoordinatorer fordelt på landets +76 butikker og vi vækster fortsat.




Din rolle som kundeservicekoordinator


Service er din passion, og det afspejler sig i den måde, du møder vores kunder på. 


 


Det er naturligt for dig aktivt at møde kunderne med høj grad af empati og professionalisme, hvor du får dem til at føle sig velkommen - om det er på telefonen eller fysisk i butikken.


 


Dine ansvarsområder er, at:



Sørge for at butikken er indbydende og klar til at modtage kunderne,


besvare telefonopkald samt ringe til kunderne,


håndtere småreparationer/service samt pleje af høreapparater,


sælge tilbehør, foretage aftaleplanlægning og opdatering af kundeinformation,


administrative opgaver - kendskab til Microsoft Office-pakken er en fordel.



 


Smil og attitude



Som person brænder du for at give den bedste service og "gå-hele-vejen" for dine kunder og kolleger. Du stortrives i en udadvendt og opsøgende rolle, og har let til smil. 


 


Derudover er du:



Fleksibel - du er altid klar til at give en hånd med, hvis en kollega har brug for hjælp,


positiv og udadvendt - du trives med en udadvendt rolle, hvor du møder kunderne og dine kolleger med et smil, og du bidrager positivt til kulturen.



 


Din værktøjskasse:
Erfaring fra hørebranchen er ikke et krav, vi skal nok klæde dig på til rollen.


 


Det vigtigste for os er, at du trives med at have en udadvendt rolle, hvor samtalen med andre mennesker er naturligt for dig.


 


Du har muligvis allerede arbejdet i et servicefag tidligere, og derfor forstår vigtigheden af, hvad god service er.


 


Desuden trives du med at have forskellige opgaver og er god til at veksle imellem dem. Du ser mulighederne for kunden og Audika samt leverer god service hver eneste gang.


Vores værdisæt
Tillid, godt samarbejde og en "can-do attitude" er en del af det værdisæt, som du bliver en del af. Derfor vægter vi, at du også kan se dig i disse værdier.


 


Hvad du bringer ind af kreative løsninger for at gøre hverdagen nemmere for vores kunder, er dét som gør dig endnu mere værdifuld, og vi vil gøre vores for at klæde dig på til denne opgave. 


 


Vi tilbyder:



En fuldtidsstilling med betalt frokostpause, bonus ordning og fri hver weekend,


ordnede forhold, i en organisation hvor god personalepleje, frihed under ansvar og tillid er en selvfølge,


dygtige og passionerede kolleger, hvor der er stor mulighed for faglig sparring,


en venlig og uformel kultur, men hvor vi sætter vores faglighed højt,









Om butikkerne
Vores butikker er beliggende på Peter Bangsvej på Frederiksberg. Din kollega vil være 1 hørespecialist, som du i det daglige vil have et tæt samarbejde med. Derudover får du også mulighed for at sparre med kollegaer på tværs af hele landet.


 


 


Har du lyst til at blive en del af holdet?
Send en kortfattet ansøgning med CV til os hurtigst muligt, dog senest d. 16.  august 2026 Interviews er planlagt til uge 34 og 35.


 


Bemærk at vi kun modtager ansøgninger via vores online platform.


 


Er du nysgerrig på at vide mere om jobbet, er du velkommen til at kontakte Regionschef Rasmus Lundsteen efter d. 6. august 2026: rasl@audika.dk


Audika er en Oticon-certificeret kæde af private hørecentre. Vi er eksperter i audiologi, teknologi og høreomsorg. Vi sætter en dyd i at hjælpe mennesker med at opnå den bedst mulige hørelse, så de kan leve det liv, de ønsker - uden begrænsninger. Vi er ambitiøse i vores målsætning, og vi mener, at succes er noget, vi opnår i fællesskab. På vejen dertil er vores værdier centralt i alt, hvad vi foretager os: Vi skaber tillid, vi er team-players, vi er innovative og vi har altid en can-do attitude. 


 


Audika er en del af Demant-gruppen, som er en af de førende organisationer indenfor høreomsorg med over 100 års erfaring. Du vil derfor ikke kun få kollegaer i Danmark - men også rundt omkring i verden. Vi har altid adgang til den nyeste viden og teknologi indenfor branchen, hvor vi samarbejder på tværs af gruppen. Vi er en global kæde med en lokal tilgang. 
 


Læs mere om Audika her: www.audika.dk 


Hos Demant værdsætter vi mangfoldighed, lighed og inklusion (DE&I), og vi er forpligtet til at skabe et inkluderende arbejdsmiljø. Vi modtager gerne ansøgninger fra alle kvalificerede kandidater uanset etnisk baggrund, personlighed, alder, køn og uddannelse. Mangfoldighed er en del af vores kulturelle DNA. Kvinder i STEM-områder opfordres især til at søge, da Demant støtter FN's mål 5 for bæredygtig udvikling om ligestilling. #


#LI-BB1 

























                
    
                

            

        

    

    
    

        

        

    

    
    

        

                    About Audika Group
The Audika Group is the hearing care division of Demant and we are one of the world's leading hearing care retailers with more than 3,500 clinics in 25 markets. If you join our team, you are guaranteed an inspiring and motivating working environment in a highly international environment. You will work with a variety of different countries, cultures and perspectives, in close collaboration with amazing and committed colleagues.



 


        

    

                                        

                                        

    
    

        

        

    

    

        


    

    

        


    

    

        


    

    
    

        

                    Who we are
Audika Group is the Hearing Care division of Demant and one of world’s leading hearing care retailers. With more than 5,000 hearing care experts in over 3,500 clinics worldwide, we combine our global reach with a local approach and strong local brands. Our team includes audiologists, managers, front-desk staff, and many other global and local functions. We are diverse in our talents, cultures, and perspectives, but united in our vision - to help more people hear better with the best personalized care.                              So, if you’re ready to make a career out of helping people love their ears, we’d love to hear from you.

     careersite--jobs--form-overlay#showFormOverlay" data-careersite--jobs--form-overlay-target="coverButton">

     blocks--cover--scroll#handleScrollDown" title="Rul til indhold">
       
   
  
       
  
 
      Vil du sætte retningen for nogle af de mest centrale digitale løsninger i Alm. Brand? Trives du med en hverdag, der både indeholder nyudvikling og incidenthåndteringer? Så er du måske vores næste kollega hos Alm. Brand Group.  
  
 Vi søger en Product Owner, der kan omsætte forretningsbehov til løsninger, skabe retning for udviklingsteams og sikre, at vi løbende leverer mest mulig værdi til kunder og forretning. Du trives i spændingsfeltet mellem forretning og teknologi, og motiveres af at skabe resultater gennem samarbejde og klare prioriteringer.  

  

  Om os 
  Du vil blive en del af vores Digital domæne, hvor vi bl.a. har ansvaret for at udvikle og vedligeholde de kundevendte digitale løsninger og vores salgsværktøjer til kolleger, der sælger til og servicerer kunderne i Alm. Brand Group. 
 
  Vi arbejder agilt og tværfagligt, og vi tror på, at de bedste løsninger skabes i fællesskab. Derfor er samarbejde, ansvarlighed og faglig nysgerrighed centrale dele af vores kultur. Vi lægger vægt på høj faglighed, løbende læring og et arbejdsmiljø, hvor vi lykkes sammen.  

  

  Din rolle 
  Som Product Owner er du en nøglespiller i et af vores produktområder, hvor du får ansvar for at balancere udvikling af nye initiativer, sikre stabil drift og løbende forbedringer. Du er ansvarlig for at sikre værdien af teamets leverancer og fungere som bindeled på tværs af stakeholders og udviklingsteams, og du sikrer, at vi arbejder med de rigtige opgaver på det rigtige tidspunkt.  

 
  Dine ansvarsområder vil blandt andet være:  
 
 
  Eje, prioritere og vedligeholde backloggen og sikre at organisationen når sine mål på både kvalitet og budget indenfor aftalte rammer.  
 

 
  Oversætte forretningsbehov til konkrete features, user stories og løsninger i tæt samarbejde med teamet.  
 

 
  Sikre, at teamet forstår mål, prioriteter og ønskede outcomes.  
 

 
  Samarbejde tæt med udviklere, arkitekter og Agile Delivery Leads.  
 

 
  Sikre stabil drift og processer omkring incidenthåndtering og verificering samt kvalificering af indmeldte fejl og issues i tæt samarbejde med Agile Delivery Leads og platformsejere.  
 

 
  Sikre transparens omkring værdiskabelse, fremdrift og prioriteringer.  
 

 
  Anvende data og indsigter til at planlægge, træffe beslutninger og måle effekt.  
 

 
  Drive dialogen med stakeholders på tværs af organisationen.  
 
 
  

  Hvem er du? 
  Vi leder efter dig, der har en stærk teknisk forståelse og kan skabe retning i komplekse problemstillinger. Du er forretningsorienteret og forstår behovet for at sikre et stabilt driftssetup. Du behøver ikke være teknisk specialist, men du skal kunne forstå teknologien godt nok til at stille de rigtige spørgsmål, udfordre løsningsforslag og skabe fælles retning mellem stakeholders, IT-arkitekter og udviklere.  

  Vi forestiller os, at du:  
 
 
  Har +3 års erfaring med at arbejde som Product Owner (eller lignende roller) efter agile metoder og værdier.  
 

 
  Har arbejdet i et teknisk komplekst setup med ansvar for både udvikling og drift.  
 

 
  Har forståelse for systemarkitektur, integrationer og moderne softwareudvikling.  
 

 
  Er en tydelig kommunikator og naturlig samarbejdspartner.  
 

 
  Har stærke kompetencer inden for stakeholder management.  
 
  
 
  Er løsningsorienteret og nysgerrig med et stærkt fokus på at skabe resultater.  
 

 
  Kan begå dig på dansk og engelsk, både skriftligt og mundtligt.  
 
 
  
 Vi tilbyder 
  Du bliver en del af et af Danmarks førende forsikringsselskaber, hvor vi kombinerer agile værdier, stærkt samarbejde og en kultur, hvor du får mulighed for at tage ansvar og sætte dit aftryk på vores løsninger. Hos os er fællesskabet i fokus - vi fejrer vores succeser sammen og ser udfordringer som noget, vi lærer og vokser af.  

  Vi holder til på Midtermolen med en fantastisk udsigt over vandet og kun et stenkast fra Østerport Station, så det er nemt at komme hertil - uanset om du cykler, tager toget eller går. Her får du ikke bare et inspirerende arbejdsmiljø, men også en hverdag, hvor balancen mellem arbejde og fritid er i højsædet.  

  Vi tilbyder en attraktiv lønpakke med personalegoder som tand- og sundhedsforsikring, rabatter på privatforsikringer og fleksibilitet med mulighed for hjemmearbejde. Samtidig kan du engagere dig i vores sports- og medarbejderforeninger og blive en del af et stærkt socialt og fagligt fællesskab.  

  

  Skal det være dig? 
 Hvis du kan se dig selv som en del af Alm. Brand Group, så send os din motiverede ansøgning og dit CV snarest muligt - vi evaluerer nemlig løbende ansøgninger og forventer at indkalde til samtaler i uge 38 og 39.  

  I din motiverede ansøgning vil vi rigtig gerne mærke dig og få et indblik i din personlighed. Vi håber derfor, at du vil reflektere over, hvad der motiverer dig ved rollen, og hvordan du ser dine kompetencer og erfaringer komme i spil. Tænk gerne ansøgningen fremadrettet - hvordan forestiller du dig, at du kan bidrage og skabe værdi i rollen?  

  

  Har du spørgsmål? 
  Så er du velkommen til at skrive en mail til Line på:    lwr@codan.dk   . Line er på ferie frem til den 17. august og følger op på din mail, når hun er tilbage.  

  

  Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig! 
  

 
  

  

 
  Til dig, der søger hos os 
  Du er velkommen til at bruge AI, når du søger hos os. Det vigtigste for os er, at vi stadig kan mærke dig - dine refleksioner og din motivation.  

  I vores rekrutteringsproces er der mennesker hele vejen. Vi bruger ikke AI til at screene eller vurdere ansøgninger.  

  Alle ansøgninger behandles naturligvis fortroligt. Vi opfordrer alle - uanset alder, køn, baggrund, handicap eller oprindelse - til at søge stillingen. 
  

 Alm. Brand Group er en af Danmarks største forsikringsselskaber, og omfatter både Alm. Brand, Codan, Privatsikring og Erhvervssikring. Vi er over 2000 medarbejdere, der arbejder for at sikre og forsikre vores flere end 800.000 kunder. Vores fundament er fokus på kunden, høj arbejdsglæde og vores værdisæt: Vi er ambitiøse, Vi er ordentlige, Vi udviser tillid. Læs mere om Alm. Brand Group på  almbrandgroup.com . Følg os på LinkedIn:  Alm. Brand Group .

Vil du være en del af noget, der både lugter lidt af havn - og meget af fremtidens fødevarer?


Aarhus Protein ligger centralt på Aarhus Havn, hvor vi producerer plantebaserede proteiner. Vi er et lille, dedikeret hold på 12 kolleger, der får tingene til at ske - i et miljø præget af samarbejde, ansvar og godt købmandskab.

Vi er stolte af at være med til at udvikle fremtidens proteinkilder og gøre fødevareproduktionen mere bæredygtig. Og vi har brug for flere dygtige medarbejdere til vores produktion for at få hverdagen til at køre - bogstaveligt talt.



Hvad du kommer til at lave

Du bliver et helt centralt tandhjul i maskinrummet.

Du får en alsidig hverdag, hvor du:


Indgår i et selvkørende produktionsteam



Træffer beslutninger og tager ansvar, når situationen kræver det



Arbejder struktureret med optimering, fejlsøgning og stabil drift



Sikrer høj oppetid og god færdigvarekvalitet



Bidrager til et arbejdsmiljø, hvor tingene fungerer - fordi folk gør


Det er praktisk, teknisk og hands-on arbejde, hvor du kan se resultatet af din indsats hver dag.



Hvem vi tror du er

Du kan have mange uddannelsesveje: procesoperatør, mejerist, procesteknolog, maskinmester - måske nyuddannet. Men vigtigst er din tilgang:


Du er fleksibel ift. opgaver og arbejdstider (dag/nat + weekend efter plan)



Du har teknisk flair og gerne håndværksmæssig erfaring



Du tager ansvar og går forrest, når noget skal løses



Du lærer hurtigt og trives i et miljø, hvor ikke to dage er helt ens



Du bidrager til samarbejde, gode beslutninger og en positiv tone


Kort sagt: Du er typen, man gerne vil på vagt med.



Hvad vi tilbyder


En afvekslende og vigtig rolle i en virksomhed i bevægelse



Gode muligheder for både faglig og personlig udvikling



Et team præget af ambitioner, respekt og et godt grin i løbet af dagen



Et procesanlæg, vi løbende forbedrer og udvikler



En konkurrencedygtig løn - og kolleger, der faktisk hjælper hinanden




Interesseret?

Lyder dette som noget for dig, så send din ansøgning og dit CV allerede i dag. Vi afholder løbende samtaler og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat.

Har du spørgsmål til os eller jobbet, er du velkommen til at kontakte Plant Manager Martin Eliasen på men@aarhus-protein.dk eller 51 58 42 62.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

title: Entrepriseleder hos M. J. Eriksson A/S
description:
Entrepriseleder hos M. J. Eriksson A/S





  






























































































Hvordan vil du som Entrepriseleder skabe stærkt samarbejde, tydelig struktur og et højt fagligt niveau på vores store motorvejsprojekt?
Vi søger en engageret Entrepriseleder med en god teknisk forståelse og evnen til at drive vores anlægsprojekter sikkert i mål. Stillingen er tilknyttet vores anlægsprojekt i Kalundborg, hvor du vil blive en del af vores kompetente team og spille en vigtig rolle i arbejdet med udbygningen af Kalundborgmotorvejens 3. etape. 




Som Entrepriseleder hos M.J. Eriksson bliver du en del af projektledelsen og får et selvstændigt ansvar for planlægning, koordinering og fremdrift på din entreprise. Du bliver bindeleddet mellem formænd, byggeledelse, rådgivere og underentreprenører, og du får en nøglerolle i at omsætte faglig indsigt til effektiv udførelse, kvalitet og sikkerhed på pladsen.




Dine primære arbejdsopgaver som Entrepriseleder vil indebære at: 


Planlægge, styre og følge op på udførelsen af egen entreprise - fra opstart til aflevering.


Udarbejde tidsplaner og logistikplaner for at sikre en god og effektiv produktion igennem nøje projektgranskning og ved tidlige identificering af kritiske opgaver.


Sikre at projektet og projektmaterialet er bygbart, med baggrund i erfaring og almen byggeskik.


Sikre at udarbejdelse af budget og kvalitetsplaner udføres og overholdes, i tæt dialog med projektteamet.


Indhente tilbud og indgå aftaler med underentreprenører og leverandører i samarbejde med formænd.


Indgå i et tæt dagligt samarbejde med formænd, for at sikre en god og effektiv produktion.


Arbejde målrettet med sikkerhed, arbejdsmiljø og kvalitetsstyring som en integreret del af projektets drift.


Er du vores nye kollega? 

Vores dygtige entrepriseledere har forskellige faglige baggrunde, men fælles for dem er ambitionen om at skabe struktur, samarbejde og kvalitet i komplekse projekter. For at lykkes i rollen ser vi gerne, at du:





Har en teknisk, bygningskonstruktør eller ingeniørfaglig baggrund (fx inden for anlæg, byggeri, infrastruktur eller lignende.) samt har kendskab til og har arbejdet med entrepriser og jordarbejder.


Har arbejdet med entreprisestyring og trives i en rolle, hvor du både planlægger og følger op på udførelsen af projektet.


Har kendskab til økonomistyring og budgettering, og sætter en ære i at skabe et solidt økonomisk fundament for projektet.


Trives i en udadvendt rolle og evner at kommunikere klart og konstruktivt i dagligdagen på byggepladsen.


Trives i en rolle hvor kundernes krav kan gøre, at arbejdstiden ofte vil være i helligdage og ferieperioder, hvor der vil være høj aktivitet og brug for en ekstra indsats. Samtidig vil der udenfor disse perioder, være plads til kompensering.


Motiveres af at lære og udvikle dig i samspil med dine kolleger.


Har fokus på sikkerhed, kvalitet og samarbejde på tværs af organisationen.


Det praktiske og teamet

Hos os bliver du en del af M.J. Erikssons stærke faglige fællesskab. Du bliver dermed en del af en stolt og robust virksomhed hvis mandskab og maskiner har lagt fundamentet til alt fra Storebæltsforbindelsen, jernbanenettet til Femernforbindelsen, de jyske motorveje, faunastier under og over motorveje, til en skybrudsledning under Amalienborg Slotsplads og etablering af store fjernvarme projekter.




Stillingen som Entrepriseleder er knyttet til vores kontor i Mørkøv ved Kalundborg, hvor du vil indgå i vores kompetente team. Derudover vil du komme til at samarbejde med vores dygtige kollegaer på pladsen, og du vil indgå i et kollegialt fællesskab med positiv energi, højt fagligt niveau og specialiseret viden.




Løn fastsættes efter kvalifikationer. 




Spørgsmål og ansøgningsproces

Ansøgningsfrist: Vi holder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat, så send gerne din ansøgning snarest muligt.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte projektchef Jannik Thorup Van Dijk på mail på jtd@mje.dk da der afholdes ferie i de kommende uger og derfor ikke kan kontaktes telefonisk i den periode.

 

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig og til at byde dig velkommen!

 

 




























































Om M. J. Eriksson A/S


M.J. Eriksson A/S er Danmarks største anlægsentreprenør med over 700 ansatte og aktiviteter i hele landet. Vi er med til at udvikle og udbygge Danmark med vores anlægsprojekter, der omfatter en bred vifte af arbejdsomra der inden for infrastruktur, energi og forsyning, miljø og kloakering, byggeri og renovering samt klimatilpasning. I M.J. Eriksson har vi flere afdelinger med speciale inden for hvert sit fagomra de. Disse tæller bl.a. anlæg, bane, forsyning, fundering, beton m.fl. M.J. Eriksson er en virksomhed, der er opbygget med en flad organisationsstruktur, hvor den direkte kommunikation er i højsædet, og hvor fleksibilitet og hurtige beslutningsprocesser præger arbejdsgangen i vores travle hverdag.

title: Senior Specialist, Non-Financial Reporting
description:
We are on the lookout for a Senior Specialist, Non-Financial Reporting to join the Finance team on our journey to always deliver amazing experiences.

This teammate will play a critical role in driving DH’s global CSRD-compliant (Corporate Sustainability Reporting Directive) non-financial report disclosure across our network of brands and their operating countries. This role will work closely with the broader team responsible for non-financial reporting, key central stakeholders like Finance, People & Culture, Legal, Product, and other functions, but also global stakeholders from network brands. This teammate will help to implement transformative partnerships, roadmaps, and project plans to collate required quantitative and qualitative information, produce, and externally assure DH’s annual non-financial report. Over the next period this role will help evolve non-financial reporting, risk management, and internal controls up to par with financial reporting.

  • Play a leading role in the production of the annual global non-financial report for the group.

  • Develop communication materials to effectively engage stakeholders, providing clear context and guidance on CSRD reporting requirements

  • Lead or support annual reporting on EU Taxonomy, non-financial risk assessment, and the coordination of new non-financial reporting regulations.

  • Monitor the evolving regulatory landscape and ensure disclosures remain aligned with leading global frameworks, such as GRI, SASB, TCFD, and ISSB.

  • Collaborate with Investor Relations on materials for, and queries from, investors; lead on annual ESG disclosures (e.g., potentially CDP).

  • Support and lead on aspects of external assurance for the non-financial report; continue optimising and evolving related processes from year to year incl. automation.

  • Lead on projects and initiatives that contribute to the reporting readiness of the Group in relation to the new regulations (CSRD).

  • Strong interest and experience in leading non-financial reporting and external assurance work/working directly with auditors – in the corporate setting, or at a consultancy/as an auditor.

  • Ability to learn quickly, with excellent qualitative analytical skills – to understand ESRS standards on various non-financial topics and help internal partner teams collate and refine disclosure content.

  • Ability to process multiple workstreams at the same time, proven project management skills and attention to detail

  • Degree in a field that builds related skills, knowledge and experience in a related role, with strong stakeholder management skills.

  • Fluency in English and strong verbal, written, and presentation skills; proven organisational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to process multiple tasks and workstreams in parallel in a dynamic environment.

  • A strong, flexible, and team/growth-oriented mindset.

Nice to have:

  • Knowledge of German and European non-financial reporting regulations (CSRD, EU Taxonomy, NFRD), GRI, SASB, and especially TCFD

  • Basic greenhouse gas (GHG) accounting principles.

  • Fluency in German is a plus to ensure alignment between DH’s German and English non-financial report disclosures.

title: Director of Product Management & Innovation
description:
Buckhorn, a Myers Industries Company (NYSE: MYE), an industry-leading manufacturer offering an extensive selection of reusable bulk boxes, hand-held containers and pallets designed to protect products, improve workflow, lower operating costs and increase profitability. Buckhorn provides superior custom capabilities that fit your precise applications.

Job Overview:

The Director, Product Management and Innovation is responsible for leading Buckhorn’s product strategy, innovation roadmap, and portfolio management for reusable packaging and material handling solutions. This role identifies market needs, translates customer and channel insights into product opportunities, and drives cross-functional execution from concept through commercialization. By aligning Buckhorn’s capabilities, customer-driven innovation, and end-market requirements, the position strengthens the portfolio, accelerates profitable growth, and advances Buckhorn’s leadership in reusable packaging systems across industrial, automotive, food, agriculture, and distribution applications.

Duties and Responsibilities

  • Product Strategy and Portfolio Leadership

◦ Lead Buckhorn’s product management strategy across reusable packaging and material handling solutions, including portfolio prioritization, lifecycle management, and roadmap development. ◦ Assess market trends, customer needs, application requirements, and competitive offerings to identify high-value innovation and product enhancement opportunities. ◦ Define strategic product priorities that align with Buckhorn’s growth objectives, manufacturing capabilities, and target end markets. ◦ Own portfolio performance by evaluating product profitability, market penetration, customer adoption, and opportunities for rationalization or expansion.

  • Innovation and New Product Development

◦ Drive Buckhorn’s innovation pipeline by converting customer insights, market intelligence, and emerging industry needs into actionable product concepts and development priorities. ◦ Partner with Engineering, Operations, and Technical teams to guide new product development from concept, validation, and testing through launch and commercialization. ◦ Champion customer-driven innovation that improves product performance, supply chain efficiency, sustainability, and application-specific value.

  • Commercialization and Go-to-Market Execution

◦ Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, and Commercial leaders to develop positioning, value propositions, launch plans, and pricing strategies for new and existing products. ◦ Support product launches, portfolio communication, and market adoption strategies that improve growth, margin, and customer retention. ◦ Translate technical product capabilities into compelling commercial strategies for Buckhorn’s core and adjacent end markets.

  • Cross-Functional Leadership and Execution

◦ Serve as the strategic link across Product Development, Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, Finance, and Commercial teams to align priorities, timelines, and execution. ◦ Lead decision-making related to product feasibility, investment, product changes, cost optimization, and launch readiness. ◦ Guide cross-functional teams through stage-gate or similar product development processes to ensure disciplined execution and business impact.

  • Market and Customer Insight Leadership

◦ Engage with customers, distributors, OEMs, and internal stakeholders to gather insights that shape product strategy, application development, and innovation priorities. ◦ Monitor industry trends, sustainability drivers, regulatory considerations, and competitive developments relevant to reusable packaging and material handling systems. ◦ Use customer feedback, voice-of-customer data, and market analysis to continuously strengthen Buckhorn’s product portfolio and differentiation.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Strong knowledge of product management principles, portfolio strategy, innovation processes, and lifecycle management within industrial or business-to-business manufacturing environments.
  • Deep understanding of reusable packaging systems, material handling products, and application requirements across industrial, automotive, food, agriculture, and distribution markets.
  • Ability to translate customer needs, market insights, and technical requirements into differentiated product strategies and innovation roadmaps.
  • Commercial acumen in pricing, margin analysis, market positioning, business case development, and go-to-market planning.
  • Working knowledge of injection molding, product development, manufacturing operations, and the technical considerations involved in scaling new products.
  • Strong analytical, strategic thinking, and problem-solving skills with the ability to prioritize high-impact opportunities.
  • Proven ability to lead and influence cross-functional teams and senior stakeholders in a matrixed environment.
  • Excellent communication, executive presentation, and customer engagement skills.
  • Ability to balance strategic innovation with operational feasibility, speed to market, and financial performance.

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Engineering, Supply Chain, or a related field; MBA or other advanced degree preferred.
  • 10+ years of progressive experience in product management, innovation, product development, strategic marketing, or related commercial leadership roles within industrial manufacturing or business-to-business environments.
  • Demonstrated experience leading product portfolios, innovation pipelines, and commercialization strategies for technically complex products.
  • Experience in reusable packaging, material handling, plastics, injection molding, or closely related industrial product categories strongly preferred.
  • Proven success working cross-functionally with Sales, Marketing, Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, and Finance to bring new products and portfolio improvements to market.
  • Experience using customer insights, market analysis, and financial evaluation to prioritize investments and drive profitable growth preferred.

Physical Requirements

  • While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to use hands and fingers to handle or feel objects.
  • The employee frequently is required to sit, stand, walk, reach with hands and arms, and talk or hear and will occasionally be required to bend, stoop, kneel and climb stairs.

Myers Industries, Inc. is an equal opportunity at will employer and does not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of age, race, religion, color, disability, sex, sexual orientation or national origin.

description:

The Opportunity :

Based in Hyderabad, join a global healthcare biopharma company and be part of a 130- year legacy of success backed by ethical integrity, forward momentum, and an inspiring mission to achieve new milestones in global healthcare.

Be part of an organisation driven by digital technology and data-backed approaches that support a diversified portfolio of prescription medicines, vaccines, and animal health products.

Drive innovation and execution excellence. Be a part of a team with passion for using data, analytics, and insights to drive decision-making, and which creates custom software, allowing us to tackle some of the world's greatest health threats.

Our Technology Centers focus on creating a space where teams can come together to deliver business solutions that save and improve lives. An integral part of our company’s IT operating model, Tech Centers are globally distributed locations where each IT division has employees to enable our digital transformation journey and drive business outcomes. These locations, in addition to the other sites, are essential to supporting our business and strategy.

A focused group of leaders in each Tech Center helps to ensure we can manage and improve each location, from investing in growth, success, and well-being of our people, to making sure colleagues from each IT division feel a sense of belonging to managing critical emergencies. And together, we must leverage the strength of our team to collaborate globally to optimize connections and share best practices across the Tech Centers.

Role Overview :

Evaluate the business impact of data quality, resolve domain data issues and inquiries, curate business metadata for discoverability, and monitor adherence to business rules. Partner with governance and downstream teams to prioritize remediation and ensure datasets are accurate, understandable, and fit for business use.

This position is based in our Hyderabad location, and we follow a hybrid work policy.

What will you do in this role:

Primary job responsibilities include:

  • Business Impact Monitoring and Prioritization

    • Assess how domain quality affects key outcomes (e.g., time-to-market, fulfillment accuracy, margin, regulatory compliance, customer experience).

    • Quantify impact using clear metrics and scorecards; prioritize remediation based on business value, risk, and urgency.

    • Communicate findings, trade-offs, and recommendations via concise reports and dashboards to product, supply chain, commercial, and finance stakeholders.

  • Issue Resolution and Business Inquiries

    • Investigate and resolve disputes related to domain definitions, ownership, lineage, and completeness/accuracy.

    • Manage intake and triage of ad hoc inquiries from business users; provide timely, well-documented responses with root-cause analysis and actions.

    • Drive cross-functional resolution through governance forums; maintain decision logs and track follow-ups to closure.

  • Business Metadata Cataloguing and Curation

    • Curate and maintain business metadata for datasets: context, definitions, descriptions, owners/stewards, usage notes, quality expectations, and authoritative sources.

    • Ensure datasets are discoverable and understandable in the enterprise catalog; keep entries current with versioning and change histories.

    • Align semantic definitions, classifications, and hierarchies with enterprise MDM standards and enterprise taxonomies.

  • Business Rule Adherence and Governance Collaboration

    • Collaborate with governance/capability teams to define, monitor, and report on product business rule application (validation rules, identifier standards, hierarchy integrity, versioning/variant rules).

    • Track violations and exceptions; coordinate remediation plans, waivers, and timelines with accountable owners.

    • Provide periodic compliance summaries and escalate systemic issues through governance channels.

  • Measurement, Reporting, and Continuous Improvement

    • Create and maintain dashboards for product domain health (data quality scores, rule adherence, issue backlog, time-to-resolution, business impact realized).

    • Identify trends and recurring issues; recommend improvements to data capture, processes, and controls (e.g., DQ rules, validations, workflow changes).

    • Update playbooks, FAQs, and guidance to reduce future inquiries and improve self-service and literacy.

Education Minimum Requirement:

Bachelor of Science (or equivalent) in Data Science, Computer Science, Management Information Systems, IT, MBA, or an equivalent scientific/commercial discipline within the pharmaceutical industry.

Required Experience and Skills:

  • Strong business acumen with a keen ability to understand how data can be leveraged to inform critical enterprise decisions and actions. (6+ years).

  • Proven ability to analyse and assess the value of data assets.

  • Proven potential to effectively collaborate with a broad range of internal and external stakeholders.

  • Intellectual curiosity and ability to identify innovative approaches to addressing data needs.

  • Excellent presentation, analytics, and communication skills, both written and oral, are required to synthesize key issues and communicate/persuade constituencies towards specific actions and initiatives.

  • Ability to operate in dynamic, transforming environment.

  • Strong experience in data management (Data analysis, Data architecture, Data Modelling)

  • Strong experience of SQL, AWS cloud services (S3, EC2, RDS, Redshift), Oracle RDBMS, JIRA, Git, Databricks

  • Strong organizational, time management and project management skills

  • Self-motivated, proactive, with ability to work independently with minimum direction.

What should you have:

  • Experience with data management (Data analysis, Data architecture, Data Modelling).

  • Experience with SQL, AWS cloud services (S3, EC2, RDS, Redshift), Oracle RDBMS, JIRA, Git, Databricks.

  • Ability to ensure datasets are discoverable and understandable in the enterprise catalog.

  • Exposure of maintaining AI ready datasets and applying AI tools in the governance of data.

Desired/Optional Technology Exposure:

  • Ability to work both independently and collaboratively within a geographically dispersed team

  • Ability to learn and use new technologies

  • Ability to manage through complexity and ambiguity along with competing priorities.

  • Experience defining & maintaining AI ready datasets and applying AI tools in the governance of data

  • Experience with data governance and data quality

  • Entrepreneurial spirit, motivated by uncovering new opportunities to add value to the organization.

Who we are:

We are in the United state Rahway, New Jersey, USA in the United States and Canada everywhere else. For more than a century, we have been inventing for lives, bringing forward medicines and vaccines for many of the world's most challenging diseases. Today, our company continues to be at the forefront of research to deliver innovative health solutions and advance the prevention and treatment of diseases that threaten people and animals around the world.

What we look for:

Imagine getting up in the morning for a job as important as helping to save and improve lives around the world. Here, you have that opportunity. You can put your empathy, creativity, digital mastery, or scientific genius to work in collaboration with a diverse group of colleagues who pursue and bring hope to countless people who are battling some of the most challenging diseases of our time. Our team is constantly evolving, so if you are among the intellectually curious, join us—and start making your impact today.
