title: Senior/Associate Planner
description:
Senior/Associate Planner

At Origin Enterprises, we are dedicated to championing sustainable land use, and our Environmental teams support a diverse range of clients and projects—from land management and development to restoration and conservation.

Joining us means becoming part of a collaborative, purpose driven community where this collective expertise enables us to deliver high quality, fully integrated solutions and contribute to meaningful environmental outcomes across the UK and Ireland.

About Neo

Neo Environmental is a multidisciplinary consultancy that provides market leading, cost-effective planning, environmental and technical solutions to clients working in the energy, residential, retail, utilities, mixed-use, aggregates and infrastructure sectors across the UK and Ireland.

We work closely with our clients throughout the duration of projects to ensure that we have a thorough understanding of their requirements and to achieve optimum designs.

Our team consists of experienced and accredited planners, engineers and multi-disciplinary environmental consultants, ensuring we provide a full suite of in-house collaborative services for projects.

We have an enviable track record for successfully consenting projects, whether small or complex, through our comprehensive understanding of planning requirements, particularly in the renewable energy industry.

The role will include:

Taking a lead role in managing small- to medium scale planning applications, overseeing all stages of the project, from preparation to submission, while coordinating work with Planning Consultants, Graduate Consultants, and Administrators.

In addition to leading smaller projects, supporting senior colleagues on larger, more

complex TCPA, DNS, and NSIP projects, carrying out tasks assigned by project leads.

Key Requirements:

  • Chartered Planner or Licentiate Planner working towards RTPI status
  • Strong to comprehensive understanding of the UK planning system and planning process.
  • Experience managing planning applications, including leading small- to medium-scale projects and supporting or leading major TCPA and DNS applications.
  • Ability to project manage applications from preparation through submission and delivery.
  • Experience coordinating, mentoring, and delegating work to consultants, graduates, and administrative staff.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision while recognising when senior input is required.
  • Proven ability to support or lead complex TCPA, DNS and NSIP planning projects.
  • Strong report-writing and communication skills, producing high-quality planning documentation and correspondence.
  • Ability to formulate planning strategies and identify key planning issues associated with development sites.
  • Confident stakeholder management skills, including attendance at or leadership of client, project and Local Planning Authority meetings.
  • Experience participating in or leading community engagement and consultation activities.
  • Strong presentation and public-speaking skills, including contributing to or chairing meetings and presenting to small audiences.
  • Ability to make sound project decisions and escalate significant issues where appropriate.
  • Established or developing professional network with a proactive approach to relationship building and business promotion.
  • Interest and involvement in business development activities, including identifying and supporting new business opportunities.
  • Excellent organisational, prioritisation and workload management skills.
  • Ability to delegate effectively, support junior colleagues and ensure high levels of team productivity.
  • Strong commercial awareness and ability to manage multiple workstreams simultaneously.
  • Team-focused approach with the ability to identify, communicate and resolve resourcing or workload issues.

Why work for us?

We offer a competitive and supportive rewards package designed to help you thrive both professionally and personally. This includes Life Assurance, access to our Employee Assistance Programme (EAP), and paid professional memberships such as CIEEM. We’re committed to continuous development, offering a blend of internal and external training opportunities to help you grow your skills and advance your career.

As part of our inclusive culture, you’ll have the opportunity to join our monthly Neurodiversity Café, take part in community action days, and benefit from our family friendly policies, including enhanced family leave options. While we value time spent together in our offices to collaborate and stay connected, most roles offer hybrid working and open conversations around flexibility.

You’ll also enjoy 25 days’ holiday, regular performance and development reviews, and the chance to collaborate across the wider Origin Group, especially within our growing family of Environmental businesses.

We actively encourage applications from all backgrounds and are proud to be building a diverse, inclusive team where everyone can grow, contribute and feel valued.

Visit our website to learn more — and grow with us.

The Program Delivery Lead serves as a key partner to the VP of Commercial & Government Specialty, AD, Strategy Advancement and senior leadership team, driving strategic alignment, executive communication, division operations, event support and business planning. This role blends high level strategic advisory with hands on execution, ensuring leadership is equipped with clear insights, compelling materials, and coordinated plans to effectively run and grow the business. This role will lead the strategic design and narrative direction of Commercial & Government Specialty ensuring all programs align with organizational priorities and business goals.

This role leads the development of executive materials including board presentations, strategy memos, and business reviews, while providing actionable insights through analysis of business performance, market trends, and competitive intelligence. Additionally, the Program Delivery Lead supports divisional meetings and events, facilitates cross functional collaboration, and serves as a trusted advisor to leadership to enable informed decision making and execution of key priorities.


Use your skills to make an impact

Key Responsibilities:

  • Executive Communications & Leadership Support
    • Lead the development of executive level communications and materials for the VP of Commercial & Government Specialty in coordination with the AD, Strategy Advancement and senior leaders, including Board presentations, Strategy memos, Weekly Updates, Monthly and quarterly business reviews (MBR/MOR), Executive briefings and rapid response materials
    • Ensure all content is clear, concise, and aligned to enterprise strategy and messaging.
    • Anticipate leadership needs and proactively prepare insights and materials for key discussions.
    • Provide perspective on risks, opportunities, and strategic choices to inform leadership decision making.
    • Drive organizational execution and accountability through effective business cadence management, including agenda development, follow up tracking, action planning, and facilitation of divisional, leadership, and offsite meetings to ensure alignment and decision making.
    • Act as a central coordination point to align priorities, messaging, and deliverables.
    • Prepare tailored materials and insights for a variety of leadership audiences and forums.
    • Coordinate business readiness efforts, ensuring stakeholders are informed, aligned, and equipped to execute against evolving priorities
  • Strategic Planning & Initiative Management – Government & Commercial Specialty
    • Partner with business management and strategy teams to coordinate:
      • Annual planning cycles
      • Goal setting and performance alignment
      • Strategic review processes
    • Track and monitor progress against KPIs, key strategic initiatives, identifying risks and ensuring accountability.
    • Deliver regular updates and report to leadership on initiative status and outcomes.
    • Use business intelligence and reporting tools to monitor, analyze and communicate performance indicators (KPIs).
    • Lead cross-functional business initiatives by coordinating execution across key partners (e.g., Network, Delivery COE, Underwriting, Finance, Compliance, HR, and Actuarial), ensuring deliverables align with strategic priorities, operational objectives, and timelines.
  • Division Operations & Event Support
    • Support planning and execution of divisional events, leadership meetings, and offsites.
    • Coordinate logistics with executive assistants and stakeholders, ensuring seamless execution and clear communication.
    • Serve as the business side counterpart to the event operations team, ensuring strategic alignment and seamless execution of events and programs.
    • Prepare materials and messaging to support effective leadership forums.
    • Work closely with executives, cross-functional partners, and content owners to craft compelling presentations and guide speakers in delivering clear, impactful messages.
  • Stakeholder Engagement & Cross-Functional Coordination across Government & Commercial Specialty.
    • Facilitate strong relationships between business leaders and key partners.
    • Act as a central coordination point to align priorities, messaging, and deliverables.
    • Prepare tailored materials and insights for a variety of leadership audiences and forums.
    • Coordinate business readiness efforts, ensuring stakeholders are informed, aligned, and equipped to execute against evolving priorities.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or Relevant experience
  • 6+ Years experience in Executive Communication, Operations and Event Planning
  • 2 or more years of project leadership experience
  • Strong knowledge of Microsoft Office XP products (Word, Excel, Powerpoint)
  • Excellent communication skills, both oral and written
  • Strong relationship building skills
  • Travel Necessary based on business needs

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master's Degree in Business Administration or a related field
  • PMP certification a plus
  • Six Sigma Certification also a plus
  • Demonstrated ability to analyze complex business problems and translate insights into actionable content recommendations.
  • Proven success partnering with senior leaders and subject matter experts to develop high impact presentations and messaging.
  • Strong facilitation skills, with the ability to guide teams toward clear objectives and cohesive content.
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate with event operations team to translate business goals into successful event experiences, including agenda development, logistics coordination, stakeholder management and execution oversight (including venue selection, planning, budget management, etc)
  • Experience designing content, agendas, and strategic narratives.
  • Ability to influence without authority and lead cross‑functional teams.
  • Experience identifying, developing, and coaching speakers or content owners.
  • Experience creating executive-level presentations in Microsoft PowerPoint, with the ability to effectively communicate complex information through compelling visuals and concise messaging tailored to leadership audiences.
  • Experience developing and utilizing interactive dashboards and reports using Microsoft Power BI or similar business intelligence platforms.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently with significant latitude in determining objectives and approaches

title: Debit Product Management - Product Manager, Vice President
description:
You enjoy shaping the future of product innovation as a core leader, driving value for customers, guiding successful launches, and exceeding expectations. Join our dynamic team and make a meaningful impact by delivering high-quality products that resonate with clients.

As a Product Manager within the Debit Product team, you are an integral part of the team that innovates new product offerings and leads the end-to-end product life cycle. As a core leader, you are responsible for acting as the voice of the customer and developing profitable products that provide customer value. Utilizing your deep understanding of how to get a product off the ground, you guide the successful launch of products, gather crucial feedback, and ensure top-tier client experiences. With a strong commitment to scalability, resiliency, and stability, you collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality products that exceed customer expectations.

The Debit Product is modernizing secure, seamless, future-ready debit experiences in the branch through a multi-year roadmap, partnering across LOBs to support key servicing and transaction activities (e.g., authentication, system access, communications, and forms). We’re seeking a Product Manager to lead end-to-end delivery of debit-focused authentication (biometrics, digital credentials, omni-channel) from discovery through launch, improving customer and employee journeys, driving operational efficiency across a 5,000-branch network, and adapting quickly while managing risk and changing priorities.

Job responsibilities

  • Develops a product strategy and product vision that delivers value to customers
  • Manages discovery efforts and market research to uncover customer solutions and integrate them into the product roadmap
  • Owns, maintains, and develops a product backlog that enables development to support the overall strategic roadmap and value proposition
  • Builds the framework and tracks the product's key success metrics such as cost, feature and functionality, risk posture, and reliability
  • Partners with technology and architecture teams to define secure, scalable solution designs and ensure alignment to enterprise standards
  • Leads end-to-end execution from concept to launch, including UAT readiness, go-to-market planning, and post-launch adoption measurement
  • Identifies operational and experience pain points across branch journeys and prioritizes enhancements that improve efficiency and reduce friction
  • Manages risks, dependencies, and trade-offs across stakeholders, ensuring timely decisions and clear communication of impacts
  • Establishes product requirements and acceptance criteria, translating customer needs into actionable user stories and epics

Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills

  • 5+ years of experience or equivalent expertise in product management or a relevant domain area
  • Advanced knowledge of the product development life cycle, design, and data analytics
  • Proven ability to lead product life cycle activities including discovery, ideation, strategic development, requirements definition, and value management
  • Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence outcomes across business, technology, operations, and control partners
  • Demonstrated ability to define, monitor, and act on KPIs/OKRs, using data to drive prioritization and continuous improvement
  • Experience delivering secure authentication or identity capabilities, with an understanding of risk, controls, and customer experience trade-offs
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to create clear narratives, roadmaps, and executive-ready updates

Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills

  • Demonstrated prior experience working in a highly matrixed, complex organization
  • Experience with branch, servicing, or frontline employee workflows and the operational realities of distributed networks
  • Experience partnering with cybersecurity, fraud, risk, and compliance teams to deliver solutions that meet control requirements
  • Track record of driving platform modernization or legacy migration efforts while maintaining stability and resiliency
  • Demonstrated ability to lead through ambiguity and manage competing priorities across a multi-year roadmap
  • Experience with agile delivery practices and tools (e.g., Scrum/Kanban, backlog hygiene, release planning)

Software Engineer



Control engineering and automation for advanced seed processing machinery and projects





Would you like to turn complex process requirements into reliable control solutions for innovative machinery? Seed Processing Holland is looking for an experienced Software Engineer who combines technical depth, analytical thinking and a practical approach from design through commissioning.


Company profile


Seed Processing Holland B.V. develops, designs and supplies machines and complete installations for the international seed processing and seed production industry. The company's solutions are used by leading seed companies worldwide and contribute to efficient, reliable and sustainable food production.



The headquarters are located in Enkhuizen, in the heart of Seed Valley and the Dutch seed industry. From here, Seed Processing Holland serves an international customer base together with regional offices in the USA, China and Vietnam and a worldwide network of specialised partners. The organisation combines specialist engineering with installation, training, service and maintenance throughout the lifetime of each installation.


The position


As Software Engineer, you will be responsible for the control engineering within technically challenging machine and project assignments. From the start of each order, your input will help define the controls and process approach, after which you will develop, test and support the software through to commissioning.



You will translate P&IDs, flow diagrams and project requirements into clear control descriptions, PLC programs and operator-panel applications. The role combines engineering work at the office with practical testing on machines and installations, giving you direct insight into the performance of the solutions you create.



You will also contribute your expertise during the quotation phase and support the service organisation with commissioning and fault resolution. Most of your work will be performed from Enkhuizen, with occasional travel to customer locations in the Netherlands and abroad.


The organisation


You will join Seed Processing Holland's multidisciplinary engineering organisation in Enkhuizen and work closely with colleagues in electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, project management, production and service. The environment is dynamic and technically diverse, with short lines of communication and a shared focus on delivering dependable solutions for customers worldwide.


Key responsibilities


	
Translating P&IDs, flow diagrams and project requirements into clear control descriptions as the basis for software development.

	
Programming PLC applications and operator/control panels for machines and complete seed-processing projects.

	
Loading, configuring and testing software on machines and installations before delivery.

	
Following projects from the initial design phase through testing, delivery and commissioning.

	
Providing controls and process input during the quotation phase for new machines and projects.

	
Supporting the service department during commissioning, including occasional assignments at customer sites in the Netherlands and abroad.

	
Analysing control-related malfunctions and helping the service organisation implement effective, lasting solutions.

	
Maintaining accurate technical documentation and ensuring that software and control solutions comply with applicable machine-safety requirements.



Professional profile


You operate at HBO level in Industrial Automation, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics or a comparable technical discipline and have substantial demonstrable experience in a similar software or control-engineering position.



The technical environment includes CODESYS, Reliance, Hitachi PLCs (EH-150 and EHV+), EXOR control panels, Invertek frequency converters, Eaton EASY control modules and Eplan. In addition, we expect that you:



	
have strong experience with PLC programming and the development of operator/control-panel applications.

	
understand related technologies such as drive systems and pneumatics and can apply this knowledge in integrated machine solutions.

	
are familiar with machine-safety standards, particularly at electrical and control-system level.

	
work accurately, analytically and in a structured manner and keep the required technical administration up to date.

	
communicate effectively in both Dutch and English and work well independently as well as within a multidisciplinary team.

	
are willing to travel occasionally for commissioning or troubleshooting assignments in the Netherlands and abroad.

	
have experience with Eplan and/or refrigeration installations; either will be considered an advantage.



Personal profile


You are solution-oriented and enjoy creating structure in complex technical challenges. You analyse processes carefully, identify the underlying issue and translate your findings into robust, maintainable software.



You take ownership of your work and combine precision with a pragmatic mindset. You communicate clearly with colleagues from different disciplines, share knowledge openly and remain focused when priorities change. Your curiosity and commitment to continuous improvement help both you and the organisation move forward.


What Seed Processing Holland offers


Seed Processing Holland offers a challenging position in a growing international machine-building company where software is central to the performance of every solution. You will have considerable scope to apply your expertise, contribute to varied projects and continue developing within a professional and collegial working environment.



	
Technically challenging automation projects from design through commissioning.

	
The opportunity to work with advanced machinery and integrated seed-processing installations.

	
Close cooperation with experienced colleagues across several engineering disciplines.

	
Plenty of room for professional growth, initiative and personal development.

	
A positive working atmosphere built on collegiality, cooperation and shared responsibility.



Terms of employment


This is a full-time position based at Seed Processing Holland in Enkhuizen, with occasional travel in the Netherlands and abroad. The company offers good working conditions and a salary in accordance with the Dutch Metal & Technology collective labour agreement. The final terms will reflect your qualifications and experience.


Interested?


If this control-engineering position matches your experience and ambitions, we look forward to receiving your CV and application. Please quote reference 2486.



If you have any questions, please contact Jørn Ravn at +45 2483 6084 or email jra@F10.dk.



Learn more at www.seedprocessing.com

title: 1775 RPG/AS400 & JD Edwards EnterpriseOne Developer
description:
This is a remote position.

We are looking for a professional with hands-on experience developing in RPG/RPGLE on IBM AS400/iSeries, as well as proven experience with JD Edwards EnterpriseOne development tools.

We are not looking for an infrastructure administrator, a JD Edwards functional consultant, or an AS400 developer without JD Edwards experience. The ideal candidate must be able to work technically across both platforms, troubleshoot production issues, modify existing customizations, and participate in system integrations.

Responsibilities

  • Develop, modify, debug, and maintain RPG, RPGLE, and CL programs on IBM AS400/iSeries.

  • Analyze and resolve technical issues, performance problems, and production incidents.

  • Develop, customize, and support JD Edwards EnterpriseOne solutions.

  • Work with JD Edwards modules such as Financials, Inventory, Distribution, Procurement, and Manufacturing.

  • Develop and modify JD Edwards components, including:

    • Business Functions

    • UBEs (Batch Reports)

    • Named Event Rules (NERs)

    • Table Conversions

    • Business Views

  • Use Object Management Workbench (OMW) to manage development objects and lifecycle processes.

  • Design and maintain SQL queries, stored procedures, and data processes using DB2.

  • Implement integrations between JD Edwards and external applications through APIs, EDI, flat files, and other data exchange mechanisms.

  • Provide technical and functional support to internal users.

  • Participate in JD Edwards upgrades, ESU installations, patch deployments, and system enhancements.

  • Prepare technical documentation, development specifications, and support procedures.

  • Maintain source code and technical objects following development best practices and coding standards.

  • Collaborate with functional teams, infrastructure teams, and business users to identify, analyze, and resolve operational needs.

Requisitos

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum of 3 years of professional experience developing on IBM AS400/iSeries.

  • Proven hands-on experience with:

    • RPG

    • RPGLE

    • CL

    • IBM AS400/iSeries

  • Practical experience developing, supporting, or customizing JD Edwards EnterpriseOne.

  • Strong knowledge of JD Edwards development tools, including:

    • Object Management Workbench (OMW)

    • Business View Design

    • UBE Design

    • Business Functions

    • Named Event Rules (NERs)

    • Table Conversions

  • Experience working with SQL and DB2.

  • Experience troubleshooting production issues and supporting live enterprise systems.

  • Ability to analyze technical requirements and translate them into effective business solutions.

  • English proficiency at a minimum B2 level, with the ability to participate in meetings, understand technical documentation, and communicate effectively with international teams.

description:
Business Controller til international vækstvirksomhed - Precision Technic Defence Group, Svenstrup - Hviid & Larsen
        
        
        
        

        
        

        

        
        
        
        
        
        
        

        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        

        

        

        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
    
    
            
        

    

                    
            
        Hviid & Larsen
    


Business Controller til international vækstvirksomhed - Precision Technic Defence Group, Svenstrup

            
    


    

        
        

            
Bliv en nøglespiller tæt på forretningen, ledelsen og de strategiske beslutninger

Har du erfaring inden for controlling eller finance, og motiveres du af at omsætte tal til indsigter, der skaber værdi for forretningen?

Precision Technic Defence Group søger en ambitiøs og forretningsorienteret Business Controller, som ønsker at tage næste skridt i karrieren.

Du bliver en del af Group Finance og refererer direkte til Group CFO. Her får du en central rolle i den økonomiske styring af en international koncern med aktiviteter i Danmark, Storbritannien, USA, Sverige og Australien.

Vi leder efter en person, som er nysgerrig, stiller spørgsmål til tallene og kan omsætte data til den historie, der hjælper ledelsen med at træffe bedre beslutninger.

Om stillingen

Som Business Controller får du en bred rolle med stor kontaktflade på tværs af organisationen. Du kommer tæt på både ledelsen og den daglige forretning og bliver en vigtig sparringspartner i arbejdet med at skabe indsigt, overblik og retning.

Du vil arbejde med rapportering, analyser, budgetter og forecasts, men lige så vigtigt bliver det, at du forstår forretningen bag tallene og formår at formidle dine konklusioner på en måde, der skaber handling.

Stillingen indebærer samarbejde med kolleger og ledere på tværs af landegrænser, og der må forventes en vis rejseaktivitet til koncernens lokationer.

Dine ansvarsområder

Drive og videreudvikle koncernens ledelsesrapportering

Udarbejde analyser af omsætning, marginer, indtjening og forretningsperformance

Deltage i budget-, forecast- og planlægningsprocesser

Identificere økonomiske risici og forretningsmæssige muligheder

Udvikle og følge op på KPI'er og ledelsesinformation

Sparre med ledere omkring økonomi, performance og beslutningsgrundlag

Udarbejde business cases og investeringsanalyser

Bidrage til optimering af processer, datakvalitet og rapporteringsværktøjer

Deltage i tværgående strategiske projekter og udviklingsinitiativer

Udarbejde ad hoc-analyser til ledelse og forretning

Hvem er du?

Vi forestiller os, at du har erfaring fra en rolle som Business Controller, Financial Controller, Finance Business Partner eller lignende.

Derudover ser vi gerne, at du:

Har en relevant økonomisk uddannelse, f.eks. cand.merc., HD(R), cand.oecon. eller tilsvarende

Har stærke analytiske kompetencer og interesse for data

Arbejder sikkert i Excel og har erfaring med ERP- og BI-systemer

Kan kommunikere komplekse økonomiske sammenhænge på en enkel og forståelig måde

Behersker dansk og engelsk på højt niveau

Trives i et internationalt miljø med mange interessenter

Vi lægger særligt vægt på, at du

Er nysgerrig og interesserer dig for, hvad der ligger bag tallene

Kan omsætte data til indsigter og konkrete anbefalinger

Har mod til at stille spørgsmål og udfordre eksisterende antagelser

Er forretningsorienteret og opsøgende

Tager ansvar og følger opgaver helt til dørs

Skaber gode relationer på tværs af organisationer, funktioner og kulturer

Trives i en dynamisk hverdag, hvor opgaver og prioriteter kan ændre sig hurtigt

Vi tilbyder

En central rolle med stor synlighed i organisationen

Tæt samarbejde med Group CFO og den internationale ledelse

Mulighed for at påvirke beslutninger og udviklingen af forretningen

Internationale kontaktflader og rejseaktivitet

Gode muligheder for både faglig og personlig udvikling

En virksomhed med korte beslutningsveje, høj faglighed og store ambitioner

Hos Precision Technic Defence bliver du en del af en arbejdsplads med et stærkt sammenhold og en uformel, åben kultur, hvor man hjælper hinanden og løfter i fællesskab. Du får en varieret hverdag med stor grad af selvstændighed samt gode ansættelsesvilkår, herunder en attraktiv lønpakke, pension, sundhedsforsikring og adgang til både kantineordning og fitness.

Sikkerhed

Stillingen kræver, at du kan sikkerhedsgodkendes.

Om Precision Technic Defence Group

Precision Technic Defence Group er en international forsvars- og sikkerhedsvirksomhed med hovedsæde i Danmark. Koncernen leverer avancerede produkter, systemløsninger og services til forsvars-, sikkerheds- og myndighedsorganisationer verden over.

Virksomheden er i fortsat udvikling og vækst, og du bliver en del af en organisation, hvor kvalitet, troværdighed og stærke relationer er fundamentet for succes.

Er du klar til næste skridt?

Hviid & Larsen står for screeningen af alle ansøgninger. Har du spørgsmål, er du velkommen til at kontakte Direktør Anna Larsen på 22 32 72 32.

Ansøgninger behandles fortroligt, og stillingsopslaget tages ned, når den rette kandidat er fundet.

title: Mental Health Professional - Russia (Chat & Video Therapy Professional)
description:
About us

ifeel is a mental health and well-being platform designed to provide users with tools, resources, and support for emotional and psychological well-being.

We aim to improve access to mental health care through a combination of technology and professional psychological support. Our platform offers personalised therapy solutions, including chat and video therapy, self-care tools, and data-driven diagnostic systems to help users identify mental health issues and connect with appropriate resources.

With a diverse global network of licensed mental health professionals, we have supported over 1 million people across 50 countries. Trusted by top companies like Glovo, Axa Partners, Cabify, and H&M, we are dedicated to making mental health care accessible and impactful for both individuals and organizations around the world.

Make a Difference with ifeel

As a collaborator, you will have the unique opportunity to impact individuals’ lives positively. You’re not just joining a team; you’re becoming part of a supportive community that values well-being and personal growth.

We are committed to fostering a culture where mental health is prioritised and openly discussed!

Behind the scenes, our dedicated triage team welcomes every new user and ensures they are paired with the right professional based on their individual needs and preferences. This personalised approach allows you to focus on what you do best—providing quality care—while we handle the logistics of client matching.

Ready to take the next step in your professional journey? Join us at ifeel and become a vital part of a platform dedicated to advancing mental well-being for all.

Your role as a Mental Health Professional - Russia (Chat Therapy Professional) is essential in offering timely and effective support through chat therapy, enabling individuals to navigate their mental health challenges in a confidential and supportive way.

Responsibilities

As a collaborating mental helath professional at ifeel, you will support patients through two complementary modalities:

  • Text therapy: asynchronous written exchanges, allowing continuous and flexible monitoring.
  • Video sessions: videoconference consultations lasting 40 minutes, planned according to your availability.

  • Engage with patients to continue the therapeutic process, encouraging progress and commitment.
  • Create a safe and trusting environment for clients to express their thoughts and feelings.
  • Utilize effective therapeutic techniques to guide clients towards resolution and coping strategies.
  • Maintain detailed records of client interactions and therapeutic progress.
  • Work collaboratively with a multidisciplinary team to improve overall client care.
  • Engage in ongoing training and professional development initiatives.

Requirements

  • Master's degree in Psychology, Social Work, or a related field.
  • Licensed or accredited to provide chat or online therapy in Russia.
  • Experience in providing therapeutic services in a chat or text-based format (desirable).
  • Strong written communication skills and ability to convey empathy through text.
  • Familiarity with mental health best practices and interventions.
  • Proficient in using video - chat platforms and digital communication tools.
  • Fluency in Russian and English; proficiency in additional languages is a plus.
  • Availability to reply to client’s messages every day.

Benefits

  • Cutting-edge E-Therapy Platform: Utilise advanced online therapy tools to assist clients effectively.
  • Simplified Client Management: Focus solely on your clients' needs without the burden or the cost of marketing fees and websites. We send clients your way at no extra expense.
  • Flexible Remote Work: Enjoy the freedom to choose your own schedule and work location.
  • Fair Payment per Session: Receive payments for each session conducted, ensuring fair compensation for your valuable skills.
  • Continuous Learning and Support: Access regular training and support to enhance your abilities and grow in your profession.
  • Global Community: Engage with a diverse community of professionals worldwide, fostering collaboration and mutual support.
  • Meaningful Impact: Make a real difference in a rapidly expanding environment.

We highly appreciate your interest. ifeel is an equal opportunity employer: all applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status. Please keep in mind that due to the high volume of applications, we will notify shortlisted candidates only.

The information you share with us will be treated confidentially and used exclusively for evaluation and selection purposes. Your resume and other related documentation, following the applicable regulation, will be stored during the recruitment process and will be deleted within two (2) years from the conclusion of the process unless otherwise agreed. By submitting your application, you agree to the processing of your data in connection with this recruitment process.

title: Intern
description:
MindKey Recruiting


    


    



        
    

	
Fagansvarlig for Service Desk og IT-serviceleverancer
Vil du være med til at styrke kommunens interne IT-support og være med til at udvikle den måde, vi leverer IT-service på?

Kommuneqarfik Sermersooq er i gang med at styrke IT og Digitalisering. Vi ønsker mere intern viden, tydeligere arbejdsgange og en mere sammenhængende support for kommunens medarbejdere.

Derfor søger vi en fagansvarlig for Service Desk og IT-serviceleverancer.

Stillingen er for dig, der har solid erfaring med IT-support og Service Desk, og som har lyst til at tage et selvstændigt fagligt ansvar for, hvordan supporten fungerer og udvikles.

Du bliver en del af IT og Digitalisering og får en central rolle i opbygningen af kommunens interne Service Desk og 1st line-support.




Om stillingen:

Som fagansvarlig får du det faglige ejerskab for kommunens Service Desk, herunder arbejdsgange og processer omkring 1st line-support og den tværgående håndtering af IT-servicehenvendelser.

Du skal sikre, at der er klare og ensartede arbejdsgange for registrering, prioritering, eskalering, opfølgning og dokumentation, og at supporten arbejder efter fælles faglige standarder.

En vigtig del af stillingen bliver også at opbygge og fastholde intern viden. Løsninger, vejledninger og erfaringer skal dokumenteres og deles, så vigtig viden ikke kun ligger hos den enkelte medarbejder.

Du får en fagligt koordinerende rolle i supportteamet og bliver en central sparringspartner for kollegerne. Samtidig får du en tværgående rolle mellem Service Desk, øvrige IT-funktioner, systemansvarlige og eksterne leverandører.




Dine opgaver:

Du får ansvar for at udvikle og vedligeholde de fælles arbejdsgange, standarder og procedurer for Service Desk og 1st line-support og for at følge op på kvaliteten i den daglige supportleverance.

Du skal sikre tydelige prioriterings- og eskaleringsveje og koordinere sager, der går på tværs af supporten, andre IT-funktioner og eksterne leverandører. Ved større, kritiske eller komplekse sager skal du sikre, at sagen bliver prioriteret, koordineret og håndteret på rette niveau.

Du får også ansvar for at opbygge og vedligeholde en fælles vidensbase, vejledninger og standardsvar og for at understøtte faglig sparring, oplæring og vidensdeling i supportteamet.

Derudover skal du udvikle og vedligeholde arbejdsgange omkring blandt andet brugeradgange, onboarding og offboarding, udstyr og øvrige servicebestillinger, der hører til Service Desk.

Du skal følge op på tilbagevendende fejl, uhensigtsmæssige arbejdsgange og andre forbedringsbehov og bruge erfaringerne fra den daglige support til at forbedre kvaliteten og den samlede serviceleverance.

En del af rollen er også at følge op på samarbejdet med eksterne leverandører og være med til at sikre, at aftalte opgaver bliver fulgt til dørs, og at der er tydelige snitflader mellem intern support og eksterne samarbejdspartnere.

Stillingen vil udvikle sig i takt med, at kommunen opbygger flere interne IT-kompetencer og gradvist overtager flere opgaver.




Fagligt ansvar:

Stillingen er uden personaleansvar, men med et selvstændigt og tværgående fagligt ansvar for Service Desk og IT-serviceleverancer.

Du får ansvar for at fastlægge og vedligeholde de faglige standarder og procedurer for området og for at sikre, at de bliver anvendt i den daglige support.

Du kan inden for de fastlagte organisatoriske rammer prioritere og eskalere supportsager, stille krav til dokumentation og kvalitet og koordinere den faglige opgaveløsning mellem supportteamet, øvrige IT-funktioner og eksterne leverandører.

Du skal samtidig følge udviklingen i supportleverancen og kunne identificere behov for ændringer i arbejdsgange, værktøjer og serviceydelser og komme med anbefalinger til afdelingsledelsen.




Vi forestiller os, at du:

Vi forestiller os, at du har minimum 6 års relevant erfaring inden for IT-support, Service Desk eller et tilsvarende område.

Du har en solid praktisk forståelse for IT-support og brugerunderstøttelse og har samtidig erfaring med at skabe struktur, koordinere opgaver og udvikle arbejdsgange omkring supporten.

Du har erfaring med ticketsystemer, dokumentation og struktureret håndtering af supportsager og forstår betydningen af tydelige prioriterings- og eskaleringsveje.

Du kan arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar for et fagligt område. Samtidig deler du gerne din viden og trives med at sparre med og hjælpe kolleger.

Det er en fordel, hvis du har erfaring fra en større organisation eller offentlig administration.

Det vigtigste er, at du har stærk erfaring med IT-support, kan skabe struktur og overblik og har lyst til at være med til at opbygge og udvikle en professionel intern supportfunktion.




Vi tilbyder:

Vi tilbyder en stilling, hvor du får mulighed for at få reel indflydelse på kommunens fremtidige IT-support.

Du bliver en del af IT og Digitalisering og får en vigtig rolle i opbygningen af kommunens Service Desk og 1st line-support.

Du får mulighed for at præge de faglige arbejdsgange og standarder, supporten skal arbejde efter, og være med til at opbygge mere intern viden, bedre dokumentation og en mere ensartet IT-service.

Du får en bred kontaktflade og kommer til at samarbejde tæt med kolleger, ledelse, medarbejdere, systemansvarlige og eksterne samarbejdspartnere.




Om dig som person:

Du trives med ansvar og med at skabe struktur, hvor der er brug for det.

Du er fagligt stærk, men har samtidig en praktisk forståelse for den hverdag, både supportmedarbejdere og brugere står i.

Du kan skabe overblik og træffe faglige beslutninger, også når der er mange forskellige hensyn.

Du deler gerne din viden og bidrager til, at teamet arbejder efter fælles principper og løfter opgaverne sammen.

Du kan sige tingene klart, men gør det med respekt for dem, du samarbejder med.

Du har lyst til at være med til at bygge noget op og kan se værdien i, at god IT-support, tydelige arbejdsgange og fælles dokumentation gør hverdagen lettere for hele organisationen.

Er du dobbeltsproget på grønlandsk og dansk, er det en fordel, men ikke et krav.




Yderligere oplysninger fås hos:
Såfremt stillingen har din interesse, er du velkommen til at tage kontakt for uddybende oplysninger om stillingen og tilhørende arbejdsopgaver til afdelingsleder Ivalo Hansen Brandt, tlf. +299 367312 eller e-mail: ks89ivbr@sermersooq.gl 




Straffeattest:
Denne stilling er omfattet af lov om pligt til at indhente straffeattest. I henhold til loven kan ansættelsen først begynde, når kommunen har modtaget en straffeattest. Vi skal derfor gøre opmærksom på, at tiltrædelsestidspunktet først kan aftales, når kommunen har modtaget straffeattesten fra Politiet.




Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår:
Løn- og ansættelsesforhold sker i henhold til gældende overenskomst mellem Grønlands Selvstyre, i henhold til den på tiltrædelsestidspunktet gældende aftale/overenskomst mellem Grønlands Selvstyre og pågældende forhandlingsberettigede organisation.

Ansættelsen vil ske med 3 måneders prøvetid.




Bolig: 
Der kan ikke anvises personalebolig til stillingen. 




Ansøgning:
Ansøgning mærket med Job nr. 723-26, og vedlagt uddannelsesbevis og dokumentation for tidligere beskæftigelse m.v. skal være uploadede inden fristens udløb.




Sådan søger du:
Ansøgninger skal sendes elektronisk, via link nederst på denne side, hvor du kan vedhæfte din ansøgning og CV.




Bemærk:
Vi modtager ikke ansøgninger i papir eller mails, send venligst din ansøgning elektronisk ved stillingsopslaget.

title: Investment Services Relationship Team Administrator

Thank you for your interest in a career at Regions. At Regions, we believe associates deserve more than just a job. We believe in offering performance-driven individuals a place where they can build a career --- a place to expect more opportunities. If you are focused on results, dedicated to quality, strength and integrity, and possess the drive to succeed, then we are your employer of choice.

Regions is dedicated to taking appropriate steps to safeguard and protect private and personally identifiable information you submit. The information that you submit will be collected and reviewed by associates, consultants, and vendors of Regions in order to evaluate your qualifications and experience for job opportunities and will not be used for marketing purposes, sold, or shared outside of Regions unless required by law. Such information will be stored in accordance with regulatory requirements and in conjunction with Regions’ Retention Schedule for a minimum of three years. You may review, modify, or update your information by visiting and logging into the careers section of the system.

Job Description:

At Regions, the Investment Services Relationship Team Administrator (RTA) leads the area’s Wealth Relationship Specialists, Trust Relationship Specialists, or Sales Assistants to ensure quality service to internal partners and clients. This role has direct management responsibility for support staff and may also directly support members of the advisor team.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Provides leadership, coaching, and training to Wealth Relationship Specialists, Trust Relationship Specialists, or Sales Assistants, serving as the dedicated subject matter expert on policies and procedures for business group systems and transactions

  • Understands client needs and identifies opportunities to improve and resolve client service issues

  • Coaches associates to identify expansion opportunities within existing relationships and/or identify knowledge gaps

  • Disseminates pertinent information to support team, ensuring consistency

  • Assists the team with resolving complex client issues

  • Completes and processes administrative documents for the department

  • Monitors departmental compliance training

  • Monitors risk and compliance on various client transaction activity

  • Supports the business, as needed, with other administrative duties such as the onboarding of new associates, training, complex reporting, and other duties as assigned

  • Travels, as needed, to support the assigned area market

  • May perform general management duties, in partnership with business leadership and Human Resources, exercising usual authority concerning staffing, performance evaluations, promotions, and terminations

This position is exempt from timekeeping requirements under the Fair Labor Standards Act and is not eligible for overtime pay.

Requirements

  • High School Diploma or GED

  • Five (5) years of experience in a related field

Preferences

  • College degree or technical school certification

Skills and Competencies

  • Ability to supervise and manage a team

  • Ability to work well under pressure and meet deadlines

  • Demonstrated leadership capabilities

  • Excellent customer service skills

  • Strong organizational skills

  • Strong relationship-building capabilities

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills

This role will lead a team of Sales Assistants within our Investment Services Group. Occasional travel will be required. Onsite expectations will be out of our office in Hoover, AL.

Highly Preferred

  • High School Diploma or GED with five (5) years of bank brokerage experience
  • Or Bachelor’s degree in a related field with one (1) year of bank brokerage experience
  • Financial Industry Regulatory Authority (FINRA) Series 7, 63, and 65 or 66 (1 year to achieve)
  • Life Insurance License (1 year to achieve)

Full time

As these factors vary by individuals, pay will also vary among individual associates within the same job.

title: Chaufføransøgning til Jylland/Fyn hos Dansk Auto Logik A/S
description:
Chaufføransøgning til Jylland/Fyn hos Dansk Auto Logik A/S




































































































Chauffør til teamet vest for Storebælt 




Vi har i alt 170 dygtige chauffører, der hver dag leverer hundredevis af fabriksnye og brugte biler ud til vores kunder i hele landet. Drømmer du om at være en del af et dynamisk team, hvor hverdagen aldrig er ens, så har vi den perfekte mulighed for dig.




Om stillingen
Du er ansvarlig for at transportere biler ud til vores kunder i hele landet, og du planlægger selv dine ruter og læs på optimal vis ud fra de tildelte ture. Du er vores ansigt udadtil, og du sikrer, at vores kunder altid får en god oplevelse, når du kommer på besøg. De fleste i vores vest-team kører ud fra Vamdrup og kommer hjem hver dag, men nogen ligger også ude i løbet af ugen, eller kører ud fra andre mindre lokationer. Anfør det gerne i bemærkningsfeltet, hvis du har særlige ønsker. 




Om dig

Det er ikke et krav, at du har erfaring med autotransport - vi hjælper med en grundig oplæring. Vi foretrækker dog, at du har min. 2-3 års erfaring med distributionskørsel med stor lastbil, da det er krævende og udfordrende i sig selv at lære at læsse en autotransporter. Du har C/E-kørekort, førerkort og EU-bevis. Du kan kommunikere på dansk, og du udstyret med et smil på læben. Det er vigtigt, at du er robust og udholdende, og at du kan bevare roen i pressede situationer. Hvis du samtidig er kvalitets- og ansvarsbevidst og sætter en ære i at yde en fantastisk service, så er det helt perfekt!




Vi tilbyder

Du får en masse hjælpsomme kolleger, hvoraf mange har høj anciennitet i firmaet. Der er en høj grad af frihed, en varieret arbejdsdag og masser af udfordringer. Hvis du ovenikøbet er typen, der er lidt tosset med biler, så er vi den helt rigtige arbejdsplads:) Vi værdsætter desuden mangfoldighed og fællesskab på kryds og tværs, og vi mødes jævnligt til festlige lejligheder. 




Vi tilbyder god løn med pension, særlig opsparing samt et tillæg, der ligger ud over den overenskomstmæssige løn (3F/ATL overenskomsten). Vi udstyrer dig med en flot arbejdstøjspakke og betaler en sundhedsforsikring efter 3 måneders ansættelse.




Du er også meget velkommen til af kontakte vores afdelingschef for chauffører, Lars Uglebjerg på 66468379 eller laug@autologik.dk




Hvis du er interesseret i at komme med på Danmarks stærkeste team inden for autotransport, så send dit CV via linket her i opslaget. Ønsker du at medsende en kort ansøgning, er du naturligvis også velkommen til det.




Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig :)











































































Kontaktinformationer


Auto Logik i Vamdrup


Koldingvej 10


6580 Vamdrup


Danmark 




















Dansk Auto Logik A/S er Danmarks største inden for billogistik. Vi har afdelinger i Vamdrup og Ringsted. Vi varetager desuden også biltransport i Tyskland og Sverige. 



































































Om Dansk Auto Logik A/S

Dansk Auto Logik beskæftiger ca. 300 medarbejdere og tilbyder gode og velordnede arbejdsforhold. Aktivitetsniveauet er højt, og omgangstonen er uformel. Vi er en meget serviceminded organisation, og har altid kunden og kvalitet i fokus.     

Ved rekruttering til stillinger med særligt fokus på kunde- og samarbejdsrelationer kan det være relevant, at vi foretager en søgning på de sociale medier. Vi anvender interesseafvejningsreglen i databeskyttelsesforordningens art. 6 (1) (f) som hjemmel til at indhente oplysninger om kandidater fra sociale medier. Vi gør det for at kunne vurdere, om du har en profil, der passer ind i virksomheden og i den konkrete stilling.

Vi gemmer uopfordrede ansøgninger i 6 måneder, og de behandles naturligvis dybt fortroligt. Hvis du ønsker din ansøgning slettet inden udgangen af 6 måneder, skal du tage kontakt til HR-chef Rikke Barlow.

title: Bilingual Director Operations- China, Taiwan, Hong Kong & Macao
description:

This role provides leadership to the regional Operations team as well as the Franchise Groups in China and Taiwan to achieve short and long-term business unit and functional objectives.   • Provide strategic direction and leadership for Operations. Identify, champion and lead franchisees on emerging operating trends, applying next generation equipment and technology. Lead operations strategy to deliver high return on investment operating models that support long term labor efficiency, reduce operating overheads and a compelling and differentiated on premise, off premise and digital Consumer experience.

  • B.A. or B.S. Degree in Business or related field, MBA preferred, or related experience in lieu of degree
  • Must have at least 10 years of progressively responsible experience preferably in Operations, Marketing or related field in QSR, Fast Casual or Full-Service restaurant(s).

Skills:

Inclusion & Belonging

We are committed to creating a culture of inclusion and belonging for all who touch DQ. We believe in and commit to fostering a community where employees bring their authentic selves to work, and where we recruit, engage, and retain employees, franchise owners, and suppliers based on qualifications and merit. We strive to maintain an environment where everyone feels welcome.

Since 1940, Dairy Queen® has been one of the world’s best known and loved brands. As a leading franchisor, there are more than 7,000 independently owned and operated restaurants in the U.S., Canada and more than 20 countries around the world.   • 15+ years' of combined experience in aircraft design and/or project management, GN&C, flight testing, systems engineering and program management

  • Has a comprehensive knowledge of engineering disciplines and prior experience leading the development of many of these systems for manned or unmanned air vehicles: Autopilot hardware and software; Flight control hardware and software; Part 23 & part 27 aircraft certification; Ground control communications hardware and software; Ground control support equipment; Air vehicle subsystems integration & test; Air vehicle systems communications hardware and software; High voltage electrical power systems

  • Travel within the continental U.S. is required to support flight test operations (up to 20%)

Other Qualifications & Desired Competencies

  • PhD is preferred

  • Demonstrates knowledge of office software and computer based productivity tools. Demonstrates expertise in engineering processes and design tools

  • Expertise in appropriate design and simulation tools and validation techniques

  • Demonstrates strong communication (verbal & written), presentation and collaboration skills

  • Is a proven leader who has demonstrated people development and leadership skills

  • Able to excel in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment, where small teams share a broad variety of duties

  • Displays strong initiative and drive to accomplish goals and meet company objectives

  • Takes ownership and responsibility for current and past work products

  • Is committed to learning from mistakes and driven to improve and enhance performance of oneself, others, and the company

  • Demonstrates effective problem-solving, analytical and interpersonal skills with the ability to work well across disciplines. Focuses on teamwork, collaboration and puts the success of the team above one's own interests

  • Ability to work in an office and R&D environment (Constant)

No Clearance

Ønsker du at blive en del af et velfungerende team, søger Mammen Mejerierne nu endnu en dygtig pakkerimedarbejder til vores pakkeri i Klovborg. Her indgår du i et team af ca. 20 dedikerede medarbejder, der hver dag passer 3 forskellige pakkelinjer, og dermed er med til at levere det bedste produkt til den aftalte tid.


Stort medansvar og levering til tiden


Hos os går kvalitet, åbenhed og respekt hånd i hånd. Du vil få et stort medansvar for, at processerne kører optimalt og at kvaliteten til enhver tid lever op til vores høje standarder.


Din baggrund og kvalifikationer


Din uddannelsesmæssige baggrund er ikke afgørende, men det vil være en fordel, hvis du har erfaring indenfor lignende stilling og har arbejdet med fødevareproduktion.



Vi lægger specielt vægt på, at du;




Er ansvarsbevidst og pålidelig


Er mødestabil


Har et godt overblik i pressede situationer


Har en positiv indstilling og bidrager til et godt arbejdsmiljø



Vi tilbyder


En fast stilling på 37 timer, hvor arbejdstiderne kan skifte mellem daghold (kl. 06-14), rengøring (kl. 08-16) og eftermiddag (kl. 14-23.45). Du kender altid din arbejdstid min. 6 uger frem. Ansættelse efter Mejeribranchens Fællesoverenskomst.


Ansøgning


Send dit CV hurtigst muligt via QuickApply-knappen "Ansøg".



Eventuelle spørgsmål kan rettes til Pakkerileder Jacob Jensen på jacob.jensen@mammenost.dk.



Tiltrædelse hurtigst muligt og ansøgningerne behandles løbende, indtil rette person er fundet.


Om Mammen Mejerierne


Mammen Mejerierne er en dansk, familieejet mejerivirksomhed, der startede i 1953. I dag er Mammen Mejerierne Danmarks næststørste mejeri målt på indvejet mælk og omsætter for over 2 mia. kr. Koncernen har hovedkontor i Mammen nær Bjerringbro og har bl.a. produktion på mejerierne i Mammen, Drøsbro og Onsild. Vi afhenter mælk fra ca. 75 landbrug i vores nærområde og producerer hvide, gule og blåskimmeloste, samt friskost og forskellige specialoste. I Danmark sælges ostene til landsdækkende supermarkedskæder og grossister. Herudover eksporterer vi til kunder i ca. 60 lande verden over.

title: Senior BIM Engineer - Mechanical (FI)
description:
Incumbent will be the part of WSP in India – Finland MEP Team (P&B). He/she will be responsible to carryout the mechanical services engineering designs for various building projects, as on required. Work with other engineers and perform calculations in coordination with our Finland/India engineers.

Technical
• Focus on the delivery of high-quality technical design drawings and specifications to the required regulations
• Develop the technical capabilities of the team
• Contribute to technical solutions on projects
• Initiate and participate in design peer reviews
• Ensure internal quality procedures are followed
• Keep up to date with industry developments with respect to own discipline and appreciate the basic technical principles and drivers of other disciplines
• Assist and support mentorship for junior engineers within the team
• Attending project meetings with the various other teams in India

Manage project delivery and leadership
• To act as project manager (PM) on selected projects by managing the successful delivery of high quality multi and single disciplinary projects
• Design, review and deliver high quality technical mechanical services engineering designs, drawings, specifications, and reports to the required regulations.
• In conjunction with team lead in India and lead country identify, assess, and manage project risks and secure the best commercial return from the project.
• To ensure statutory and regulatory requirements are met.
• Ensure project programs are met and advise on any foreseen delays
• Participate and support internal multi-discipline knowledge sharing initiatives.
• Identify and flag additional fees to the local CRC Head of MEP

Key Competencies / Skills:
Mandatory Skills
• The applicants should possess a degree in Mechanical Engineering
• The applicant will have proven experience in the HVAC & Plumbing services engineering designs with significant experience in a similar role or demonstration of a good track record.
• Must be technically good in heat load and ventilation load calculations, duct & pipe sizing and pressure drop calculations
• Must be technically good in equipment selection such as ventilation fans, Chillers, AHUs, FCUs, boilers, pumps etc.
• Carryout preparation of technical submittals of various materials, equipment’s etc.,
• Hands on experience on drafting/3D modelling software’s like AutoCAD, MEP Revit etc.
• Preferred familiarity with technical software’s, such as HAP, Hevacomp, IES, SES etc.
• Must be fluent in English with an excellent understanding of technical terminology.
• Experience of delivering international projects.
• The role requires involvement in numerous projects from an early stage to providing fit for construction stage designs
• Good working knowledge of BIM software packages
• Proven ability to produce detailed drawings (plans, sections & details) from engineers’ basic sketches
• Excellent working knowledge of REVIT Software (version 2021 and above). Including HVAC and plumbing services modelling, content creation (parametric and non-parametric families), coordination with structural and MEP elements, Revit schedules, managing work sets/ links/ visibilities, sheet setup and collaboration.
• The successful candidate will be a dynamic, self-motivated individual who will take on a key role in project work, focused on timely delivery and technical excellence.
• The role requires involvement in numerous projects from an early stage.
• Experience and knowledge in MagiCAD for AutoCAD/Revit will be value added.
• Excellent command of written and verbal English
Desired Skills
• A sound understanding of Microsoft Outlook, Word, Excel, Project is essential
• Must be fluent in English with an excellent understanding of technical terminology.
• Should possess membership to an accredited engineering body i.e., ISHRAE, ASHRAE, CIBSE, IMechE, European Buildings Codes & Standards
• Work towards achieving EngTech/IEng/Chartered engineer/professional license
• Applicants need to be able to demonstrate good management and technical skills and be capable of working both within the team and independently, as dictated by workload
• Excellent oral and written communication skills
• Punctual and able to meet deadlines.

• Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical Engineering
• Minimum of 12 years relevant work experience
• Experience of MS Office Suite of Programs
• Comprehensive experience of technical design and associated discipline software.

BGV:

• Employment with WSP India is subject to the successful completion of a background verification (“BGV”) check conducted by a third-party agency appointed by WSP India.

• Candidates are advised to ensure that all information provided during the recruitment process — including documents uploaded — is accurate and complete, both to WSP India and its BGV partner”.

title: Head, Pricing Strategy
description:
We are on the lookout for a Head, Pricing Strategy (APAC) to join the Marketing Team on our journey to always deliver amazing experiences, reporting to the Director, Pricing.

The Pricing team at Delivery Hero is at the forefront of shaping our global strategy and growth agenda. We are a dynamic, analytical team of pricing analysts and experts who work hand in hand with product managers, data analysts, and data scientists in our product organization. We partner across the organization, including teams in marketing, product, logistics, commercial, and finance, to define and execute pricing strategies that balance profitability, affordability, and market leadership across our diverse global operations.

As the Head, Pricing Strategy (APAC) at Delivery Hero, you will be responsible for defining and executing pricing strategy across our brands in APAC, owning the fee structure for millions of our users in the region. You will lead the development of our regional pricing roadmap, ensuring alignment across marketing, product, data/analytics, and management teams to maximize business value while enhancing Delivery Hero's price perception in APAC markets. You will also play a key role in informing global strategy with regional operational insights to ensure scalable solutions. This is a vital leadership role with high exposure and a significant opportunity to impact the APAC business. You will:

  • Define and execute the pricing strategy for all markets across our APAC business, primarily covering the Foodpanda brand
  • Drive new strategic and innovative pricing initiatives to improve overall global pricing strategy, operations, experimentation, and tooling – including integration of AI and automation solutions
  • Identify, test, and scale opportunities to capture customer willingness to pay while maintaining a fair and competitive price perception
  • Build and align the pricing experimentation roadmap across cross functional teams and local markets
  • Guide user-facing product feature developments required to communicate our fees in the consumer app
  • Own accurate target setting and achievement of the customer fee P&L line items, on the order of hundreds of millions of Euros
  • Manage the APAC pricing strategy team, ensuring strong cross-functional alignment with regional product, commercial, and finance teams
  • 7+ years of experience in pricing, analytics, top-tier consultancy, or a related field.
  • Bachelor's degree in Economics, Mathematics, Engineering, Statistics, or a similar quantitative field.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with proven experience in SQL and Python/R, leveraging data analysis and A/B testing to deliver quick, scalable, and data-driven solutions in complex environments.
  • Ability to communicate effectively at all levels of the organization and manage multiple stakeholders with diverse interests.
  • A proactive and problem-solvers mindset with a passion for data analytics and a track record of tackling complex problems autonomously.
  • Strong stakeholder management, presentation and communication skills with demonstrated experience working in complex and/or matrixed organizations

title: Algorithmic Trading Developer
description:

Location: 100% Remote (Continental United States)

The ideal candidate will have expertise in C++, Java, or Python, low-latency systems, market data, financial markets, and quantitative development, with experience building scalable, production-grade trading platforms.

title: Talentech - Studentermedarbejder til energisystem-modellering i Energihandel
description:
I sektionen Energihandel har vi ansvaret for energihandel i HOFOR og arbejder for at sikre den bedst mulige afsætning af vores varme- og elproduktion fra vores portefølje af kraftværk og vind- og solparker. Vi udvikler løbende handlen i takt med markedsforandringer og i tæt dialog med aktører på både el- og varmesiden. 



 Til at løse nogle af de mange spændende opgaver søger vi nu en studentermedarbejder, der har interesse for data, modellering og energimarkeder. 



 Drift og analyse af modeller for produktion og handel
 
Som vores nye studentermedarbejder bliver din kerneopgave at bidrage til sektionens matematiske model for HOFORs kraftvarmeproduktion. 



 Dine opgaver bliver blandt andet at: 


 
	
 Lave ny udstilling af modelresultater og historisk produktion fra vores assets 

	
 Opdatere forudsætninger til og validere resultater fra den matematiske model 

	
 Udføre dataanalyse og afrapportering af vores historiske og fremtidige handel 

 


 Vi sørger selvfølgelig for en grundig oplæring, og afhængigt af din profil vil du på sigt få flere opgaver og mulighed for at indgå i mere tværfaglige opgaver i sektionen. 



 Interesse for dataanalyse og handel
 
Vi forestiller os, at du er i gang med en uddannelse inden for økonomi, ingeniørvidenskab, data eller lignende, men din specifikke uddannelsesbaggrund er ikke afgørende. Det vigtigste er, at du har stor interesse og god forståelse for dataanalyse samt er nysgerrig efter at lære mere om, hvordan energimarkederne fungerer. 



 Derudover forventer vi, at du: 


 
	
 Har erfaring med eller interesse i at lære Python-programmering og SQL-dataudtræk 

	
 Arbejder systematisk med tal og data, herunder identificerer fejl, afvigelser og mønstrer i datagrundlag 

	
 Arbejder selvstændigt, er initiativrig og bidrager til at forbedre opgavevaretagelsen 

 


 13 dygtige kolleger er klar til at byde dig velkommen
 
Du bliver en del af Energihandel og får 13 kolleger, herunder en anden studentermedarbejder. Vi består af to teams - Short Term Trading og Support & Analyse - og du bliver en del af sidstnævnte. Vi har et godt fagligt og socialt miljø, hvor du får rig mulighed for at udvikle dine kompetencer og have det sjovt samtidig. Derudover prioriterer vi både det fysiske og psykiske arbejdsmiljø højt, så vi sammen får de bedste rammer for vores arbejde - hos os får du nemlig plads til et bæredygtigt arbejdsliv. 



 Du kan læse mere om vores medarbejdergoder  her . 



 Sådan bliver du vores kollega
 
Er du klar til nye muligheder, så ser vi frem til at høre fra dig senest den 20. august 2026. Bemærk at din ansøgning blot skal være et cv på 1-2 sider, hvor du tilføjer et par linjer om din motivation for at søge stillingen. Du kan finde inspiration til at skrive et motiveret CV  her . Derudover bedes du uploade dit seneste karakterudskrift. 



 Vi afholder 1. og 2. samtaler fra uge 35.

  Vand, varme, hverdag. I HOFOR sikrer vi forsyningen i hovedstadsområdet. Men vores ansvar rækker længere: Vi skaber fremtidens bæredygtige byer. Det kræver overskud, og derfor giver vi dig plads. Plads til at forfølge de store ideer og til at hente de små. Plads til at dyrke de faglige detaljer og til at tegne de store linjer. Plads til at hjælpe hinanden og til at tænke nyt, når der er brug for det. Vi har plads til flere og til, at du kan være med.   


 HOFOR. Hos os får du plads. Til fællesskab, udvikling og et bæredygtigt arbejdsliv.

title: Operations Associate (German Speaking)
description:
Starting salary: €15,000 gross per year, subject to skills and experience.

Tired of the 9-to-5 grind? Imagine a World without borders, where opportunities are endless. That's the future of work, and we're building it at WorkMotion. Our all-in-one HR platform makes it easy to hire and manage global teams, ensuring compliance and streamlining processes. So, whether you're a digital nomad or a remote-first company, we've got you covered.

Ready to join the future of work? Let's build something amazing together. As we value work-life balance, please only apply if you're based within 2 hours of the Central European Time zone.

Our Direct Hiring Operations Team is seeking a German-speaking, detail-oriented, highly organized Operations Associate to own end-to-end processes that empower global hiring. In this role, you’ll bridge clients, internal teams, and partners, turning complexity into clarity while ensuring seamless, compliant operations.

What is Direct Hiring?

We enable companies to hire talent directly in new markets by managing their foreign employer registration, onboarding, payroll, and ongoing compliance. Think of us as the behind-the-scenes engine that keeps global teams running smoothly, so our clients can focus on growing their business, not paperwork.

Why this role?

If you thrive in fast-paced environments, love solving puzzles with precision, and want to shape how companies hire globally, let’s talk.

What you will do as a German-speaking Operations Associate (Direct Hiring)

  • Own end-to-end project management for global hiring operations, ensuring compliance and efficiency at every stage.
  • Simplify complex operational or financial concepts into clear, actionable steps for clients and internal teams.
  • Proactively manage client workflows with precision, from onboarding to payroll coordination, while maintaining a “helicopter view” of priorities.
  • Adapt quickly to shifting regulations, client needs, or market dynamics in a fast-paced startup environment.
  • Build trust through transparent communication, resolving escalations with empathy and professionalism.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to innovate and improve our operational framework.

What we are looking for…

  • 3–5 years of operations experience in HR, payroll, or global workforce management (startup/SaaS background is a plus).
  • Proven ability to manage projects from A-to-Z, with strong follow-up and organizational skills.
  • Calm under pressure: You adapt quickly, prioritize effectively, and thrive in ambiguity.
  • A simplifier at heart: you translate complex processes or messages into clear, actionable steps.
  • Startup DNA: Ownership mentality, rapid learning agility, and comfort with a wide-scope, ‘company-within-a-company’ role.
  • Fluent English and German (written and spoken) is essential.

Desirable (but not required):

  • Familiarity with international labor laws or payroll systems.
  • Experience scaling operations in hyper-growth environments.
  • Additional European languages (Portuguese, Spanish, or Italian)

Our benefits and perks…

  • Global, remote, and thriving: We're a global team of talented individuals spread across 26 countries. Our WorkFlex program lets you work from anywhere, anytime. Whether it's a beachside office or a cosy home office, the choice is yours.
  • Your well-being is our priority: We know mental health matters, which is why we offer a dedicated Well-Being Day—a full day off just to recharge and relax.
  • Get fit and stay active: Whether it’s yoga, weightlifting, or a quick jog—work out on your terms, at a discount with our subsidised gym memberships.
  • Learn, grow, and develop: We believe in constant growth. With our Training & Development Allowance, you’ll have all the opportunities you need to keep expanding your skills and knowledge.
  • Stay connected: Take part in exciting annual team meetups!
  • Diversity is our superpower: We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace.

*Benefits vary depending on location due to local laws and regulations.

At WorkMotion, we’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer. If you need any accommodations during the recruitment process, just let our Recruitment Team on [email protected]. We’re here to support you every step of the way!
