  • Konkursy sprzedażowe i dodatkowe akcje z atrakcyjnymi nagrodami.
  • Elastyczny grafik i zespół, który wie, że poza pracą też jest życie.
  • 20% rabatu pracowniczego na zakup produktów we wszystkich sklepach JYSK i spółkach Lars Larsen Group - również na produkty objęte promocją.
  • Atrakcyjne benefity, m.in.: prywatna opieka medyczna, finansowe świadczenia świąteczne, karta Multisport, wspólne integracje i wydarzenia.
  • Stabilne miejsce pracy, w firmie o skandynawskiej kulturze organizacyjnej, opartej na współpracy i wzajemnym szacunku.
  • Nagrody jubileuszowe - doceniamy osoby, które rozwijają się razem z nami.

CZYM BEDZIESZ SIĘ ZAJMOWAĆ?

  • Obsługa klientów z wykorzystaniem wiedzy o produktach.
  • Wspólna realizacją celów sprzedażowych i budowanie wyników wraz z zespołem.
  • Dbanie o spójny, atrakcyjny wyglądu sklepu.
  • Praca operacyjna z zespołem - dostawy, towarowanie, organizacja sklepu.

SZUKAMY OSÓB, KTÓRE:

  • są zorientowane na sprzedaż, realizację wyników oraz wysoką jakość obsługi klienta,
  • budują pozytywne relacje, są otwarte na współpracę i dobrze odnajdują się w pracy z ludźmi,
  • potrafią wspierać i rozwijać zespół poprzez komunikację, feedback i codzienne zaangażowanie,
  • wykazują inicjatywę i energię do działania,
  • dobrze odnajdują się środowisku, w którym dużo się dzieje i jest wiele wyzwań,
  • mają gotowość do pracy w różnych godzinach otwarcia sklepu, w tym w soboty oraz niedziele handlowe,
  • cenią różnorodność, elastyczność w wykonywanych zadaniach.

Poznaj jednego z naszych Sprzedawców i dowiedz się, jakim pracodawcą jesteśmy tutaj.

UWAŻASZ, ŻE TO PRACA WŁAŚNIE DLA CIEBIE? Aplikuj już dziś!

O NAS

W JYSK ludzie są w centrum wszystkiego, co robimy. To ich energia, zaangażowanie i współpraca napędzają nasz rozwój. Dlatego tworzymy środowisko, w którym można się rozwijać, zdobywać nowe doświadczenia i budować swoją ścieżkę kariery krok po kroku, w swoim tempie.
Nasza historia sięga 1979 roku, kiedy Lars Larsen otworzył pierwszy sklep w Danii. Od tego czasu rozwinęliśmy się w międzynarodową sieć obecna w wielu krajach, w tym w Polsce, gdzie mamy już ponad 340 sklepów oraz nowoczesne centrum dystrybucji, które wspiera sprawne funkcjonowanie całej sieci. Rozwijamy zarówno sprzedaż stacjonarną, jak i kanały online, pozostając blisko klientów i ich codziennych potrzeb.
Naszą kulturę definiują trzy wartości: Kupiec, Kolega i Duch Firmy. Przekładają się one na codzienną pracę: odpowiedzialność za wyniki, współpracę w zespole oraz zaangażowanie.
W JYSK stawiamy na środowisko oparte na zaufaniu, szacunku i rozwoju. Wspieramy się nawzajem i dajemy przestrzeń do nauki, niezależnie od miejsca startu.
Jesteśmy organizacją otwartą na różnorodność. Cenimy ludzi bez względu na wiek, tożsamość płciową, orientację seksualną, sprawność, pochodzenie, doświadczenie czy sposób myślenia. Wierzymy, że różne perspektywy, talenty i doświadczenia wzmacniają nasze zespoły i pozwalają nam działać lepiej każdego dnia.

Chcesz uzyskać więcej informacji, odwiedź naszą stronę kariera JYSK.

Dowiedz się, w jaki sposób przetwarzamy Twoje dane osobowe w naszej Polityce Prywatności.

title: Lead, Environmental Health
description:
L3Harris is dedicated to recruiting and developing high-performing talent who are passionate about what they do. Our employees are unified in a shared dedication to our customers’ mission and quest for professional growth. L3Harris provides an inclusive, engaging environment designed to empower employees and promote work-life success. Fundamental to our culture is an unwavering focus on values, dedication to our communities, and commitment to excellence in everything we do.

L3Harris is the Trusted Disruptor in defense tech. With customers’ mission-critical needs always in mind, our employees deliver end-to-end technology solutions connecting the space, air, land, sea and cyber domains in the interest of national security.

Job Title: Lead, Environmental Health

Job Code: 41916

Job Location: Camden AR

Job Schedule: 4/10, Employees work 10 hours per day, 4 days a week

Job Description:

The Lead, Environmental Health will support and lead a wide variety of environmental compliance efforts and projects by performing assignments requiring application of advanced principles, theories, and concepts.

Essential Functions:

  • Ensure compliance with environmental regulations, including preparation of permit applications, compliance recordkeeping and reporting, and related interaction with federal, state, and local regulatory agencies.
  • Provides oversight/guidance for environmental compliance programs including air pollution compliance, waste management, environmental monitoring, remedial/corrective action efforts, stormwater management, and oil spill prevention/SPCC.
  • Supports development and implementation of company and site-specific management system programs, initiatives, and procedures.
  • Participates in, supports, and/or leads investigations of environmental releases and incidents to develop effective corrective actions.
  • Participate in internal and external environmental audits, including report preparation with effective corrective actions and tracking to closure.
  • Evaluates new chemicals; planned new or modified manufacturing or R&D facilities, equipment, tooling, or processes; and procedures with related process hazard analyses to ensure they can be implemented in compliance with environmental regulations and Company and site-specific policies and procedures.
  • Develops and conducts environmental training sessions for compliance with regulations, programs, initiatives, and procedures.
  • The work environment may require a combination of indoor and outdoor activity in varying weather conditions.
  • Frequently moves equipment weighing up to 50 pounds.
  • Person in this position may work around variable noise levels or with fumes or airborne particles, hazardous chemicals, etc. requiring the use of personal protective equipment.
  • Ability to drive up to 10% between various locations within the Company facility or between locations.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Security Clearance at the appropriate level.

Qualifications:

Bachelor’s Degree and minimum 9 years of prior relevant experience. Graduate Degree and a minimum of 7 years of prior related experience. In lieu of a degree, minimum of 13 years of prior related experience.

Preferred Additional Skills:

Extensive experience with air pollution compliance in heavy industrial or chemical sector, including Title V permitting, federal regulations (NSPS, NESHAP/MACT, ODS, RMP), and Arkansas DEQ regulations.

Experience / knowledge of RCRA permitting, hazardous and solid waste management, wastewater/stormwater compliance, remediation, SPCC, and EPCRA/SARA.

Advanced degree in an appropriate environmental discipline.

Energetic materials experience.

Supervisory/management experience.

Experience / knowledge of Process Safety Management, Process Hazard Analysis, and/or Explosives Safety regulations (e.g., DoD 4145.26M).

description:

House: 3:00am-11:30am

Our Brand Promise:
At Four Seasons, Life is richer when we truly connect to the people and world around us. Whether you work, stay, live or discover with us, our purpose is to create impressions that will last a lifetime.

To create a culture and a work ethic based on the Golden Rule, giving our people a framework to pursue a superior international service culture.

What we expect:

  • Operate, maintain and properly clean kitchen equipment, including deep fryer, broiler, stove, steamer, food processor, mixer, slicer, oven, steam table, tilt kettle, waffle iron, and flat top grill.

  • Date all food containers and rotate as per policies, making sure that all perishables are kept at proper temperatures; check pars for shift use, determine necessary preparation, freezer pull and line set up; note any out-of-stock items or possible shortages; return all food items not used to designated storage areas, being sure to cover/date all perishables; assist in setting up plans and actions to correct any food cost problems; control food waste, loss and usage per policies.

Ideal candidate will have:

  • 2-3 years experience with fine pastry; culinary school required; high standard of cleanliness and food safety.

  • Prepare pastry items according to guest orders of consistent quality following recipe cards, as well as production, portion, and presentation standards

  • Complete mis en place and set-up station for breakfast, lunch, and/or dinner service

  • Start food items that are prepared ahead of time, making sure not prepare beyond estimated needs

  • Operate and maintain clean kitchen equipment, including deep fryer, broiler, stove, steamer, food processor, mixer, slicer, oven, steam table, tilt kettle, waffle iron, and flat top grill

  • Label food containers and rotate as per policies, making sure that all perishables are kept at proper temperatures

  • Check pars for shift use, determine necessary preparation, freezer pull and line set up; note any out-of-stock items or possible shortages.

  • Return all food items not used to designated storage areas, being sure to cover/date all perishables.

  • Assist in setting up plans and actions to correct any food cost problems; control food waste, loss and usage per policies.

  • Comply with Four Seasons’ Category One and Category Two Work Rules and Standards of Conduct as set forth in EmPact.

  • Work harmoniously and professionally with co-workers and supervisors and actively participate in creating a teamwork environment.

  • Must have a valid Food Handler’s certificate

  • Perform other duties as assigned.

  • This position requires an applicant with a flexible schedule and the ability to work all shifts, weekends and holidays.

We offer:

  • Hourly Rate: $32.75 - $33.91

  • Comprehensive benefits package: Medical/Dental/Vision

  • 401K Retirement Savings Plan

  • Employee Assistance Program

  • Investment in your Wellbeing

  • Life Insurance

  • Free On-Site Parking

  • Training Program, Tuition Reimbursement

  • Excellent Training and Development opportunities

  • Employee Discount for stays at any Four Seasons worldwide

  • Complimentary Dry Cleaning for Employee Uniforms

title: Engineer/BIM - Electrical (SE)
description:

Work with other engineers and perform calculations in coordination with our Sweden/local engineers.

Technical
• Contribute on the delivery of high-quality technical design drawings, engineering designs, and specifications to the required regulations
• Contribute to technical solutions on projects
• Initiate and participate in design peer reviews
• Ensure internal quality procedures are followed
• Keep up to date with industry developments with respect to own discipline and appreciate the basic technical principles and drivers of other disciplines
• Attending project meetings with the various disciplines

Mandatory Skills
• The applicants should possess a degree in Electrical Engineering
• Experience of delivering international projects.
• The role requires involvement in numerous projects from an early stage to providing fit for construction stage designs
• Must be technically good in providing Electrical Systems design for Property and Building sector.

• Must be fully conversant with technical software, such as Amtech, Dialux, Dialux Evo, Relux.

• The successful candidate will be a dynamic, self-motivated individual who will take on a key role in project work, focused on timely delivery and technical excellence.
• Excellent command of written and verbal English

• A sound understanding of Microsoft Outlook, Word, Excel, Project is essential

• Applicants need to be able to demonstrate good management and technical skills and be capable of working both within the team and independently, as dictated by workload
• Punctual and able to meet deadlines
• Excellent oral and written communication skills

• Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering
• Minimum of 5 years relevant work experience

Er du et sultent salgstalent med appetit på en hverdag, hvor du udfordrer dig selv og bliver endnu bedre? Som sælger hos POWER får du både grundig oplæring og fantastiske udviklingsmuligheder.



"Som sælger spiller du en hovedrolle i kundens oplevelse. Vi går op i, at kunden går fra butikken med en god følelse - og med den rigtige løsning. Derfor får du masser af frihed til at kunne løse hver enkelt kundes problem på den helt rigtige måde," fortæller sælger Patrick Ask.

Afdæk kundernes behov
Hver morgen får du et overblik over dit salgsbudget. Derefter råber vi vores kampråb, tænder gnisten og er klar til dagens salg. Du står for salget af et af vores produktområder: mobil, TV, computer eller hvidevarer.
Du er både sælger af dine produkter, men i høj grad også den ekspert, som rådgiver kunderne. Selvom du har et salgsbudget, du skal overholde, så er det din fornemmeste opgave at afdække kundernes behov. På den måde skaber du glade kunder, som afslutter besøget med det produkt, de har brug for.
"Det fede ved at være sælger i POWER er, at jeg får lov at dyrke salg som det håndværk, det er. For mig har det været en god dag, hvis jeg har bragt et smil på kundernes læber og de rigtige varer ned i deres poser," fortsætter Patrick Ask.

Har du salgstalentet? Så udvikler vi det!  
Denne stilling er for dig, der har vindermentalitet og elsker at sætte mål for dig selv. Vi sørger for, at du får grundig oplæring, og vi har både produktkurser og en mentorordning. På den måde lærer du salgshåndværket fra de mest rutinerede sælgere og udvikler med tiden din egen metode. Samtidig kommer du ind i en stor organisation, hvor der er plads til, at du kan udfolde dine ambitioner - fx igennem vores ledelses- og aspirantkurser.

100 % mandat
Selvom du følger vores salgsstrategier, får du rigeligt med plads til at udfolde dig.
"Det, der adskiller arbejdet som sælger hos POWER fra andre steder, er konceptet om 100 % mandat. Som sælger betyder det, at mine ledere har tiltro til mine evner. Her får jeg langt mere frihed til at træffe beslutninger, så længe de er rettet imod at skabe tilfredse kunder," slutter Patrick Ask.
  
Engageret, udadvendt og karismatisk 
Hos os kan du både få din første erfaring med salg eller tage din eksisterende salgserfaring op på et endnu højere niveau. Vi forestiller os, at du er et socialt væsen, der trives i et konkurrencepræget miljø. Samtidig er du interesseret i vores produkter og opdateret omkring den nyeste teknologi, særligt inden for telefoner, computere, TV eller hvidevarer.

title: Special Agent - Gallup, NM
description:
Be part of a team that values safety, inclusion, and excellence

We are one of the largest U.S. railroads transporting the nation’s freight across 28 western states and 3 Canadian provinces. As a member of our team, you will play a role in supporting the movement of essential products and materials that help feed, clothe, supply, and power communities throughout America and the world.

We are committed to a culture where all employees are included, belong, and have equal opportunity to achieve their full potential. Come make a difference with us!

Learn more about BNSF and our Benefits

Job Location: Gallup
Other Potential Locations: Gallup, NM
Anticipated Start Date: 10/05/2026
Number of Positions: 1
Salary Range: $90,300 - $103,400

Apply early as this job may be removed or filled prior to the closing date, which is approximately seven (7) days after the posting date.


DUTIES/RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Protects and safeguards company assets and resources including personnel, property and customer’s property entrusted to the company.
  • Conduct proficient, sensitive corporate and criminal investigations, provide accurate, detailed reports and provide court testimony when required.
  • Identify and properly handle trespassers on Company property and make arrests as appropriate.
  • Counsels and advises company officials to reduce crime and accidents and improve security; coordinates response to railroad emergencies; supervises contract security guards and trains other employees on relevant matters.
  • Perform aggressive crime prevention patrol of facilities, railroad property and trains, with special emphasis on TOFC/COFC, automobiles, and high value shipments.
  • Perform other duties as assigned

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• High School diploma or GED.

• Must have satisfactorily completed basic police training at a recognized state certified academy

• Must meet peace officer commissioning standards in state in which this job is posted and be commissioned as such and maintain a valid State Peace Office License in that state.

• Must meet BNSF Resource Protection Solutions Team standards as a Special Agent

• Must have a valid driver’s license

• Must be willing and able to travel as required

• Must be able and willing to use the company’s computer system for creating reports and databases

• Must be physically and psychologically fit, able to successfully pass any required company evaluations and pass an extensive background investigation

• Must successfully complete any required company training for this position

• Must have broad knowledge of railroad industry and operations; particularly as it relates to handling emergency situations such as derailments, load securement, and like events

• Must have a broad knowledge of criminal law and procedures

• Must be able to successfully lead people, often in a stressful critical-event environment

• Must be able to meet any government or Company training and retention standards

• Must live or be willing to relocate within 50 miles of the assigned work location

• Eighteen months of successful experience as a full time peace officer with a city, county, state federal or railroad law enforcement agency required

PREFERED QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor's degree

Union:

  • Allied Services Division, Transportation-Communications Union
  • Dues required per union agreement

At BNSF, you will have access to a comprehensive and competitive benefits package including:

  • An industry-leading 401(k) and renowned Railroad Retirement program.
  • A range of robust health care options for you and your dependents (including domestic partners), including medical, dental, vision, telemedicine, mental health, cancer support, and high-quality care network options.
  • Health care spending accounts (HSA) with employer contributions, as well as life and disability insurance, provided at no cost.
  • Family benefits including parental, pediatric and family building support, adoption and surrogacy reimbursement, and dependent care spending account (with employer match).
  • Access to discounts on travel, gym memberships, counseling services and wellness support.
  • Annual bonus (Incentive Compensation Program)
  • Generous leave / time off policies.
  • For more information, visit Benefits.

Please be aware of potential fraud that can occur when searching for new career opportunities. Please review our FAQ for more information and awareness.

All positions require pre-employment background verification, medical review and pre-employment drug screen. You can find more information by reviewing the Hiring Process. Federal authority requires BNSF employees, whose work requires unescorted access to secure areas of port facilities, to obtain a TWIC. More information is available at https://www.tsa.gov/for-industry/twic

BNSF Railway is an Equal Opportunity Employer, all qualified applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.

title: Resident Maintenance Specialist
description:
Since 2012, we've grown to become one of the leading single-family rental companies and homebuilders in the country, recently recognized as a top employer by Fortune and Great Place To Work®. At AMH, our goal is to simplify the experience of leasing a home through professional management and maintenance support, so our residents can focus on what really matters to them, wherever they are in life.

Join our team as a Resident Maintenance Specialist, where you’ll play a crucial role in maintaining the quality and comfort of our properties. You’ll be tasked with overseeing tenant maintenance requests, ensuring they are addressed promptly and effectively. Your role will involve balancing cost control, customer service, and asset preservation.

Responsibilities:

  • Oversee a portfolio of maintenance work, ensuring progress from initiation to completion. Some work orders may be complex.
  • Assist in managing Capital Improvement Projects and vendors.
  • Collaborate with the Supervisor of Market Maintenance/Director of Property Operations, Field Schedulers, and Vendor Performance Specialist to meet service order metrics.
  • Receive, review, and document maintenance requests in company systems. You’ll have the authority to assign work orders to internal or external resources, following company guidelines.
  • Approve vendor bids and manage change orders when necessary. You’ll also provide recommendations to leadership regarding vendor utilization and pricing.
  • Diagnose maintenance problems accurately and determine appropriate solutions.
  • Determine the cost of proposed solutions using company guidelines.
  • Dispatch clear and timely instructions to vendors for resolution of maintenance problems.

Requirements:

  • High School Diploma/GED required.
  • Minimum one year of experience in construction/maintenance, property management, logistics scheduling/dispatching preferred.
  • Basic understanding of single-family home systems and components (appliances, HVAC, etc.).
  • Bilingual (English/Spanish) verbal and written skills are preferred.
  • Intermediate knowledge and experience in Microsoft Office and PC skills.
  • Intermediate knowledge and experience of Customer Service Software Applications, VOIP phone systems, CRM, InContact, and Balto.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication, problem-solving, time management, and conflict resolution skills.
  • Flexibility to work weekends and evenings if assigned

Compensation

The anticipated pay range/scale for this position is $23.19 to $27.83 Hourly. Actual starting base pay within this range will depend on factors including geographic location, education, training, skills, and relevant experience.

Additional Compensation

This position is eligible to receive quarterly bonus payments.

Perks and Benefits

Employees have the opportunity to participate in medical, dental and vision insurance; flexible spending accounts and/or health savings accounts; dependent savings accounts; 401(k) with company matching contributions; employee stock purchase plan; and a tuition reimbursement program. The Company provides 9 paid holidays per year, and, upon hire, new employees will accrue paid time off (PTO) at a rate of 0.0577 hours of PTO per hour worked, up to a maximum of 120 hours per year.

CA Privacy Notice: To learn more about what information we collect when you apply for a job, and how we use that information, please see our CA Job Applicant Privacy Notice found at https://www.amh.com/ca-privacy-notice.

title: Lead UX Designer
description:
Company Description

Come join us and make a difference in the world!

Discover more at www.necsws.com

NO AGENCIES PLEASE

Job Description

NEC Digital Studio is looking for a passionate and experienced design leader to help shape the future of digital healthcare.

Reporting functionally to the Head of Product within NEC Health, you'll define and drive the user experience strategy across our portfolio of screening, real-world evidence, registries and pathway management solutions. You'll own the evolution of the NEC Health design system, creating a consistent, intuitive and accessible experience across our products and services.

This is both a strategic and hands-on role, combining UX leadership, design delivery, and coaching the wider product team best practice design principles. You'll work closely with customers, clinicians, product and engineering teams to improve patient outcomes, support value-based healthcare, and championing a culture of exceptional design as well a the use of latest technologies.

As part of NEC Digital Studio's UX/UI Community of Practice, you'll also contribute to and benefit from a wider network of design expertise across NEC.

Key Responsibilities

Design Leadership & Portfolio Ownership

  • Define and own the UX vision for the NEC Health portfolio.
  • Lead the development and governance of a unified NEC Health Design System.
  • Drive consistency in user experience, interaction patterns, accessibility standards and visual language across all Health products and services.
  • Partner with Product Managers, Product Owners and Engineering teams to embed design excellence throughout the product lifecycle.
  • Experience working within multidisciplinary delivery teams.
  • Shape a seamless NEC Health Suite experience, enabling users to move effortlessly between products and services.
  • Lead design activities on strategic programmes and high-priority initiatives.
  • Produce and oversee user flows, wireframes, prototypes and interaction models where required.
  • Facilitate workshops, discovery activities and co-design sessions with customers and users.

Coaching & Capability Development

  • Mentor Product Managers, Product Owners and wider stakeholders in user-centred design and design thinking.
  • Increase design maturity across the Health division.
  • Promote best practices in accessibility, usability testing and evidence-based design.
  • Help teams embed customer-centric thinking into product development.

Stakeholder & Customer Engagement

  • Build trusted relationships with healthcare organisations, NHS stakeholders, clinicians and customers.
  • Present and defend design decisions to senior stakeholders and executive audiences.
  • Translate complex healthcare workflows into intuitive, effective digital experiences.
  • Act as a trusted advisor on user experience and design strategy.
  • Demonstrable experience working with complex stakeholder groups, navigating ambiguity and competing priorities.

Design Culture & Advocacy

  • Champion a culture of simplicity, empathy, accessibility and quality.
  • Promote innovative approaches grounded in user needs, evidence and measurable outcomes.
  • Drive adoption of design standards, reusable patterns and best practices across the organisation.
  • Help establish NEC Health as a recognised leader in healthcare user experience and digital product design.

Technology

  • A clear active interest in the latest technology and tooling for software design and beyond.
  • Demonstrable Experience with Figma
  • Experience using Figma Make and/or other AI design tools

Qualifications

  • Demonstrable Experience working as a UX Designer
  • Experience with Leadership
  • Experience within Health would be desirable
  • Experience working to GDS standards
  • Previous experience working with Multidisciplinary Project Teams
  • Stakeholder Management
  • Experience of Accessibility and WCAG Standards

Additional Information

We pride ourselves in offering an excellent benefits package, including an above average pension scheme. When you join the team at NEC Software Solutions, you are provided with the following:

  • Private Medical Cover funded by NEC for Employees (with the option to add family members at an additional cost)
  • 25 days paid holiday with the option to buy/sell (FTE)
  • 4 x basic salary life assurance cover funded by NEC (with the option to increase cover at an additional cost)
  • A Group Pension Plan with fantastic employer contributions up to a maximum of 8.5%
  • A selection of flexible benefits to suit your individual needs
  • All colleagues get free access to LinkedIn Learning. Over 15000 courses covering a huge breadth of subjects. Learn about what you like, when you like, how you like.

OTHER INFORMATION

  • Candidates must be able to demonstrate a pre-existing right to work and travel within the UK. Documentary evidence will be required.
  • All offers are subject to satisfactory vetting, references and occupational health checks.
  • Depending on the nature of the role a Disclosure Barring Service (DBS) check may also be required.

NEC Software Solutions is an equal opportunities employer, welcoming applications from all communities. If you require any reasonable adjustments or have specific accessibility needs during the recruitment or interview process, please feel free to share these with us. We are committed to ensuring an inclusive and accommodating experience for all candidates.

Who We Are:

We’re NEC Software Solutions (part of global tech giant NEC Corporation). While you read this ad, our software is helping to support families, keep trains on the move, locate missing people and even test the hearing of newborn babies.

Working with us, you’ll be helping our 3,000+ employees push the boundaries of what’s possible and support amazing public services.

We work with governments, hospitals, housing providers, local authorities and more. We help them pay financial support faster, speed up treatments for patients and respond to emergencies in the right way. The more we do, the more our customers can do for others. And together, we make a world of difference.

We’d love your help. And we’ll support you all the way.

 jobdetaljer 

 
 
          
 Sætter du en ære i at fjerne afvigelser frem for blot at forklare dem? Og er du klar til at blive en af CFO’ens vigtigste økonomiske sparringspartnere, hvor du udfordrer forretningen, når forecast, performance eller projektrisici ikke hænger sammen? 
 
           ...  

 Eltel bygger den kritiske infrastruktur, der driver den grønne omstilling og holder samfundet kørende. Nu søger Eltel en Senior Business Controller, der vil være med til at styrke lønsomheden i en projektforretning med en årlig omsætning på 600-700 mio. DKK. Her får du en unik mulighed for at skabe værdi, påvirke beslutninger og forme fremtiden. Du spiller en central rolle i en forretning, hvor selv mindre forbedringer i margin, produktivitet og projektstyring kan skabe betydelige resultater på bundlinjen. 
 
  om jobbet Som Senior Business Controller indtager du en nøglerolle med direkte reference til CFO'en og stor eksponering mod direktionen. Det er en position, hvor du får reel indflydelse på forretningen, direkte adgang til beslutningerne og mulighed for at forme controlling-funktionen. Du fungerer som den centrale økonomiske rådgiver for områdecheferne, hvor du får et reelt mandat til at udfordre, påvirke og drive forbedringer. Du understøttes af moderne BI-værktøjer og et velfungerende datagrundlag, men det er din opgave at gå bag om tallene, omdanne indsigterne til konkrete tiltag og skabe struktur i forretningens processer.
 
 Dit primære fokus bliver at styrke lønsomheden i projekterne, skabe gennemsigtighed i performance og risici, samt at oversætte finansiel indsigt til klare prioriteringer. Du vil især arbejde med at:
 • Identificere risici og forbedringsmuligheder i projekter og forretningsområder for proaktivt at optimere lønsomheden
 • Sikre stærkere styring af marginer, produktivitet og omkostninger samt forankre en robust governance
 • Forbedre forecast-præcision, cashflow og PoC-styring, så risici identificeres tidligere og projektets lønsomhed bliver mere forudsigelig 
 • Agere en værdiskabende sparringspartner ved at bygge bro mellem finans og drift gennem et tæt, strategisk samarbejde med områdechefer og projektansvarlige
 • Drive konkrete forbedringer i processer, værktøjer og opfølgning og omsætte analyser til anbefalinger, der skaber mærkbare resultater
 
  for at få succes i rollen Når vi møder dig, er vi langt mere interesserede i de resultater, du har skabt, end i en liste over dine arbejdsopgaver. Din gennemslagskraft skinner igennem ved din evne til at gennemskue finansiel kompleksitet og identificere præcis de handlinger, der kan flytte marginen. Du har tyngden til at navigere i store projekter og modet til at eksekvere på de beslutninger, der reelt styrker bundlinjen. 
 
 For at skabe succes i rollen er det en fordel at medbringe:
 • Minimum 5 års erfaring fra Business Controlling, Finance Business Partnering eller Project Controlling i en projektdrevet virksomhed (f.eks. byggebranchen)
 • En relevant videregående uddannelse som f.eks. cand.merc., HD eller en bachelor i økonomi
 • Dokumenteret erfaring med at forbedre lønsomhed, cashflow og forudsigelighed gennem stærk økonomisk styring og tæt samarbejde med forretningen 
 • Erfaring med at styre og forstå driverne bag økonomien, fx produktivitet, materiale- og timeforbrug, standard cost afvigelser samt margin- og risikostyring
 • En stærk forretningsforståelse og indgående erfaring med Percentage of Completion (PoC), hvor du udfordrer beslutninger konstruktivt
 • Flydende dansk og engelsk i både skrift og tale
 
  hvorfor skal du blive en del af Eltel? Hos Eltel får du adgang til et professionelt miljø i en virksomhed, der tror på ansvar, handlekraft og ærlig dialog. Stillingen giver en sjælden mulighed for at arbejde tæt på både drift, direktion og CFO i en virksomhed, der spiller en central rolle i elektrificeringen og den digitale udvikling i samfundet. 
 
 Her får du et reelt mandat til at udfordre beslutninger og gøre en målbar forskel på bundlinjen i et tæt samarbejde med både ledelse og drift. Du bliver en del af en kultur, hvor analyser rent faktisk bliver omsat til handlinger, der føres ud i livet, og hvor initiativ belønnes. Du står stærkt med direkte reference til CFO'en, og du får den optimale platform til at understøtte direktionen med afgørende indsigt i forhold til fremtidige projekter. 
 
  ansøg nu Kan du se dig selv i rollen som Senior Business Controller, så send din ansøgning. Randstad varetager denne rekrutteringsproces på vegne af Eltel. Vil du vide mere om stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Principal Consultant Mille Maegaard-Fast på tlf. +45 92 92 08 53 eller Principal Consultant Steffen Paaske på tlf. +45 92 92 51 19. Alle henvendelser behandles fortroligt, og vi kalder løbende ind til samtale.
 
 Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig.
 
  om randstad 
 Randstad er verdens største HR-udbyder og ‘partner for talent’. De giver lige muligheder til alle uanset baggrund og hjælper kandidater med at forblive relevante på et hastigt skiftende arbejdsmarked. De tror på et inkluderende arbejdsmarked, hvor alle kan være sig selv og føle sig velkomne.
 
 Deres markedsindsigt og store kendskab til arbejdsmarkedet hjælper virksomheder med at opbygge en kvalificeret, mangfoldig og fleksibel arbejdsstyrke, og de støtter mennesker og virksomheder i at nå deres fulde potentiale. Det er det, de er her for, og det er det, der motiverer dem hver dag.
 
 Randstad DK er en del af den internationale Randstad Group. De formidler dagligt arbejde til over 600.000 mennesker verden over og er førende inden for rekruttering, karriererådgivning og fleksibel arbejdskraft i Danmark, med afdelinger i København, Aarhus, Aalborg og Kolding.

title: MDLBEAST CO-OP Internship Program
description:
MDLBEAST CO-OP Internship Program

We’re excited to launch the MDLBEAST CO-OP Internship Program, offering Saudi students hands-on training in the music and entertainment industry. This initiative supports university graduation requirements and aligns with the MHRSD’s goals to empower national talent in alignment with Vision 2030.

Vacancies:

IT & Procurement – Riyadh

Creative – Jeddah

Events – Jeddah

Marketing– Riyadh / Jeddah

Finance – Riyadh / Jeddah

Music & Talent – Jeddah

Legal – Riyadh

HR – Riyadh

Here’s what you can expect from the internship:

  • Work closely with experienced professionals in your chosen field

  • Participate in real projects that enhance your skills and knowledge

  • Program duration: 3 months

  • Open to Saudi nationals only

  • Gain hands-on experience and contribute to the organization’s growth

  • Build practical knowledge in the music and entertainment industry

If you are passionate about the music and entertainment industry and eager to learn, this internship program is the perfect opportunity for you. Join us and be part of the MDLBEAST team as we continue to revolutionise the music scene in Saudi Arabia.

MDLBEAST CO-OP Internship Program Requirements

Thank you for your interest in the MDLBEAST CO-OP Internship Program. To be considered for this exciting opportunity, please ensure you meet the following requirements:

  • A relevant major to the required vacancies.

  • Passion for the music and entertainment industry.

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.

  • Ability to work well in teams.

  • Excellent organisational and time management skills.

  • Willingness to learn and take on new challenges.

  • Flexible and adaptable to changing priorities.

  • Positive attitude.

Join the MDLBEAST CO-OP Internship today and don't miss out on this incredible opportunity to gain valuable experience!

title: Software Development Engineer, Translation Services
description:
Translation Services(TS) seeks a passionate Software Development Engineer to drive innovations in translation to reach every Amazon customer in their own language.



Key job responsibilities
Are you passionate about creating high-performance, large-scale language translation services to support Amazon's current and future growth? Do you thrive in environments where you can lead innovation? If so, we're seeking a software engineer to join the Translation Services (TS) team.

TS provides technology solutions and services that deliver quality translations at the lowest possible cost for Amazon businesses. As a Software Development Engineer, you'll help drive efforts to build translations solutions at Amazon scale with 100% translations coverage, eventually making translations a no-op for developers so that they can focus on business logic and application building.

We're seeking a self-starting individual comfortable with ambiguity, possessing strong attention to detail, and dedicated to ensuring that secondary language experiences match the excellence of primary language experiences, even at Amazon's vast scale.



About the team
We have fifteen member talented engineering teams based in Seattle, WA and a great office space where we collaborate.

Our vision: Language will not stand in the way of anyone on earth using Amazon products and services.

Our mission: We are the enablers and guardians of translation for Amazon's customers. We do this by offering hands-off-the-wheel service to all Amazon teams, optimizing translation quality and speed at the lowest cost possible.

   Servicemedarbejder under 18 år - Nørresundby 
  Kickstart dit første job som servicemedarbejder (15-17 år) i Netto! 
 Er du klar til at tjene dine egne penge, få nye venner og være en del af et fedt fællesskab? Så er jobbet som servicemedarbejder i Netto måske lige noget for dig! 

 Hvad skal du lave? 
  Som servicemedarbejder er du med til at gøre hverdagen nemmere for vores kunder - og du får masser af sjove og varierede opgaver: 
 
 Hjælpe med let rengøring og oprydning 

 Fylde varer op og sørge for, at hylderne ser godt ud (ingen tunge løft!) 

 Holde butikken pæn og indbydende 

 Sætte prisskilte op 

 Betjene kunder - ved kassen 

 Levere kundeservice til alle vores kunder 
 
 Du får selvfølgelig grundig oplæring, så du hurtigt føler dig hjemme og tryg i jobbet. Vi sørger for, at alt foregår efter reglerne for unge under 18 år. 

 Hvorfor vælge Netto? 
  Hos Netto bliver du en del af et stærkt team, hvor vi hjælper hinanden og har det sjovt sammen - det kalder vi Netto-ånden! Du lærer en masse om samarbejde, kundeservice og butiksliv, og du får erfaringer, du kan bruge resten af livet. 

 Vi leder efter dig, der:  
 
 Er fyldt 15 år og har afsluttet 9. klasse (eller er fritaget for undervisningspligt) 

 Er positiv, hjælpsom og klar til at tage ansvar 

 Har lyst til at arbejde sammen med andre unge og møde nye mennesker 
 
 Vi tilbyder:  
 
 Et fleksibelt job, hvor der er plads til skole og fritid 

 En arbejdsplan der er synlig i vores medarbejderapp - MyNetto 

 Grundig oplæring i butikken og online 

 Et godt arbejdsmiljø 

 Mulighed for at udvikle dig og tage næste skridt i Netto 
 
 Alle de gode grunde til at starte som servicemedarbejder i Netto 
  Hos Netto vil vi gerne være det bedste sted at få dit allerførste job! Vi gør meget ud af at tage godt imod dig, og vi ved, at det kan være lidt nervepirrende i starten - fx hvis du er bange for at lave fejl, skal snakke med voksne eller kunder, eller er usikker på vagtplaner og mødetider. 

 Bare rolig - vi hjælper dig hele vejen! Uanset om du bliver hos os i lang tid eller kun for en kort periode, vil vi gerne sikre, at du får en god oplevelse og lærer noget nyt. 

 Du kan også glæde dig til:  
 
 Løn og arbejdsvilkår der følger HK overenskomst 

 Masser af gode personalegoder, fx rabatter i Bilka, føtex, Netto, Carl’s Jr. og Starbucks 

 Adgang til Salling online personaleshop med 35% rabat 

 Mulighed for at handle i vores fysiske Salling varehuse i Aalborg, Aarhus og snart i København, hvor vi åbner i 2026 med 35% rabat 
 
 Bliv en del af Netto-ånden: Sammenhold, engagement og fællesskab 
  I Netto fylder sammenhold, engagement og fællesskab rigtig meget. Vi kalder det Netto-ånden, og den bliver man hurtigt bidt af. Det er den hjælpende hånd, smilet der stadig sidder fast efter en lang dag, og det er sammenholdet, der får os til at løfte i flok. 

 Hos Netto skal alle medarbejdere opleve, at de er en del af et stærkt team, hvor de føler sig respekteret, og deres indsats er højt værdsat. Vi tilbyder varierende opgaver, der motiverer og udvikler dig - både til gavn for din fremtid hos os eller andre steder. Vi tager et stort ansvar for at gøre hverdagen bedre for medarbejdere, kunder og det samfund, vi er en del af. 

 Lyder det som noget for dig? 
  Send din ansøgning online til os via knappen nedenfor. Vi inviterer løbende til samtale, så søg allerede i dag. 

 Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

title: 105 - Raley's Starbucks Assistant Team Leader - Robb Dr. - Reno
description:
We are now hiring Great People Who Care!

We are looking for a fearless and inspiring Food Service Assistant Team Leader who has a passion for food. Our Food Service Assistant Team Leader will assist in day to day operations in our Food Service departments and help lead their team to success. A Food Service Assistant Team Lead can demonstrate excellent leadership skills, the ability to drive for results, and has great attention to detail. A Food Service Assistant Team Lead has a keen eye for Food Safety and Sanitation and will be able to help in production and merchandising while offering unmatched customer service.

Be part of our store team and help us make a positive impact in our customer’s lives. We promise our Team Members open and honest communication and opportunities for growth with our company. Our leaders lead with passion and purpose, and celebrate you with meaningful recognition. We promote a healthy life balance because we believe your personal well-being is essential.

We have a passion for food, and we share an inspiring vision, “To change the way the world eats, one plate at a time.”

Perks & Benefits

  • Competitive compensation, paid weekly
  • Retirement Benefits
  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance for yourself and eligible dependents
  • Tuition Reimbursement for qualified courses
  • Scholarship opportunities for continued education
  • Family leave and paid time off
  • Store discount programs (10% off household groceries, free items)
  • Discounts to amusement parks, gym memberships, mobile phone plans, etc.
  • Employee Assistance Program (free financial, legal, and mental health services)
  • Fun work environment where you have the opportunity to nourish your community.

Responsibilities

A Food Service Assistant Team Leader is a positive, motivated servant leader who is always looking to learn.

A Food Service Assistant Team Leader’s responsibilities include:

  • Assisting Food Service Department Team Lead in all department tasks
  • Daily customer interactions
  • Preparation of food, including slicing meats, preparing sandwiches, cooking fresh offerings
  • Sharing food knowledge with customers and Team Members
  • Leading, training, coaching, and communicating with all Team Members in their department.
  • Food Safety, Safety, and Sanitation
  • Day to day production, merchandising, and quality control of all department offerings
  • Driving department sales
  • Managing department labor and productivity

Desired Qualifications include:

  • Friendly and customer service oriented. Interest in food and cooking a plus.
  • Must display exceptional leadership skills; excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
  • Customer service, restaurant, barista, food service, grocery or similar experience desired
  • Self-motivated, with a high attention to detail, quality and presentation
  • Skills to communicate effectively with coworkers and customers
  • Ability to work independently, effectively manage time and multitask in a fast-paced environment
  • Ability to read, understand and follow through on verbal and written directions
  • Ability to reliably meet required work schedule and adhere to company attendance policy

Employees may occasionally experience the following physical demands for an extended period:

Standing, Sitting, Lifting + Stocking (Up to 50 lbs.), Pushing, Keyboarding, Telephone Use, Walking, Bending

Must be 18 years of age

Note For Current Raley's Employees:

  1. You must apply through the internal portal
  2. No disciplinary action during the past 6 months
  3. Your current leader must recommend that you apply for this position and provide an endorsement

Compensation: The range displayed reflects the range the company reasonably expects to pay for the position. The actual compensation offered to the selected individual(s) will depend on their relevant education, training, or experience, among other bona fide factors.

description:
Category Purchaser Outbound Vessel (m/f/d)
     
          
 
              
              
              
              
           

         

       

 
 
 
 Posted  31 July 2026

     77878

									  Hamburg, HH, DE, 20097

 Become part of a global procurement organization at the forefront of renewable energy. In this role, you will manage strategic vessel sourcing and supplier partnerships, ensuring the safe and efficient transportation of wind turbine components from factory to destination worldwide. 



 Vestas Technology & Operations > Procurement > Procurement Logistics 



 As part of the Transport Procurement function, you will contribute to the development and execution of global sourcing strategies that ensure safe, cost-effective, and reliable transportation capacity for our projects worldwide. Working in a highly international environment, you will support the procurement of complex marine logistics solutions while balancing commercial, operational, sustainability, and compliance requirements. 


 In this role, you will take ownership of procurement activities related to outbound vessel transportation, driving sourcing initiatives, supplier negotiations, and contract management to ensure capacity availability, competitive commercial terms, and high service performance. You will collaborate closely with Supply Chain and other cross-functional stakeholders, serving as a trusted procurement partner and helping secure seamless transport flows that support the successful delivery of projects globally. 


   


 Responsibilities 

 

 Lead sourcing and procurement activities for outbound vessel transportation, including chartering, liner services, heavy-lift, and breakbulk logistics solutions 


 Develop and execute sourcing, negotiation, and category strategies to secure competitive commercial terms, reliable capacity, and effective risk management 


 Negotiate and manage transportation contracts, framework agreements, and charter party arrangements while ensuring compliance with commercial and governance requirements 


 Build and maintain strategic relationships with vessel owners, shipping lines, brokers, and logistics providers to strengthen supplier performance and market access 


 Monitor freight markets, vessel availability, and industry trends to provide insights and recommendations that support business and project objectives 


 Partner closely with Supply Chain and cross-functional stakeholders to align transportation solutions with project schedules, operational requirements, and business priorities 


 Act as the primary procurement interface for outbound vessel logistics, driving supplier management, commercial governance, continuous improvement initiatives, and logistics optimization opportunities 

 

   


 Qualifications 

 

 Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Administration, Maritime Studies, or a related discipline 


 Proven experience in ocean freight procurement, vessel chartering, project logistics, or a comparable transportation environment 


 Solid understanding of maritime logistics, including vessel operations, cargo movements, and transportation execution 


 Experience working with multipurpose (MPP), heavy-lift, breakbulk, or other non-containerized cargo solutions is highly desirable 


 Knowledge of end-to-end outbound logistics processes, from manufacturing sites to ports of discharge, is considered an advantage

 Competencies

 Strong analytical capabilities with the ability to evaluate costs, risks, market trends, and business scenarios to support decision-making 


 Ability to build relationships and collaborate effectively with stakeholders across a global, cross-functional, and matrix organization 


 Proven project management and prioritization skills, with the ability to manage multiple activities in a dynamic environment 


 Knowledge of commercial contracting and supplier governance, including transportation and freight agreements 


 Structured, proactive, and solution-oriented team player with excellent communication skills and professional proficiency in English 

 

   


 What we offer 


 We offer an exciting opportunity to shape and optimize outbound vessel procurement in a global organization. You will work in an international environment with significant exposure to global supply chains and the opportunity to influence logistics and shipping strategy. 


 You will be part of a high-performing team delivering reliable and cost-efficient transport solutions, with strong opportunities for professional growth. 


   


 Additional information 


 The primary work location for this position is Aarhus (Denmark) or Hamburg (Germany). 


 Up to 40 days of travel per year. 


 We do amend or withdraw our jobs and reserve the right to do so at any time, including prior to the advertised closing date. Please be advised to apply on or before 30th August 2026.

To support a fair recruitment process, we kindly ask that you remove any photos, dates of birth or graduation, gender pronouns, marital status, or other personal information not relevant to the role before submitting your CV/resume. Your CV/resume should focus on your professional and educational background, along with the necessary contact details (email and phone number). We train our hiring teams in inclusive evaluation and regularly review process outcomes to ensure fairness. 


   



  
 At Vestas, we recognize the value of diversity, equity, and inclusion in driving innovation and success. We strongly encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply, particularly those who may hesitate due to their identity or feel they do not meet every criterion. As our CEO states, "Expertise and talent come in many forms, and a diverse workforce enhances our ability to think differently and solve the complex challenges of our industry". title: Staff Software Engineer-Android
description:
Here at Scout Motors, we're carrying forward the heritage of one of the most iconic American vehicles in history. A vehicle dating back to 1960. One that forged the path for future generations of rugged SUVs and trucks and will do so once again.

But Scout is more than just a brand, it's a legacy steeped in a culture of exploration, caretaking, and hard work.

The Scout brand is all about respect. Respect for the past and the future by taking an iconic American brand that hasn't been around for a while, electrifying it, digitizing it, and loading it with American innovation. Respect for communities by creating a company that stands for its people and its customers. Respect for both work and play, with vehicles that are equally at home at a camp site, a job site, or on a Tuesday commute. And respect for our customers by developing two powertrains that meet their requirements - an all-electric powertrain as well as the Harvester range extender powertrain which includes a built-in gas-powered generator with an estimated 500 miles of combined range.

At Scout Motors, we empower our talented, inclusive, and entrepreneurial teams to innovate. What makes a Scout employee? Someone who is a visionary and a leader, who seeks new paths and shares lessons learned. A knowledgeable doer who collaborates across the company to build better. A go-getter with unrivaled passion.

Join us at Scout Motors and be part of shaping the future of transportation. If you're ready to drive change and make history, apply now!

What you'll do

As a Staff Software Engineer (Android) on the Digital Products team, you will provide technical leadership for the architecture, development, and evolution of our Android platform, helping shape the future of the connected vehicle experience. You will drive the design and delivery of scalable, high-quality Android applications and services across key customer-facing products, including vehicle connectivity, mapping and navigation, EV charging experiences, vehicle purchasing journeys, and other strategic digital initiatives.

In this role, you will partner closely with engineering leadership, product management, design, and cross-functional stakeholders to define and execute the Android engineering strategy. You will influence technical direction across multiple teams, establish best practices, and ensure architectural consistency, performance, reliability, and maintainability across the Android ecosystem.

As a technical leader, you will lead large-scale, complex initiatives from concept through delivery, balancing near-term business needs with long-term platform investments. You will drive technical decision-making, identify and mitigate risks, and champion engineering excellence through code quality, operational rigor, and continuous improvement.

You will also play a key role in developing engineering talent by mentoring senior and junior engineers, providing technical guidance, fostering collaboration, and elevating the overall effectiveness of the Android organization.

Become part of an iconic brand that is set to revolutionize the electric pick-up truck & rugged SUV marketplace by achieving the following:
  • Lead the design, development, maintenance and mobile release of our Android applications.
  • Drive the technical architecture and implementation of mobile platform and solutions from the ground up, ensuring they are scalable, reliable, and performant.
  • Grow the knowledge of the team, sharing through pair programming, code reviews, presentations, example code, and documentation.
  • Implement programming best practices, deployment processes and monitoring for mobile platforms.
  • Stay current with emerging technologies and industry trends in mobile development, advocating for the adoption of new tools and techniques as appropriate.
Location & Travel Expectations:
  • This role will be based out of the Scout Motors location in Fremont, California.
  • This role requires occasional attendance in the office, with regular in-person meetings and events.
  • Applicants should expect that the role will require the ability to convene with Scout colleagues in person and travel to participate in events on behalf of the company from time to time.
What you'll bring

We expect all Scout employees to have integrity, curiosity, resourcefulness, and strive to exhibit a positive attitude, as well as a growth mindset. You'll be comfortable with change and flexible in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. You'll take a collaborative approach to achieve ambitious goals. Here's what else you'll bring:
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 8+ years of hands-on experience in software engineering shipping customer facing applications on Android.
  • Proficiency in Android application development using languages like Kotlin or Java.
  • Solid understanding of mobile platform architecture, UI/UX design principles and frameworks, GraphQL, mobile security and performance optimization techniques.
  • Experience with version control systems (e.g., Git), CI/CD pipelines and mobile release process.
  • Experience as a technical lead for large projects (6+ months in length), including defining the roadmap for complex projects spanning multiple teams and functions.
  • Effective communication skills, with the ability to articulate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience operating in start-up settings, launching 0 to 1 product, and driving graduation to highly customized applications.
  • Ability to effectively manage multiple priorities and stakeholders in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
  • Passion for mobile technology and a commitment to delivering exceptional user experiences.
Preferred Qualifications:
  • Experience building systems in the automotive industry.
  • Experience with mobile app testing, experimentation frameworks and automation frameworks.
  • Experience with cloud technologies and services, such as AWS or Azure.
  • Experience with mobile apps that connect to an IOT device
What you'll gain

The benefits of joining Scout include the chance to build products and a company from the ground up . This is a chance to create something new and lasting - with an iconic brand at its foundation . In addition, Scout provides competitive compensation and benefits to support your physical, mental, and financial wellbeing. Program specifics are detailed in company policies and employee benefit guides, select highlights:
  • Competitive insurance including:
    • Medical, dental, vision and income protection plans
  • 401(k) program with:
    • An employer match and immediate vesting
  • Generous Paid Time Off including:
    • 20 days planned PTO, as accrued
    • 40 hours of unplanned PTO and 14 company or floating holidays, annually
    • Up to 16 weeks of paid parental leave for biological and adoptive parents of all genders
    • Paid leave for circumstances related to bereavement, jury duty, voting time, or military leave
Pay Transparency

This is a full-time, exempt position eligible to receive a base salary and to participate in an annual performance bonus program. Final salary offered will be determined based on factors including but not limited to the candidate's skills and experience. The annual performance bonus program is preset and not candidate dependent.

Initial base salary range = $165,000.00 - $200,000.00

Initial California base salary range = $181,500 - $220,000

title: Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
Quality Assurance Engineer

Location: Remote

Reporting to: Engineering Squad Lead

About the Role

We are looking for a Quality Assurance Engineer to join our team at 1VALET. This role is critical to ensuring the quality, reliability, and performance of 1VALET’s hardware and software products, including our Entry systems, software and third-party hardware integrations (smart locks, thermostats, sensors, and other IoT devices). You will work closely with Product, Hardware Engineering, Software Engineering, CX, and Operations teams to validate new products, support field deployments, and troubleshoot real-world issues reported by customers and operations teams. This is a hands-on QA role that requires deep involvement with physical hardware, firmware, software, and system-level integrations.

Responsibilities

Hardware & System QA

  • Define and execute QA strategies, test plans, and test cases for hardware products, embedded software, and connected systems
  • Perform functional, regression, integration, and system testing on 1VALET Entry systems and related hardware
    ● Validate hardware integrations including smart locks, thermostats, access readers, sensors, and other IoT devices
  • Participate in new hardware bring-up and validation Software & Platform QA
  • Test embedded firmware, device software, mobile applications, and backend services as part of an end-to-end system
  • Ensure quality across multiple device types, screen sizes, hardware revisions, and firmware versions
  • Collaborate with software engineers to reproduce, isolate, and verify fixes for defects Field & Operations Support
  • Work closely with CX and Operations teams to investigate and troubleshoot issues reported from the field
  • Reproduce customer issues in the lab using real hardware and production-like environments
  • Perform root cause analysis and provide actionable feedback to engineering and product teams Process & Quality Improvement
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of testing methodologies, documentation, and release quality
  • Track defects, test results, and quality metrics; clearly communicate risks and release readiness
  • Advocate for quality throughout the product lifecycle, from design to deployment

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in Quality Assurance, with a strong focus on hardware-software systems
  • Proven ability to troubleshoot complex, real-world issues involving hardware, software, and networks
  • Experience working with bug tracking and test management tools
  • Comfortable working onsite with physical devices and lab equipment

Nice to Have

  • Experience in smart building, proptech, access control, or IoT platforms
  • Familiarity with networking concepts (TCP/IP, Wi-Fi, Ethernet, BLE, LTE)
  • Knowledge of compliance or certification processes (FCC, CE, etc.)
    ● Experience collaborating closely with Operations or Customer Support teams
  • Strong understanding of hardware, firmware, and software interactions
  • Experience testing device integrations (locks, sensors, controllers, or similar systems)
    ● Hands-on experience testing embedded systems, IoT devices, or hardware products
    ● Experience using AI-assisted tools to improve productivity and quality (e.g., Replit AI, Claude, GitHub Copilot, or similar tools) for tasks such as test design, debugging, documentation, or analysis

What We Offer

  • Opportunity to work on real, deployed hardware systems used in residential and commercial buildings
  • High ownership role with direct impact on product quality and customer experience
  • Close collaboration with product, engineering, CX, and operations teams
  • Access to a fully equipped R&D lab and hands-on testing environment

AI may be used to help filter applications

Servicetekniker inden for autobranchen, entreprenørmaskiner eller industrimaskiner

Har kendskab til hydraulik, pneumatik og el-teknik 

Har erfaring med fejlfinding, reparation og vedligehold 

Er vant til at dokumentere dit arbejde og følge sikkerhedsprocedurer 

Er serviceminded og kommunikerer professionelt med kunder 

Er bosiddende i Hovedstadsområdet. 

Har kørekort og kan arbejde selvstændigt på landevejen

En selvstændig og afvekslende hverdag med stor frihed under ansvar 

Grundig oplæring og løbende faglig udvikling

Sammen skaber vi et arbejdsmiljø, hvor forskellighed værdsættes og styrker fællesskabet.

title: Google Ads (AdWords) / SEM Executive
description:
We are looking for a passionate and result-oriented Google Ads (AdWords) / SEM Executive to join our digital marketing team. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in planning, executing, monitoring, and optimising paid search campaigns to generate quality leads and maximise ROI.

Key Responsibilities

  • Plan, create, and manage Google Ads campaigns (Search, Display, Performance Max, Shopping, and YouTube).
  • Conduct keyword research and competitor analysis.
  • Optimise
  • campaigns to improve CTR, Quality Score, conversions, and ROI.
  • Monitor daily campaign performance and budget allocation.
  • Perform A/B testing for ad copies, landing pages, and bidding strategies.
  • Track campaign performance using Google Analytics and Google Tag Manager.
  • Generate weekly and monthly performance reports.
  • Analyse conversion data and recommend improvements.
  • Stay updated with Google Ads policies and industry trends.
  • Collaborate with the SEO, Content, and Sales teams to improve lead generation.



Requirements

Required Skills
  • Strong knowledge of Google Ads.
  • Experience with Google Analytics (GA4).
  • Knowledge of Google Tag Manager (GTM).
  • Keyword research using Google Keyword Planner and other SEO tools.
  • Understanding of CPC, CPA, CTR, ROAS, Conversion Rate, and Quality Score.
  • Basic knowledge of SEO and landing page optimization.
  • Strong analytical and reporting skills.
  • Good communication and problem-solving abilities.

Preferred Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • Google Ads Certification is preferred.
  • Experience in B2B SaaS or Software Product Marketing is an added advantage.

Experience
  • 1–3 years of experience in Google Ads / SEM.
  • Freshers with Google Ads certification and hands-on project experience may also apply.

  Oplysning om indsamling af dine personoplysninger: 

 Ved udfyldelse af spørgeskemaet indhentes oplysninger om dit navn, e-mail, køn, CV og ansøgning. 


 Vi behandler de personoplysninger, du har afgivet i dette spørgeskema. Derefter indhenter og behandler vi eventuelt yderligere oplysninger om dine arbejdsevner fra referencer og sociale medier med henblik på en vurdering af dine kompetencer og erfaringer i relation til den pågældende stilling. På grundlag af alle disse oplysninger udarbejder vi en profil, som vi registrerer og opbevarer i en periode på 6 måneder. 


 Formålet med ovennævnte behandling af dine personoplysninger er en vurdering af dine kompetencer i forhold til det konkrete opslag hos virksomheden/organisationen, du har søgt ansættelse hos, samt i forhold til fremtidige stillinger. 


 Dine oplysninger i dette spørgeskema kan blive omfattet af en automatisk afgørelse, herunder profilering. Logikken bag denne afgørelse er brug af saglige kriterier, som gør det muligt at finde frem til de registrerede, som har de kompetencer, som søges til den pågældende stilling. 


 Behandlingen af dine personoplysninger er baseret på dit samtykke. 


 Dit samtykke til de ovennævnte behandlinger af dine oplysninger kan til enhver tid tilbagekaldes med det resultat, at registreringen af oplysningerne slettes. Tilbagekaldelse kan ske ved henvendelse til den dataansvarlige. 


 Dine personoplysninger vil blive opbevaret i en periode på 6 måneder og derefter slettet. 


 Det er frivilligt at besvare de stillede spørgsmål, men undlader du at besvare spørgsmålene, bevirker det, at den dataansvarlige ikke vil være i stand til at vurdere din kompetence på den forudsatte måde.

  Ansøg  

 Bilrådgiver søges til Cars Højbjerg
 

 Vil du være en del af en af Danmarks førende specialister i brugte elbiler?
 

 Hos Cars Højbjerg søger vi en engageret og resultatorienteret bilrådgiver med passion for bilsalg og kundeoplevelser.
 

 Er du en dygtig sælger med erfaring fra bilbranchen, og motiveres du af at skabe resultater i en virksomhed med høje ambitioner og stærk vækst, så er det måske dig, vi leder efter.
 

 Dine arbejdsopgaver
 

 Som bilrådgiver hos Cars bliver du en vigtig del af vores salgsteam. Du får en alsidig hverdag, hvor du blandt andet skal:
 

 •	Rådgive kunder om køb af brugte elbiler.
 

 •	Sikre en professionel kundeoplevelse fra første kontakt til bilen er afleveret.
 

 •	Udarbejde tilbud, finansieringsløsninger og byttebilsvurderinger.
 

 •	Præsentere bilernes funktioner og vejlede kunderne om elbilernes teknologi.
 

 •	Sikre, at salgsudstillingen altid fremstår indbydende og salgsklar.
 

 •	Bidrage aktivt til afdelingens salgsresultater.
 

 
  

 Vi forventer, at du
 

 •	Har minimum 2 års dokumenteret erfaring med salg af biler og kan fremvise gode salgsresultater.
 

 •	Er en dygtig købmand med forståelse for både kundens behov og forretningens mål.
 

 •	Er engageret, ansvarsbevidst og arbejder struktureret.
 

 •	Trives i et travlt miljø med højt tempo.
 

 •	Er udadvendt og brænder for at skabe gode kundeoplevelser.
 

 •	Har interesse for elbiler og ny teknologi.
 

 •	Er en holdspiller med en positiv indstilling.
 

 •	Har gyldigt kørekort (kategori B).
 

 
  

 Vi tilbyder
 

 •	En spændende hverdag i en virksomhed i markant vækst.
 

 •	Muligheden for at arbejde med et af Danmarks stærkeste udvalg af brugte elbiler.
 

 •	Dygtige og engagerede kolleger med stor erfaring.
 

 •	Attraktiv lønpakke efter kvalifikationer.
 

 •	Pension og sundhedsforsikring.
 

 •	Fri mobiltelefon.
 

 •	Gode muligheder for både faglig og personlig udvikling.
 

 •	En arbejdsplads med korte beslutningsveje, stærkt sammenhold og højt ambitionsniveau.
 

 
  

 Hvem er Cars?
 

 Cars er specialister i brugte elbiler. Med to store salgsforretninger har vi opbygget en stærk position som en af Danmarks førende virksomheder inden for køb og salg af brugte elbiler.
 

 Hos Cars kombinerer vi mange års erfaring fra bilbranchen med et stærkt fokus på kvalitet, professionel rådgivning og kundeoplevelser i særklasse. Vi hjælper hver dag kunder fra hele landet med at finde den helt rigtige elbil og gør en dyd ud af at skabe langvarige relationer.
 

 Vi er en virksomhed i markant vækst med høje ambitioner. Som medarbejder hos os bliver du en del af en organisation med korte beslutningsveje, højt tempo og gode udviklingsmuligheder.
 

 Vores kultur bygger på værdierne Glæde, Ordentlighed, Ansvarlighed og Tillid, og vi tror på, at de bedste resultater skabes gennem dygtige medarbejdere, stærkt samarbejde og et godt arbejdsmiljø
 

 
  

 Ansøgning

 Er du uddannet personlig træner og brænder for at give dine klienter de bedste resultater? Kunne du tænke dig at blive en del af landets største personlig træner-team samt få adgang til Danmarks største fitness medlemsbase?

 Som personlig træner i PureGym hjælper du vores medlemmer med at opnå deres mål gennem træningsforløb, der er karakteriseret ved konstant sparring, coaching og motivation.   

 En personlig træner hos PureGym karakteriseres ved at være energisk og udadvendt og trives blandt andre mennesker. Du brænder for personlig træning og er proaktiv i din tilgang til at skabe en klientbase blandt centerets medlemmer. 

 Vi forventer, at du leverer en høj kvalitet til vores medlemmer, skaber dit eget personlige brand for at tiltrække og fastholde klienter samt laver ulønnet lead-generende arbejde som fx foredrag, SoMe konkurrencer og andre proaktive tiltag.

 Udover dette, vil du som PT i PureGym blive en del af landets største personlige træner-team og vil få adgang til Danmarks største fitness medlemsbase.

 Send din motiverede ansøgning, CV samt eksamensbeviser snarest muligt. Da vi modtager rigtig mange ansøgere, kan du forvente en svartid på op til 3 uger.

title: Server - Koloa Landing

description:
POSITION PURPOSE

Provide friendly, courteous, and efficient quality presentation of food and beverage service to all guests. Clean and set tables in the outlet and perform other food service-related duties, including set up and general cleaning.

ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Greet all guests in a welcoming and friendly manner.
  • Take guest food and beverage orders.
  • Describe menu items, ingredients, and methods of preparation. Suggest menu products to customers.
  • Clear, clean, and reset tables as needed.
  • Verify customers identification and confirm it meets legal drinking age.
  • Ensure that minors and intoxicated persons are not served alcoholic beverages.
  • Perform opening and closing procedures, and side work duties according to station rotation assignment to ensure tables and side stands are kept stocked, tidy and clean.
  • Maintain the cleanliness of the restaurant area through disposing of all waste, clearing, and cleaning all glassware, and wiping down service and preparation areas.
  • Participate in the deep cleaning of the outlet.
  • Operate a cash register/POS and receive payment from customers in cash or credit card, accurately counts and provides change to customers as required, and follow all companys customer service and cash handling policies and procedures.
  • Assist all guests professionally and courteously, with the highest quality of standards for customer service.
  • All other duties assigned by manager or supervisor.

SUPPORTIVE FUNCTIONS

In addition to performance of the essential functions, this position may be required to perform a combination of the following supportive functions, with the percentage of time performing each function to be solely determined by the manager based upon the particular requirements of the hotel:

  • Assist with any guest inquiry.
  • Follow all company and safety and security policies and procedures.
  • Report maintenance problems, safety hazards, accidents, or injuries.
  • Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by direct and indirect Supervisors.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

  • Environmental conditions are inside, a job is considered inside if staff spends approximately 75 percent or more of the time inside. Temperature is moderate and controlled by hotel environmental systems.
  • Must be able to work in extreme temperatures like freezers (-10°F) and kitchens (+110°F), possible for one (1) hour or more.
  • Must be able to stand and exert well-paced mobility for up to four (4) hours in length.
  • Must be able to exert well-paced ability to maneuver between functions occurring simultaneously.
  • Must be able to exert well-paced ability in limited space and to reach other departments of the hotel on a timely basis.
  • Must be able to lift up to 45 lbs. as needed.
  • Must be able to push and pull carts and equipment weighing up to 250 lbs.
  • Requires grasping, writing, standing, sitting, walking, repetitive motions, bending, climbing, listening, and hearing ability and visual acuity.
  • Hearing, smelling, tasting, and visual ability to observe and distinguish product quality and detect signs of emergency situations.
  • Talking and hearing occur continuously in the process of communicating with other staff, guests, and supervisors.
  • Vision occurs continuously with the most common visual functions being those of near and color vision and depth perception.
  • Ability to work primarily with fingers to pick, pinch, type and carry out substantial movements (motions) of the wrists and hands as well.

SPECIFIC JOB KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES

The individual must possess the following knowledge, skills and abilities and be able to explain and demonstrate that he or she can perform the essential functions of the job, with or without reasonable accommodation, using some other combination of knowledge, skills, and abilities:
