title: Vice President Finance - Remote
description:
Job Description:

Job Title: Vice President of Finance
Location: Remote
Department: Finance
Employment Type: Full-time
Shift: Monday – Friday, 8:00 A.M. – 5:00 P.M.

Job Summary

The Vice President (VP) of Finance is a key member of Centerstone’s financial leadership team, reporting directly to the Chief Accounting Officer (CAO). The VP of Finance provides strategic financial leadership, analytical insight, and operational oversight across the organization’s financial planning, analysis, and reporting functions.

This role partners closely with the CAO, CFO, and other senior leaders to drive financial excellence, optimize performance, and support data-informed decision-making across all markets and service lines. The VP of Finance will play a critical role in aligning financial strategies with Centerstone’s mission, vision, and long-term growth objectives.

Essential Job Functions

Strategic Financial Leadership

  • Partner with the CAO and CFO to define and execute financial strategies that support Centerstone’s strategic goals, mission delivery, and sustainable growth.

  • Provide expert guidance and analysis to senior leadership to support organizational decision-making, forecasting, and resource allocation.

  • Lead development of multi-year financial plans and long-range forecasts to ensure fiscal sustainability and mission alignment.

  • Support the CAO in maintaining a strong internal control environment and compliance with all financial regulations, accounting standards, and audit requirements.

Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A)

  • Oversee the preparation, consolidation, and analysis of annual budgets and forecasts in collaboration with operational and regional leaders.

  • Develop and refine key financial metrics and performance dashboards to monitor operational performance and identify improvement opportunities.

  • Lead ongoing variance and trend analyses to provide actionable insights on revenue, expenses, and capital utilization.

  • Drive financial modeling and scenario planning to support strategic initiatives and market expansion efforts.

Operational & Market Support

  • Partner with Market Presidents, State CEOs, and operational leaders to provide financial guidance and support decision-making at all organizational levels.

  • Serve as a strategic advisor on pricing, cost structure, service line profitability, and capital investments.

  • Ensure financial processes and reporting align with operational goals and provide transparency across markets and departments.

Accounting & Compliance Collaboration

  • Work closely with the CAO and accounting teams to ensure accuracy and integrity in financial statements and reporting.

  • Support compliance with GAAP, state and federal regulations, and organizational accounting policies.

  • Partner in the development of accounting policies and procedures that ensure efficiency, consistency, and compliance across the enterprise.

Leadership & Team Development

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing finance team focused on collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.

  • Promote a culture of transparency, integrity, and fiscal responsibility throughout the finance function.

  • Encourage professional development and career growth within the finance and accounting departments.

Performance Improvement & Systems

  • Lead initiatives to streamline financial processes, enhance use of technology, and strengthen data integrity across financial systems.

  • Evaluate and implement best practices to improve efficiency, accuracy, and reporting capabilities.

  • Support integration of financial systems following mergers, acquisitions, or organizational restructuring.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Healthcare experience

  • Multi-state operations experience

  • Strong leadership and team-building skills with the ability to influence across organizational boundaries.

  • Deep understanding of healthcare finance, reimbursement, cost management, and financial reporting.

  • Exceptional analytical, quantitative, and problem-solving abilities.

  • Demonstrated expertise in budgeting, forecasting, and financial modeling.

  • Advanced proficiency in financial management systems and tools (ERP, reporting platforms, Excel).

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills with the ability to translate complex data into actionable insights for non-financial leaders.

  • High degree of integrity, confidentiality, and professional judgment.

Experience and Education Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or related field required.

  • Master’s degree (MBA, MHA, or related) or CPA designation strongly preferred.

  • 10+ years of progressive finance leadership experience, preferably within healthcare, behavioral health, or nonprofit sectors.

  • Proven experience leading financial operations in multi-entity or multi-state environments.

  • Demonstrated success working within complex organizational structures with shared services or matrixed reporting.

Supervisory Responsibilities

  • Directly supervises finance leaders and analysts as designated by the Chief Accounting Officer.

  • Provides leadership, direction, and professional development opportunities to all team members.

  • Collaborates with accounting, operations, and executive leadership to ensure cohesive financial performance across the organization.

Position Perks & Benefits:

Paid time off: full-time employees receive an attractive time off package to balance your work and personal life

Employee benefits package: full-time employees receive health, dental, vision, retirement, life, & more

Top-notch training: initial, ongoing, comprehensive, and supportive

Career mobility: advancement opportunities/promoting from within

Welcoming, warm, supportive: a work culture & environment that promotes your well-being, values you as human being, and encourages your health and happiness

Brightli is on a Mission:

A mission to improve client care, reduce the financial burden of community mental health centers by sharing resources, a mission to have a larger voice in advocacy to increase access to mental health and substance user care in our communities, and a mission to evolve the behavioral health industry to better meet the needs of our clients.

As a behavioral and community mental health provider, we prioritize fostering a culture of belonging and connection within our workforce. We encourage applications from individuals with varied backgrounds and experiences, as we believe that a rich tapestry of perspectives strengthens our mission. If you are passionate about empowering local communities and creating an environment where everyone feels valued and supported, we invite you to join our mission-driven organization dedicated to cultivating an authentic workplace.

We are an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer.

Brightli is a Smoke and Tobacco Free Workplace.

title: Program Coordinator/ Lead DSP
description:
What You Get to Do:

The Program Coordinator (PC) is the lead direct support professional for an assigned Supported Living Program in Lakewood, WA and will be responsible providing direct support, hands-on instruction, assistance, and positive direction to individuals with intellectual/developmental disabilities (I/DD) in a manner that ensures their health, safety, successful achievement of service objectives, and personal goals.

This is not a supervisory role. The Program Coordinator reports directly to the Program Director.

  • Enrich and support the lives of our residents while maintaining a safe and healthy environment
  • Provide companionship and personalized care while encouraging independence and self-care.
  • Assist clients with activities of daily living, including dressing, bathing, grooming, toileting, and eating.
  • Prepare meals and snacks. May include grocery shopping.
  • Perform light housekeeping and laundry duties.
  • Assist with transportation needs for community outings, appointments, and errands
  • Implement behavior supports and de-escalation during challenging behaviors
  • Provide mobility and transfer assistance, which may include using mechanical lift devices.
  • Administrative duties such as assisting with schedules, one-on-one training of staff, documentation and follow-up of individual and program related issues, and ensuring compliance with policies and Oregon Administrative Rules.
  • Other duties as assigned

Why This Role:

  • Personal fulfillment, a meaningful career, and the chance to make a difference.
  • Positively impact someone’s life.
  • Gain health care experience to further your career

What Makes You A Great Fit:

  • 2+ years of caregiver experience required (experience supporting adults with intellectual and developmental disabilities is preferred)
  • Valid driver's license required
  • NAR Preferred
  • Must be at least 21 years old
  • HS Diploma or GED required
  • Have a passion to help others through person-centered care
  • People-oriented and have a team approach
  • Dependable, adaptable, and flexible
  • Good communication is key in this role. You’ll rely on your reading, writing, and communication skills to document care, follow support plans, and collaborate with both internal and external team members.
  • Able to attend two weeks of PAID in-house orientation and training

We believe in supporting not only those we serve but also each other, ensuring a collaborative and supportive work environment for all. Udadvendt Udviklingskonsulent til Personaleudviklingsafdelingen

Har du forståelse for organisatoriske forandringsprocesser? Kan du forestille dig at bidrage til at omsætte strategiske udviklingsinitiativer til konkrete handlinger og brænder du for kompetenceudvikling? Så har du nu mulighed for at blive en del af organisationsudviklingsteamet i Grønlands næststørste arbejdsplads, Kommuneqarfik Sermersooq, med 2.500 andre kollegaer.

Ansvarsområder:

 Skabelse af et læringsmiljø, der fremmer kompetenceudvikling blandt alle medarbejdere.

 Design og facilitering af onboardingprocessen for nye ledere.

 Deltagelse i udviklingen af forandringsprocesser, herunder implementering af bæredygtige tiltag.




Kvalifikationer:

 Kompetencer inden for forandringsledelse eller organisatorisk udvikling.

 Evne til at arbejde tværfagligt og engagere medarbejdere på alle niveauer.

 Kendskab til grønlandsk og dansk er påkrævet; engelskkundskaber er en fordel.




Om afdelingen: 

Du bliver ansat i vores Personaleudviklingsafdeling, hvor du vil arbejde tæt sammen med fire kolleger i et ambitiøst og stærkt udviklingsorienteret team, som brænder for at skabe værdi i organisationen. I teamet har vi en bred kontaktflade til direktionen og lederne på tværs af kommunen. Vi har en imødekommende kultur og stort engagement i teamet, hvor vi løfter i flok og prioriterer faglig sparring, kollegial opmærksomhed og gode grin meget højt i hverdagen. Med ansvar for kommunens sundhedsarbejde for medarbejderne, værner vi om den sociale trivsel for alle medarbejdere.

Vi tilbyder en spændende og udfordrende stilling i en organisation, der vægter udvikling og medmenneskelighed højt. Hvis du har passion for at skabe positive forandringer og ønsker at bidrage til vores medarbejderes kompetenceudvikling, ser vi frem til at modtage din ansøgning.

Denne stilling er omfattet af lov om pligt til at indhente straffeattest. I henhold til loven kan ansættelsen først begynde, når kommunen har modtaget en straffeattest. Løn- og ansættelsesforhold sker i henhold til gældende overenskomst mellem Grønlands Selvstyre, i henhold til den på tiltrædelsestidspunktet gældende aftale/overenskomst mellem Grønlands Selvstyre og pågældende forhandlingsberettigede organisation.

Er du drevet af relationer, ansvar og resultater, og vil du være med til at styrke salget af Mercedes-Benz Vans i Storkøbenhavn?



Bliv en del af vores erhvervsteam

Hos Van Mossel søger vi en dygtig og ambitiøs erhvervsrådgiver til vores forretning i Søborg. Vi leder efter dig, der motiveres af at udvikle forretning, opbygge stærke kunderelationer og skabe resultater i et marked med stort potentiale.

Du bliver en del af et team på mere end 10 erhvervsrådgivere fordelt på fire Mercedes-Benz lokationer i Storkøbenhavn. Sammen arbejder vi hver dag for at give vores kunder professionel rådgivning, de rette løsninger og en oplevelse, der gør os til deres foretrukne samarbejdspartner.

Din daglige arbejdsplads bliver i Søborg. Du vil derfor være centralt placeret i et af landets mest attraktive erhvervsområder med et stort opland og en omfattende bilpark, som giver dig optimale muligheder for at udvikle både nye og eksisterende kunderelationer.



Vi tilbyder

Hos Van Mossel bliver du en del af en ambitiøs organisation i vækst, hvor vi investerer i vores medarbejdere og tror på frihed under ansvar.

Adgang til en eksisterende kundeportefølje med stort udviklingspotentiale.

	
En central rolle i et stærkt og erfarent erhvervsteam.

	
Stor frihed til selv at planlægge og udvikle din forretning.

	
Et godt internt netværk på tværs af afdelinger og lokationer.

	
Løbende uddannelse, produkttræning og personlig udvikling.

	
En kultur præget af samarbejde, godt humør, respekt og en fælles ambition om at skabe resultater.

	 




Du er vigtig for vores fælles succes

Som erhvervsrådgiver bliver du ansvarlig for både at udvikle eksisterende kunderelationer og skabe nye forretningsmuligheder.



Dine primære arbejdsopgaver bliver:



	
Salg af Mercedes-Benz varebiler til erhvervskunder.

	
Professionel rådgivning omkring et af markedets mest omfattende varevognsprogrammer.

	
Rådgivning om finansielle løsninger, leasing, serviceaftaler og øvrige mobilitetsprodukter.

	
Opsøgende salgsarbejde og aktiv bearbejdning af markedet.

	
Udvikling og vedligeholdelse af butikkens netværk af erhvervskunder.

	
Systematisk opfølgning og dokumentation i CRM-systemet.

	
Bidrage til at sikre fortsat vækst i vores erhvervsforretning.






Hvem er du?

Du motiveres af at skabe relationer og opbygge forretning. Du tager ansvar for dine egne resultater og trives med at være synlig hos kunderne.



Derudover forestiller vi os, at du:



	
Har erfaring med salg af varebiler og kan dokumentere gode salgsresultater.

	
Har et solidt kendskab til gældende regler og lovgivning inden for varebiler.

	
Arbejder struktureret og er stærk til CRM og kundeopfølgning.

	
Er en stærk kommunikator med naturlig gennemslagskraft.

	
Bidrager positivt til samarbejdet på tværs af organisationen.

	
Trives med klare mål, høj aktivitet og ambitiøse forventninger.




Som person håber vi du er initiativrig, tillidsvækkende og vigtigst af alt en god kollega. Du forstår, at langsigtede kunderelationer skabes gennem troværdighed, faglighed og en oprigtig interesse for kundens forretning.





Lyder det som noget for dig?

Så send dit CV hurtigst muligt. Vi afholder samtaler løbende og lukker opslaget, når den rette kandidat er fundet. Stillingen er med opstart snarest muligt.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte CEO Johnny Bruun-Pedersen på Johnny.Bruun.Pedersen@vanmossel.dk.

Hos Van Mossel er vi en del af en stolt, familieejet koncern, der bygger på 77 års erfaring og en dybt forankret passion til bilbranchen. På tværs af Van Mossel Automotive Group står vi skulder ved skulder, mere end 11.200 dedikerede medarbejdere, der sammen skaber noget helt særligt.

Med et stærkt afsæt i vores gæstfrihed og en dyb respekt for hver eneste kunde stræber vi efter at gøre en forskel, som kan mærkes og ses.                         Mestrer du nyheder, breaking og liveblogs?
På TV2.dk søger vi en journalist, der er vild med nyheder. Dig, der er optaget af at følge historier tæt, skabe overblik og udkomme i liveblogs, mens dagsordener udvikler sig minut for minut.

Hver dag bruger omkring 1,3 millioner danskere TV2.dk for at få overblik over de vigtigste begivenheder i Danmark og verden. Derfor søger vi en journalist med solid faglighed, godt overblik og lysten til at levere den bedste live- og nyhedsdækning, når historierne udfolder sig.
Om jobbet
Din vigtigste opgave bliver at dække de store dagsordener i liveblogs, nyhedsartikler og overbliksformater.

Når nyheder bryder ud, er du med til at sikre, at danskerne får den hurtigste og bedste dækning. Du følger historierne tæt, skaber overblik og samarbejder med redaktører, korrespondenter og kolleger på tværs af TV 2. Sammen sikrer vi, at brugerne får den hurtigste, mest præcise og relevante dækning.

Uanset om det handler om dramatiske begivenheder i Danmark eller store internationale nyheder, skal du kunne omsætte information til skarp og troværdig journalistik i højt tempo. Og så er du motiveret af at finde den helt rigtige kilde, der giver både indsigt og ny viden.

Det er heldigvis ikke hver dag, at nyhederne buldrer derudaf, og vi sætter stor pris på journalister med egne ideer. Har du en original historie eller et perspektiv, der fortjener mere plads, får du mulighed for at udvikle den og udnytte at arbejde i et stort mediehus.
Vi leder efter dig, som:
Har erfaring med digital nyhedsjournalistik

Trives med breaking news og hurtige deadlines

Kan bevare overblikket og får energi af at dække en historie, mens den udvikler sig

Skriver hurtigt, præcist og sikkert

Udviser god, journalistisk dømmekraft

Viser engagement og bidrager med gode idéer

Er god til at samarbejde og bidrager positivt til redaktionen

Du er uddannet journalist eller har en anden relevant uddannelse.

Vi forestiller os, du kan klippe videoer - men det er ikke et krav.

Din arbejdsplads er på Teglholmen i København.
Om redaktionen
TV2.DK's nyhedsredaktion i København består af cirka 30 journalister. Sammen med kollegerne i Odense leverer vi nyheder til danskerne fra tidlig morgen til sen aften.

Derfor skal du være indstillet på skæve arbejdstider, herunder weekendarbejde. Redaktionen i København arbejder primært i morgen- og dagtimerne.

På TV2.dk prioriterer vi både faglig udvikling og et tæt kollegialt fællesskab. Du får løbende sparring fra redaktører og kolleger, mulighed for at udvikle dine kompetencer og bliver en del af en redaktion med stort engagement og godt sammenhold.

Samarbejde og trivsel er afgørende for, at vi skaber resultater. Vi søger derfor en journalist, der sætter en ære i at være en god kollega og bidrage konstruktivt og positivt i hverdagen.

Redaktionen samles til månedsmøder med faglige oplæg, diskussioner og øvelser, ligesom vi afholder sociale teamdage.
TV 2 som arbejdsplads 
TV 2 er Danmarks kommercielle public service virksomhed. Vores opgave er at begejstre, oplyse og forbinde - at skabe indhold, der samler danskerne på tværs af TV 2 Play, tv2.dk og vores kanaler. Vi er ejet af den danske stat og leverer public service på kommercielle vilkår.

Som moderne virksomhed arbejder vi hver dag for at gøre public service personlig - med målet om at samle alle - en for en i en tid med ændrede medievaner og skarp international konkurrence. title: CRM Lifecycle Specialist - Careers - LEGO.com
description:
CRM Lifecycle Specialist  
 

 
 
 
 
 
 Share on: 
 
     

     
  

  Apply now   
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
  
 

 
  
  
 Management Level 
 Professional   

  
 Job ID 
 0000036513   

  
 Category 
 Sales, Marketing & Product Management   

  
 Location 
 København K, Denmark   
  
 
 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 Job Description 
 Are you passionate about developing impactful member experiences and supporting CRM lifecycle development across a global membership ecosystem? 
  

 Join us for an exciting career as CRM Lifecycle Specialist as part of the Membership & Personalisation team within Market & Channels Central Marketing. 

  

 Bring your structured mindset, stakeholder collaboration skills and passion for CRM Lifecycle to help develop connected, personalised and commercially impactful member experiences across the LEGO Insiders ecosystem. 

  

 Please note the work location is in Copenhagen, Denmark and no relocation assistance is offered for this role.                           
   Core responsibilities  
 Lifecycle Strategy Development: Support the Senior Manager, Lifecycle & Triggers in developing CRM lifecycle strategies across the member journey to enhance engagement, retention and long-term member value. 

 Opportunity Identification: Use data, insights and intent signals to identify member behaviours, trends and lifecycle opportunities that can help shape relevant lifecycle initiatives. 

 Cross Functional Collaboration: Work cross-functionally with key stakeholders to support the development and delivery of CRM lifecycle initiatives. 

 Lifecycle Planning & Prioritisation: Support lifecycle planning and development, including lifecycle architecture, prioritisation and roadmap opportunities. 

 Stakeholder Collaboration: Build strong stakeholder relationships and support alignment to ensure lifecycle journeys reflect wider membership and commercial strategies. 

 Lifecycle Journey Development: Partner with the CRM Hub and Product teams to help shape and deliver connected lifecycle experiences across LEGO branded channels. 

 Performance Optimisation: Review lifecycle performance and use insights to identify future optimisation and member engagement opportunities. 
  
   
 
 
  Play your part in our team succeeding     
 

 
   Our team collaborates across multiple business areas to   identify   and unlock opportunities that strengthen the LEGO® membership experience across the full member journey.      

  
 

 
   By working closely with   the   CRM Hub,   P  roduct   teams   and commercial stakeholders, we help shape connected lifecycle experiences that create value both for members and for the business.      
 

 
  

   You will report directly to the    Director CRM & Personalisation    and play   an important role   in shaping the future direction of Lifecycle   journeys   at the LEGO Group.      
 

 
      
  Do you have what it takes?     
 
 

 
  
 
   Experience working with CRM lifecycle, membership,   loyalty   or customer engagement initiatives.      
 
  

  
 
   Ability   to support cross-  functional     initiatives   and   build     strong   stakeholder   relationships     across   teams and   functions  .      
 
  

  
 
   Strategic and   commercial   mindset with the   ability   to   translate     insights  ,   member     behaviours   and business   opportunities     into     actionable     lifecycle     initiatives  .      
 
  

  
 
   Experience     working   with data,   customer     insights   and   behavioural   signals to support   prioritisation   and decision   making  .      
 
  

  
 
   Strong   project   management   skills  , with the   ability   to   manage   multiple   initiatives  ,   stakeholders   and   dependencies  .      
 
  

  
 
   Excellent   communication   and   collaboration     skills  , with the   ability   to   create     clarity   and alignment   across     different     audiences  .      
 
  

  
 
   Good   understanding   of CRM   capabilities   and   how     they     can   support   personalised     lifecycle     experiences  .      
 
  

  
 
   Positive,   proactive   and relationship driven team player who thrives in collaborative environments and is comfortable working with ambiguity.        
 
 
  

   #LI-SG2   

   #LI-Hybrid   
 
 

  

 Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis. However, please note we do amend or withdraw our jobs and reserve the right to do so at any time, including prior to any advertised closing date. So, if you're interested in this role we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

title: Principal Product Manager
description:
Overview

We are hiring for a Principal Product Manager with a proven track record of building AI-driven, scalable advertising products that deliver measurable ROI for advertisers while ensuring the right level of targeting and controls to meet advertiser needs.

In this role you will own the vision, strategy and roadmap for Microsoft Advertising’s Smart Bidding products. You will partner closely with Data Science, Engineering, UX, Product Marketing, Legal, and Finance to design solutions that aim to maximize advertiser value.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Starting January 26, 2026, Microsoft AI (MAI) employees who live within a 50- mile commute of a designated Microsoft office in the U.S. or 25-mile commute of a non-U.S., country-specific location are expected to work from the office at least four days per week. This expectation is subject to local law and may vary by jurisdiction.



Responsibilities
  • Deep AI/ML expertise with a proven ability to integrate AI-first thinking into strategy.
  • Solid technical background (APIs, infrastructure, AI modeling).
  • Track record of defining product vision that drives significant business impact.
  • Expert stakeholder management and ability to influence senior leadership.
  • Solid analytical skills with OKR/KPI definition and tracking experience.
  • Go-to-market planning and product launch experience.


Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree AND 8+ years experience in product/service/program management or software development
    • OR equivalent experience.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree AND 12+ years experience in product/service/program management or software development
    • OR equivalent experience.

title: Process Associate
description:
Sistema.bio, we work with farmers to improve life on Earth.

Sistema.bio is a global social enterprise working with farmers to improve life on Earth. Founded in 2010 in Mexico, we provide innovative biodigester technology, training, and financing that enable farmers to convert organic waste into renewable energy and organic fertilizer.

Sistema.bio operates in more than 20 countries across Africa, Asia, and Latin America and has supported over 150,000 farms to date. Through our work, we help reduce greenhouse gas emissions, strengthen farm resilience, and promote regenerative agricultural practices.

At Sistema.bio, we believe that accelerating the transition to renewable energy, reducing global emissions, and advancing regenerative farming are essential to building a thriving planet for current and future generations. Our mission drives action at the intersection of food security, climate change, and social equity.

You have the opportunity to become an integral part of this impactful story!


Your mission at Sistema.bio:

Reporting to the Global Head of Manufacturing & Supply Chain, the Planning Associate will be responsible for vendor coordination, production planning, BOM management, and SAP operations for smart meter manufacturing at Sistema.bio's Pune (Chakan) factory, while supporting PPC and export logistics as needed. The role requires a proactive, process-driven professional with experience in electronics or electromechanical manufacturing, capable of independently managing vendors and building efficient systems and documentation.


You’ll be in charge of:

  • Managing end-to-end vendor communication, including sourcing, quality clarifications, delivery follow-ups, and sample approvals.
  • Coordinating with the London engineering team to implement engineering requirements, ECNs, and BOM updates into production and procurement.
  • Maintaining the Production Planning & Control (PPC) schedule by tracking production, mitigating risks, and ensuring material availability.
  • Managing SAP master data, including BOMs, routings, production orders, and goods receipts, ensuring SAP remains the single source of truth.
  • Supporting PPC and export logistics, including shipping documentation, freight coordination, and end-to-end order tracking.
  • Qualifying and managing local vendors through technical evaluations, sample validation, quotations, and Approved Vendor List (AVL) maintenance.
  • Developing SOPs, process documentation, and tracking systems to standardize manufacturing and logistics operations.
  • Coordinating with test rig and hardware suppliers to ensure assembly fixtures and test equipment are available, calibrated, and production-ready.


More about YOU:

Education:

  • B.E. / B.Tech in Electronics, Electronics & Telecommunication, Mechatronics, Mechanical or Production Engineering
  • Diploma with strong practical background also considered

Experience:

  • 3 to 4 years in manufacturing (electronics, electromechanical, or plastics-to-electronics)
  • Hands-on experience in vendor coordination, procurement, or PPC
  • Working knowledge of BOM structures, ECN management, and production scheduling
  • Exposure to automated test rigs or hardware assembly interfaces preferred
  • SAP (MM / PP modules) experience strongly preferred

Key Skills:

  • Able to read and interpret engineering drawings, BOMs, and technical specs
  • Comfortable working with both factory floor teams and remote design engineers
  • Experienced in export documentation: packing lists, commercial invoices, HSN codes
  • Strong written and spoken English (daily coordination with London team)
  • Proficient in Excel and G-Suite


What we offer:

✨ Passion and Purpose:
Join a dynamic social impact company, certified B Corp and immerse yourself in an environment where passion, a strong mission and collaborative spirit converge.

🌍 Global Team, Local Impact: Be part of our incredible international team comprising over 300 colleagues across 3 continents. Experience the power of working together toward a common goal that transcends borders.


🍃Balance matters: We understand that your best work comes from a rested and healthy state. Embrace our commitment to work-life balance with a flexible and accommodating work environment designed to suit your needs.


👐 Embrace diversity: Join a vibrant workplace with colleagues representing more than 15 nationalities. At Sistema.bio, inclusivity and diversity are not just values; they are the essence of our culture.


🌱 Grow with us: We foster an autonomous work environment that empowers you to contribute, develop, and take ownership of your projects and work. Join our team of doers in a fast-paced environment where there are plenty of opportunities to grow and learn.


🐄 Farmers are at the heart of what we do: Our mission, strategies, and day-to-day operations revolve around supporting farmers. We are committed to creating a positive impact on their lives, ensuring our work is always aligned with their needs and challenges.


Our values are FIRE 🔥

Farmer-Centric: We are inspired by the passion and hard work of farmers in all we do

Impact-driven: We are focused on cultivating positive change on Earth

Resourceful: We are proactive and efficient, weeding out challenges as they pop up

Ethical: Trust, transparency, reliability, and respect to cultivate healthy relationships


Your journey with us is not just a job; it's a chance to make a lasting impact.

Sistema.bio is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome and encourage diversity in the workplace regardless of gender, race or color, ethnicity or national origin, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression.

title: Auditor 2nd shift
description:
We are seeking a skilled and detail-oriented Quality Assurance Auditor to join our Quality team. This role is crucial in ensuring that our molded products meet rigorous quality standards. The successful candidate will have a strong background in quality assurance within an injection molding manufacturing environment, with a focus on accurate auditing, detailed observation, and adherence to standards.

Job duties include, but not limited to:

  • Conduct regular audits of injection mold processes to ensure compliance with quality standards and specifications.
  • Perform detailed inspections and observations of molded parts, identifying any deviations from quality standards.
  • Complete and maintain accurate documentation and records related to quality audits and inspections.
  • Understand and apply SOS (Standard Operating Systems) procedures and Visual Criteria to ensure consistent product quality.
  • Collaborate with production and quality teams to address and resolve any quality issues or non-conformances.
  • Clearly communicate audit findings and recommendations to management and other relevant team members.
  • Perform first article inspection to ensure successful process start up
  • Other duties as assigned.

title: Founding Growth & Delivery Lead
description:
About Lightfield

Lightfield is an AI-native CRM that assembles itself from your email, calendar, and meetings. It captures every interaction and turns it into organized context: accounts, tasks, follow-ups, and insights, so nothing slips through the cracks.

We’re rethinking CRM from first principles. Instead of forcing teams to maintain rigid systems, Lightfield learns from how companies actually work, adapting, automating, and surfacing the insight that drives growth. We’re building the CRM platform we always wished existed: fast, intelligent, and genuinely helpful.

We are backed by Greylock, Lightspeed, and Coatue, and our founders previously built Tome, a generative AI presentation product used by over 25 million people. Before Lightfield, our team worked on Llama, Instagram, Facebook Messenger, Pinterest, Google, and Salesforce.

About the Role

We're hiring a founding member of our Growth & Delivery team.

The team activates customers on the Lightfield platform, delivers their pipeline generation motion, supports strategic deals alongside our leadership team, and drives special projects across GTM and business operations.

You'll work directly with founders and their teams to build their customer memory on Lightfield, put agents to work generating pipeline, and help their business grow. The agents do the work—you bring the judgment and taste that guide them, and the advisory relationship with the customer.

You're both an operator and a builder: running many customer engagements at once, and turning what works into playbooks the whole team can run.

What you’ll do

  • Activate new customers on Lightfield: set up their workspace, migrate their data, build their customer memory, and enable their team, so Lightfield becomes the system their company runs on

  • Deliver pipeline generation for a portfolio of customers: understand each business, define the ICP and targeting strategy, and direct Lightfield's agents from first outreach to booked meetings

  • Advise founders and GTM leaders on their go-to-market: what to target, what to say, and what to try next

  • Own the outcomes: time-to-activation, meetings booked, and the quality of the pipeline behind them

  • Support strategic deals alongside our leadership team, from scoping POCs to helping convert evaluations into customers

  • Take on special projects across GTM and business operations, from business analysis to competitive research to new initiatives

  • Turn what works into playbooks, and feed what you learn back to product so the agents get better

Who you are

  • 3+ years of experience in consulting, banking, investing, or go-to-market and operating roles

  • A strong generalist, comfortable across delivery, growth, and customer-facing work. You don't wait to be handed a lane and instead figure out what needs to happen and do it

  • A trusted advisor to founders and GTM leaders - curious and analytical, able to read a business and its customers quickly, move from qualitative signals to a clear hypothesis, and back your view with data.

  • A systems thinker who brings structure to open-ended problems and builds playbooks and repeatable processes, not just completed tasks

  • High agency and thrives in ambiguity, able to independently drive projects and deliver results in a fast-moving environment

  • You're excited about AI agents and the opportunity to deliver customer outcomes with them

  • Eager to learn GTM and outbound. Prior experience is a plus, not a prerequisite

Benefits & Perks

  • Competitive salary

  • Meaningful early equity

  • Health insurance (medical, dental, vision)

  • 3 weeks of PTO

  • 11 paid company holidays + we enjoy a winter holiday break

  • 3 months of paid family leave

  • Wednesdays work from home

  • Regular team dinners, events, offsites, and retreats

  • 401k plan

  • Other perks include: commuter and lunch stipend

title: Software Engineer
description:
Worker Type

Regular

Job Description

As a Software Enginee r at AV, you’ll develop software to control advanced robotic platforms from AV and industryleaders including Boston Dynamics, Red Cat, FLIR, Skydio, QinetiQ, Parrot, and more. You’ll play a key role in developing Kinesis, our flagship software ecosystem that enables users to collaboratively control a diverse set of robots.

This role is ideal for engineers who take ownership, enjoy working hands-on with hardware, and bring structure and clarity to complex systems. You’ll be trusted to move quickly, make sound decisions, and continuously improve our product and execution.

Position Responsibilities:

  • Software development in support of AV’s vision-based navigation, autonomy, cooperative behaviors, and mission systems technology roadmap.

  • Design, implement, and integrate systems in C++ and Kotlin.

  • Develop cross-platform applications for Android, Linux, and Windows to control robotic platforms.

  • Design SDK interfaces for internal and external integration with AV systems.

  • Perform hands-on field testing with robots to validate new features.

  • Delivers work on time according to agreed completion dates and project schedule & budget.

  • Supports and derives algorithm design from detailed software requirements.

  • Works closely with multiple teams of software developers reusing developed software to support different programs.

  • Operates in a continuous learning environment and provides guidance and mentoring to less experienced engineers.

  • Works on significant and unique issues where analysis of situations or data requires an evaluation of intangibles.

  • Acts independently to determine methods and procedures on new or special assignments.

  • Occasional travel for customer or testing events.

  • Other duties as assigned.

Basic Qualifications (Required Skills & Experience):

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Math, or Physics is required or equivalent combination of education, training, and experience with 5+ years of relevant experience.

  • Strong fluency in modern C++, maintainable software architecture, and modular system design

  • Experience evaluating product design tradeoffs and translating them into clear system requirements

  • Hands-on knowledge of CMake or similar build systems

  • Experience developing software for mechatronic or hardware-integrated systems

  • Knowledge of computer networking topologies, protocols, and principles

  • Self-directed engineer who takes ownership and brings structure to complex systems

  • Ability to engage directly with technical and non-technical customers

  • Ability to leverage AI tooling to improve engineering productivity and code quality

  • Ability to obtain a US DoD Secret clearance if required

  • Willingness to travel locally (Occasionally)

Other Qualifications & Desired Competencies:

  • Advanced degree is preferred

  • Familiarity with safety critical software concepts such as determinism and real-time systems

  • Experience with UAS, drones, robotics, autonomous vehicles, or other embedded systems

  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines (Gitlab or similar)

  • Android/Linux application development experience

  • Experience with Docker

  • Experience with FastDDS, gRPC, MQTT, or similar networking protocols

  • Experience designing and delivering APIs and SDKs to third-party developers

  • Demonstrates leadership skills and sound judgment in selecting methods and techniques for obtaining solutions

  • Demonstrates effective listening, questioning, clarifying and summarizing skills to effectively communicate in one-on-one and small group settings

  • Demonstrates understanding of system design that one is working on and understands the role that assigned tasks play in the system

  • Able to excel in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment, where small teams share a broad variety of duties

  • Displays strong initiative and drive to accomplish goals and meet company objectives

  • Takes ownership and responsibility for current and past work products

  • Is committed to learning from mistakes and driven to improve and enhance performance of oneself, others, and the company

  • Has effective problem-solving, analytical, interpersonal and communication skills

  • Focuses on teamwork, collaboration and puts the success of the team above one's own interests

Physical Demands:

  • Ability to work in an office environment (Constant)

  • Required to sit and stand for long periods; talk, hear, and use hands and fingers to operate a computer and telephone keyboard (Frequent)

Special Requirements:

  • U.S. Citizenship i s required.

  • Occasionally may be required to travel within the Continental U.S.

ITAR Requirement:

This position requires access to information that is subject to compliance with the International Traffic Arms Regulations (“ITAR”) and/or the Export Administration Regulations (“EAR”). In order to comply with the requirements of the ITAR and/or the EAR, applicants will be asked to provide specific documentation to verify U.S. person status under the ITAR and the EAR. A “U.S. person” according to their definition is a U.S. citizen, U.S. lawful permanent resident (green card holder), or protected individual such as a refugee, or asylee. See 22 CFR § 120.15. Some positions will require current U.S. Citizenship due to contract requirements.

Benefits: AV offers an excellent benefits package including medical, dental vision, 401K with company matching, a 9/80 work schedule and a paid holiday shutdown. For more information about our company benefit offerings please visit: http://www.avinc.com/myavbenefits.

We also encourage you to review our company website at http://www.avinc.com to learn more about us.

Principals only need apply. NO agencies please.

Who We Are

Based in California, AeroVironment (AVAV) is a global leader in unmanned aircraft systems (UAS) and tactical missile systems. Founded in 1971 by celebrated physicist and engineer, Dr. Paul MacCready, we’ve been at the leading edge of technical innovation for more than 45 years. Be a part of the team that developed the world’s most widely used military drones and created the first submarine-launched reconnaissance drone, and has seven innovative vehicles that are part of the Smithsonian Institution’s permanent collection in Washington, DC.

Join us today in developing the next generation of small UAS and tactical missile systems that will deliver more actionable intelligence to our customers so they can proceed with certainty – and succeed.

What We Do

Building on a history of technological innovation, AeroVironment designs, develops, produces, and supports an advanced portfolio of unmanned aircraft systems (UAS) and tactical missile systems. Agencies of the U.S. Department of Defense and allied military services use the company’s hand-launched UAS to provide situational awareness to tactical operating units through real-time, airborne reconnaissance, surveillance, and target acquisition.

title: Bioinformatics Software Engineer II
description:
Labcorp is a global leader in laboratory services, providing the insights and answers that help healthcare providers, patients, researchers, pharmaceutical companies and health systems make confident decisions and improve outcomes. Through our unparalleled science, data, technology and laboratory network, we advance diagnostics, accelerate innovation and help address some of the world’s most important health challenges. As we shape the future of healthcare, we are leveraging advanced technologies, intelligent digital solutions and data-driven innovation across our operations to enhance how work gets done and deliver greater value to customers and patients. With our global scale and deep expertise, you’ll have the opportunity to do meaningful work, grow your career and make a real impact on people’s health around the world. Together, we’re improving health and improving lives.


Labcorp is seeking a US based remote Bioinformatics Software Engineer II to join our team!

Job Responsibilities:

Every part of our organization relies on software. As a Bioinformatics Software Engineer, you will be producing software and documentation that will directly impact our products, customers, and patients.

Personal Genome Diagnostics (PGDx), a part of LabCorp, is Empowering the Fight Against Cancer by unlocking actionable information from the genome. We are developing an innovative portfolio of tissue-based and non-invasive liquid biopsy genomic products for laboratories worldwide.

  • Actively participate in all facets of design, development, testing, and maintenance of robust software and systems to support PGDx products and services.

  • Strategize with leadership to solve challenging problems

  • Follow the software development lifecycle in an agile environment

  • Contribute to software and project requirements

  • Contribute to the architecture and design of software

  • Ensure data and software quality by designing and implementing test methodologies

  • Ensure the security of the information systems, software, communication lines, and equipment

  • Provide reports to managers and staff on systems and software, including capabilities, performance, and security

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Bioinformatics, Biology, Computer Science, or Software Engineering

  • 2 or more years of experience in software engineering

  • 2 or more years of experience with Python, PERL, R, C/C++, Java, or BASH

  • 2 or more years of experience with Next Generation Sequencing (NSG), pipeline development or machine learning

Preferred Qualifications

  • PhD in Bioinformatics, Biology, Computer Science, or Software Engineering

  • 2 or more years of experience in Bioinformatics

  • 2 or more years of experience with Algorithm development

  • 2 or more years of experience with Angular, React, or JavaScript

  • 2 or more years of experience with Django, or RESTful APIs

  • 2 or more years of experience with SQL, or NoSQL

  • 2 or more years of experience with agile software development methodology and practices, git source control, and Atlassian tools (JIRA, Confluence, Bitbucket, Bamboo).

Additional Job Standards

  • Familiarity with concepts in genomics and bioinformatics analysis of cancer

  • Demonstrated knowledge with Workflow systems

  • Ability to effectively perform in a Linux environment

  • Team-first attitude and entrepreneurial spirit

  • Ability to deliver within fixed deadlines

  • Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to learn quickly on the job

At Labcorp, you can expect the following:

  • Innovative Environment: Join a leading healthcare organization committed to driving innovation through internal development to help improve health and improve lives.

  • Collaborative Culture: Work in a dynamic, inclusive environment that values diverse perspectives and fosters collaboration.

Application window open through: 08/01/2026

Pay Range: $100-$140k annually (USD)

All job offers will be based on a candidate’s skills and prior relevant experience, applicable degrees/certifications, as well as internal equity and market data.

Benefits: Employees regularly scheduled to work 20 or more hours per week are eligible for comprehensive benefits including: Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, STD/LTD, 401(k), Paid Time Off (PTO) or Flexible Time Off (FTO), Tuition Reimbursement and Employee Stock Purchase Plan. Employees regularly scheduled to work less than 20 hours, Casual, Intern, and Temporary employees are only eligible to participate in the 401(k) Plan. title: Talentech - Technical Engineer for DEIF A/S
description:
Technical Engineer for DEIF A/S 


  

 

 

 


 





 


 

 

 

 

 Do you have a strong technical background and a passion for solving complex customer challenges? Are you looking for a role where you can provide expert guidance, enhance service capabilities and ensure the effectiveness of the global service organisation? Then this opportunity is for you! 


 

 DEIF A/S is a global leader in power efficiency, driving the green transition through advanced and innovative energy solutions. With 700 employees worldwide, we’re pursuing an ambitious growth strategy with a strong focus on sustainability. Our goal is to set new standards in energy efficiency and conversion - and become the market leader in intelligent energy control. 


 

 About the job
 
At DEIF A/S, we specialise in the development and manufacturing of electronic devices designed to seamlessly control and switch between various energy sources, including solar, wind, diesel, and batteries, for efficient and reliable power production. As Technical Engineer, you’ll join the Global 2nd line Service Team in DEIF, consisting of 9 colleagues. You’ll serve as the primary technical expert, providing top-tier support to customers, partners, and internal teams. Your role will include consulting customers and partners in pre- and after-sales activities in complex cases, driving service improvements, and ensuring close collaboration between Service, Sales and R&D.
 

 
“This role is perfect for someone who enjoys solving complex technical issues while mentoring and sharing knowledge with colleagues and other stakeholders", says Palle Lind Nielsen, Department Manager.
 

 
“It’s not just an exciting job - it’s also incredibly versatile. One day, you might be helping a marine customer troubleshoot a complex power management setup on a vessel, and the next, advising a partner on how to integrate our controllers into a hybrid energy system." 



 Main responsibilities and tasks 


 
	
 Provide expert-level technical support and troubleshooting for complex customer cases 

	
 Build structures (tools and ways of working) and foster global cooperation between global teams 

	
 Manage big troubleshooting issues and drive product quality issues through R&D and suppliers 

	
 Provide feedback to Product Management and R&D to improve product quality 

	
 Manage the development of new products from a service perspective and anchor the knowledge in all our subsidiaries 

	
 Collaborate with Sales and engage in both pre- and after-sales activities 

 


 The working place is based in Skive, Denmark. Danish language skills are an advantage but not required. 



 What you’ll bring 


 
	
 A degree in Electrical Engineering, Marine Engineering, Automation Technology or similar 

	
 Some experience as a Service Engineer, Application Engineer, or in a related role 

	
 Familiarity with Power Management and protection devices is a plus 

	
 Good English skills in speaking and writing   

 

 
	
 Strong interest in using various digital tools 

	
 Familiarity with PLC programming, ideally with CODESYS (IEC 61131-3, ST) is as plus 

 


 As a person, you thrive in a collaborative environment and are comfortable navigating complex technical challenges. You take initiative, embrace ambiguity, and stay resilient when handling demanding service cases. Most importantly, you have a strong drive to help customers succeed and a passion for continuous learning. 



 What You Can Expect from Us
 
At DEIF A/S, you’ll be part of a highly professional and supportive work environment. Guided by our core values of Ambition, Perspective, and Respect, we cultivate a culture where trust, accountability, and innovation thrive. We believe in investing in our people and encouraging strong collaboration across our global organisation. 



 In addition to a role filled with exciting challenges, we offer you: 


 
	
 Flexible work arrangements, including home office days 

	
 The opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies in state-of-the-art facilities 

	
 On-the-job training and knowledge sharing with skilled employees 

	
 In-house canteen and physiotherapist at our headquarters 

	
 Fitness breaks, social events, and much more supporting your wellbeing. 

 


 Want to know more about working at DEIF? Visit our  career page  today! 



 How to apply
 
Send your application and CV as soon as possible on our website  https://career.deif.com/recruitment/job-openings/ . We expect interviews to be conducted on an ongoing basis. 



 If you want to learn more about the position, feel free to contact Department Manager of Global Service, Palle Lind Nielsen on e-mail pln@deif.com.

The duration of the course is approximately half hour, but you can easily browse and choose the content that makes most sense to you. The purpose is to give you the opportunity to succeed - even before you start. Sign up for the course here:  https://hrcaseforum.simplero.com/page/192181-deif-applicant “

title: Senior BIM Engineer - Mechanical (DK)
description:
Incumbent will be the part of WSP in India – Denmark MEP Team (P&B). He/she will be responsible to carryout the mechanical services engineering designs for various building projects, as on required. Work with other engineers and perform calculations in coordination with our Denmark / India engineers.

Technical
• Focus on the delivery of high-quality technical design drawings and specifications to the required regulations
• Develop the technical capabilities of the team
• Contribute to technical solutions on projects
• Initiate and participate in design peer reviews
• Ensure internal quality procedures are followed
• Keep up to date with industry developments with respect to own discipline and appreciate the basic technical principles and drivers of other disciplines
• Assist and support mentorship for junior engineers within the team
• Attending project meetings with the various other teams in India

Manage project delivery and leadership
• To act as project manager (PM) on selected projects by managing the successful delivery of high quality multi and single disciplinary projects
• Design, review and deliver high quality technical mechanical services engineering designs, drawings, specifications, and reports to the required regulations.
• In conjunction with team lead in India and lead country identify, assess, and manage project risks and secure the best commercial return from the project.
• To ensure statutory and regulatory requirements are met.
• Ensure project programs are met and advise on any foreseen delays
• Participate and support internal multi-discipline knowledge sharing initiatives.
• Identify and flag additional fees to the local CRC Head of MEP

Key Competencies / Skills:
Mandatory Skills
• The applicants should possess a degree in Mechanical Engineering
• The applicant will have proven experience in the HVAC & Plumbing services engineering designs with significant experience in a similar role or demonstration of a good track record.
• Must be technically good in heat load and ventilation load calculations, duct & pipe sizing and pressure drop calculations
• Must be technically good in equipment selection such as ventilation fans, Chillers, AHUs, FCUs, boilers, pumps etc.
• Carryout preparation of technical submittals of various materials, equipment’s etc.,
• Hands on experience on drafting/3D modelling software’s like AutoCAD, MEP Revit etc.
• Preferred familiarity with technical software’s, such as HAP, Hevacomp, IES, SES etc.
• Must be fluent in English with an excellent understanding of technical terminology.
• Experience of delivering international projects.
• The role requires involvement in numerous projects from an early stage to providing fit for construction stage designs
• Good working knowledge of BIM software packages
• Proven ability to produce detailed drawings (plans, sections & details) from engineers’ basic sketches
• Excellent working knowledge of REVIT Software (version 2021 and above). Including HVAC and plumbing services modelling, content creation (parametric and non-parametric families), coordination with structural and MEP elements, Revit schedules, managing work sets/ links/ visibilities, sheet setup and collaboration.
• The successful candidate will be a dynamic, self-motivated individual who will take on a key role in project work, focused on timely delivery and technical excellence.
• The role requires involvement in numerous projects from an early stage.
• Experience and knowledge in MagiCAD for AutoCAD/Revit will be value added.
• Excellent command of written and verbal English
Desired Skills
• A sound understanding of Microsoft Outlook, Word, Excel, Project is essential
• Must be fluent in English with an excellent understanding of technical terminology.
• Should possess membership to an accredited engineering body i.e., ISHRAE, ASHRAE, CIBSE, IMechE, European Buildings Codes & Standards
• Work towards achieving EngTech/IEng/Chartered engineer/professional license
• Applicants need to be able to demonstrate good management and technical skills and be capable of working both within the team and independently, as dictated by workload
• Excellent oral and written communication skills
• Punctual and able to meet deadlines.

• Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical Engineering
• Minimum of 12 years relevant work experience
• Experience of MS Office Suite of Programs
• Comprehensive experience of technical design and associated discipline software

BGV:

• Employment with WSP India is subject to the successful completion of a background verification (“BGV”) check conducted by a third-party agency appointed by WSP India.

• Candidates are advised to ensure that all information provided during the recruitment process — including documents uploaded — is accurate and complete, both to WSP India and its BGV partner”.

title: Manufacturing Domain Leader
description:
At DuPont, our purpose is to empower the world with essential innovations to thrive. We work on things that matter. Whether it’s providing clean water to more than a billion people on the planet, producing materials that are essential in everyday technology devices from smartphones to electric vehicles, or protecting workers around the world. Discover the many reasons the world’s most talented people are choosing to work at DuPont. Why Join Us | DuPont Careers

Transform the Future of Manufacturing at DuPont

At DuPont, we’re reimagining how world-class manufacturing organizations operate by combining Operational Excellence, advanced technologies, and the DuPont Business System to drive breakthrough business performance.

We are seeking a visionary Manufacturing Domain Leader to shape and accelerate our global manufacturing excellence strategy. This is a highly visible leadership role that will influence operations across multiple businesses and manufacturing sites around the world. Reporting directly to the Vice President, Operational Excellence, you will serve as a key member of the Global Operational Excellence Leadership Team and help define how manufacturing excellence is deployed across one of the world's most iconic industrial companies.

If you are passionate about operational transformation, business systems, Lean manufacturing, and building global capabilities that deliver measurable results, this is an opportunity to make a lasting impact at scale.

What You'll Do

As the Manufacturing Domain Leader, you will lead a global team of manufacturing subject matter experts responsible for developing and deploying world-class manufacturing standards, tools, playbooks, and best practices that improve productivity, agility, safety, quality, and business performance across DuPont.

You will:

  • Define and drive DuPont's global manufacturing excellence strategy across multiple businesses and manufacturing sites.
  • Lead the creation, deployment, and continuous improvement of manufacturing standards, toolkits, and operational excellence playbooks based on industry-leading practices.
  • Partner closely with Business Operational Excellence Directors, Integrated Operations Leaders, and functional leaders across Supply Chain, Quality, Reliability, and Maintenance to deliver sustainable improvements in SQDIP performance.
  • Build and strengthen manufacturing capability by developing practitioner training, certification programs, and communities of practice.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to manufacturing and business leaders, facilitating workshops, Kaizen events, performance improvement initiatives, and strategic transformation programs.
  • Develop robust manufacturing performance metrics, analytics, and "single sources of truth" that enable data-driven decision making from the plant floor to the executive leadership team.
  • Collaborate with Digital, Engineering, Automation, and IT leaders to maximize value from manufacturing technologies and IT/OT systems.
  • Integrate manufacturing excellence tools and practices into the evolving DuPont Business System to create a consistent approach across the enterprise.
  • Foster a culture of continuous improvement, accountability, and operational excellence throughout the organization.

Why This Role Matters

This is far more than a traditional operational excellence role.

You will help shape the future of manufacturing across a global enterprise undergoing significant transformation. Working alongside senior leaders, you will influence strategy, drive execution, and build capabilities that impact thousands of employees and manufacturing facilities worldwide.

You'll have the opportunity to:

  • Lead enterprise-wide transformation initiatives.
  • Influence manufacturing performance across multiple global businesses.
  • Build and scale world-class operational excellence practices.
  • Develop future manufacturing leaders and practitioners.
  • Drive measurable improvements in safety, quality, delivery, productivity, and cost.
  • Help embed the DuPont Business System across the organization.

What We're Looking For

Leadership Experience

  • 15+ years of manufacturing, production, or operations leadership experience, including significant time spent supporting plant operations.
  • Demonstrated success leading large-scale operational excellence or manufacturing transformation initiatives.
  • Proven ability to influence and collaborate with leaders at all levels of the organization, from plant operations to executive leadership.
  • Experience leading and developing high-performing teams in a matrixed, global environment.

Operational Excellence Expertise

  • Deep expertise in Lean Manufacturing, Continuous Improvement, Kaizen, and Operational Excellence methodologies.
  • Experience deploying structured business systems such as the Danaher Business System, Toyota Production System, Honeywell Operating System, or similar frameworks.
  • Lean Six Sigma Black Belt or equivalent certification is preferred.
  • Strong track record of delivering measurable year-over-year improvements in operational performance.

Manufacturing & Technical Knowledge

  • Strong understanding of manufacturing systems, operations management, and plant performance drivers.
  • Experience creating manufacturing standards, best practices, playbooks, and capability-building programs.
  • Ability to leverage data and operational metrics to identify opportunities and drive sustainable results.
  • Experience partnering with digital, engineering, automation, and IT teams to improve manufacturing performance.

Change Leadership

  • Demonstrated experience leading organizational change and Management of Change (MoC) processes.
  • Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution.
  • Highly collaborative leadership style with strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Passion for building a culture of accountability, continuous learning, and operational excellence.

Location & Travel

Preferred Location: Wilmington, Delaware (DuPont Corporate Headquarters), Midland, Michigan, Minneapolis, Minnesota.

Travel: Approximately 50% global travel to manufacturing sites and business locations.

Join our Talent Community to stay connected with us!

DuPont is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, national origin, age, veteran status, disability or any other protected class. If you need a reasonable accommodation to search or apply for a position, please visit our Accessibility Page for Contact Information.

DuPont offers a comprehensive pay and benefits package. To learn more visit the Compensation and Benefits page.

The Pay range for this role is $168,000.00 - $264,000.00 Annual

How Base Pay is Determined: DuPont has job leveling frameworks that help organize roles based on progressive levels of responsibility, proficiency and qualifications. Each role has an associated pay range (or an established pay rate for some roles) based on the competitive market in each country where we operate. Each individual’s pay is based on a variety of factors, including their role and the associated pay range for that role, their geographic location (i.e., country, state, metropolitan area), as well as their skills, experience, education and certifications, and performance.

 Som Junior Event Specialist hos nabogo får du:  
 
 Et lærerigt, spændende og udfordrende job 
 

 
 En attraktiv lønpakke med bonusordning 
 

 
 Et stærkt og støttende team, der vil hjælpe dig med at vokse og udvikle dine karrieremuligheder 
 

 
 En stilling, som kan være med til at udvikle dine formidlings- og kommunikative evner 
 

 
 Et arbejde, der fremmer den grønne omstilling 
 
 
   
 Hvem er vi? 
 Nabogo er en app-baseret scale-up, der gør det nemt at samkøre til gavn for både klimaet og sammenhængskraften i land og by. Vi samarbejder med kommuner, regioner, trafikselskaber og virksomheder for at sikre mere bæredygtig transport i hverdagen. Som en del af vores team får du mulighed for at bidrage til en grønnere fremtid. 

   
 Hvem er du?  
 
 Du er i gang med en bachelor eller lige startet på en kandidatuddannelse 
 

 
 Du elsker at møde nye mennesker og kan tale med både studerende og medarbejdere fra store virksomheder - og er god til smalltalke 
 

 
 Du er opsøgende i feltet og tør at tage direkte kontakt til mennesker 
 

 
 Du er proaktiv i samtaler, og hvis dialogen ikke opstår naturligt, tager du initiativet og skaber den 
 

 
 Du har et kæmpe drive, er nysgerrig og siger aldrig nej til en god challenge 
 

 
 Du er performancedrevet og resultatskabende og arbejder målrettet på konstant at hæve dit niveau i feltet 
 

 
 Du er struktureret, løsningsorienteret og tager ansvar uden at tøve 
 

 
 Du har interesse i at blive en fantastisk kommunikatør og tør stå foran en forsamling 
 
 
   

 Men vigtigst af alt er din imødekommende personlighed og din entusiasme for at møde nye mennesker og skabe den direkte kontakt til vores lokale brugere. 

   
 Praktisk information:  
 
 Deltidsstilling med base i enten Odense eller Vejle - ansøgning er mulig uanset lokation 
 

 
 Minimum 10 timer om ugen - vær opmærksomhed på, at vagter vil forekomme i dagtimerne på hverdage, med respekt for dit studie og eksamener. Arbejdet er sæsonpræget, så forvent flere arbejdstimer slut august til slut november og igen midt januar til slut april 
 

 
 Forventet opstart i juli eller august 
 

 
 Der vil være rejseaktivitet i Danmark ifm. events og kampagner 
 

 
 Dansk på et højt niveau er et krav for denne stilling 
 
 
   

 Kan du se dig selv i rollen? Så er det nu, du skal slå til! 

   

 Send din ansøgning og dit CV til job @ nabogo.com senest den 24. august 2026. Vi afholder løbende samtaler. 

 Det er kun ansøgninger sendt til mailen, som vil komme i betragtning. 
   
 
   For more information or questions please contact us at   carolina@nabogo.com

 Are you motivated by creating clarity in complex environments and turning strategy into execution?  



 As a Product Manager, you will play a critical role in strengthening the product management discipline across Vestas, creating the frameworks, insights, and operating rhythm that help our product organization make better decisions, move faster, and deliver greater customer value.  



   


 Vestas Technology & Operations > Product Line Onshore > Product Management ONS  


 Product Line Onshore is the strategic driving force behind VTO’s product success, with end-to-end accountability for competitiveness, customer value, and business outcomes. Acting as the voice of the customer within VTO and the voice of VTO towards customers, the function ensures that market needs, customer insights, and business priorities are translated into a compelling product vision and roadmap. 


 It steers the product portfolio, investment decisions, budgets, and key cross-functional initiatives to maximize value creation and long-term performance. In essence, the Product Line function aligns the organization around clear priorities, enabling efficient execution, innovation, and sustainable growth while delivering superior customer value. 


   


 Responsibilities 


 As a Product Manager, you will help define and maintain the operating framework for our product management organization. You will drive performance transparency, coordinate annual product planning cycles, facilitate portfolio governance, and establish the tools, templates, and processes that enable consistent and effective product management across the business. 


 Working across the value chain, you will connect market insights, product strategy, business performance, and development priorities to support fact-based decision-making and long-term portfolio success. 

 

 Own and continuously improve the product management operating framework, including governance processes, performance reporting, planning cycles, and decision-making structures 


 Coordinate the annual product planning process, ensuring alignment between market needs, business priorities, product roadmaps, and development activities 


 Develop and maintain standardized business case methodologies, templates, value frameworks, and supporting tools to enable consistent evaluation of investment opportunities and strategic initiatives 


 Drive visibility of product and portfolio performance through robust reporting, KPI tracking, and management insights that support senior leadership decision-making 


 Facilitate the development and maintenance of market, product, and portfolio roadmaps, ensuring clear prioritization and alignment across key stakeholders 

 

   


 Qualifications 

 

 Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Business, Economics, or a related field 


 Relevant experience in renewable energy, electric utilities, industrial manufacturing, management consulting, strategy, product management, portfolio management, or business performance management 


 Experience developing business cases, investment evaluations, financial analysis, or strategic planning materials 


 Strong analytical capabilities with the ability to transform data into actionable business insights 


 Experience coordinating complex initiatives across multiple stakeholders and functions 


 Excellent communication and presentation skills with the ability to structure information for senior leadership audiences 

 

   


 Competencies 

 

 Strategic thinker with a strong customer and market orientation 


 Demonstrated ownership mentality with a focus on delivering measurable business results 


 Ability to lead through influence, creating alignment and momentum without formal authority 


 Strong decision-making capability, balancing data, business judgement, and customer value 


 Collaborative and resilient leader who thrives in complexity and drives progress through ambiguity 

 

   


 What we offer 


 This is a unique opportunity to influence and elevate product management practices within one of the world's leading renewable energy companies. You will gain direct exposure to strategic portfolio decisions while partnering with senior leaders across product, technology, commercial, and operational teams. 


 The role offers the chance to establish and enhance the frameworks, governance models, and ways of working that drive long-term business growth and deliver sustainable customer value. Working in a global, highly collaborative environment, you will be encouraged to demonstrate initiative, take ownership, and contribute to a culture of continuous improvement. 


 Guided by our core values of Collaboration, Simplicity, Accountability, and Passion, we foster an inclusive workplace where diverse perspectives are embraced and innovation thrives through collective expertise and shared ambition. 


   


 Additional information 


 The primary work location for this position is Aarhus (Denmark), Porto (Portugal) or Hamburg (Germany). 


 Up to 60 days of travel per year. 


 We do amend or withdraw our jobs and reserve the right to do so at any time, including prior to the advertised closing date. Please be advised to apply on or before 30th August 2026. 


   


   

    
 

   


 Our commitment to a fair hiring. 


 At Vestas, we evaluate all candidates solely based on their professional experience, education, and relevant skills. To support a fair recruitment process, we kindly ask that you remove any photos, dates of birth or graduation, gender pronouns, marital status, or other personal information not relevant to the role before submitting your CV/resume. Your CV/resume should focus on your professional and educational background, along with the necessary contact details (email and phone number). We train our hiring teams in inclusive evaluation and regularly review process outcomes to ensure fairness. 


   



  
 At Vestas, we recognize the value of diversity, equity, and inclusion in driving innovation and success. We strongly encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply, particularly those who may hesitate due to their identity or feel they do not meet every criterion. As our CEO states, "Expertise and talent come in many forms, and a diverse workforce enhances our ability to think differently and solve the complex challenges of our industry". Your unique perspective is what will help us powering the solution for a sustainable, green energy future.

title: Technician IV, Manufacturing (Quality Assurance and Contamination Support)
description:
Summary of the Role:

As a Technician IV, Manufacturing (Quality Assurance and Contamination Support), you are responsible for ensuring contamination control, cleanroom compliance, and manufacturing readiness by performing area certifications, qualifications, environmental monitoring, equipment qualification, and preventive maintenance. You support investigations, audits, training, and continuous improvement initiatives while collaborating with cross-functional teams to maintain quality, operational, and regulatory compliance through effective documentation, reporting, and contamination control practices.

Key Responsibilities and Role Accountabilities:

  • Conducts area certification and line qualification
  • Checks and monitors cleanroom parameters
  • Conducts IDM Qualification, supports IMQF requirement, and IDM process-related investigation activities
  • Supports manufacturing area qualification for both cleanroom and normal room after Planned/Unplanned Shutdown, scheduled Technical Cleaning and Disinfection activity
  • Conducts investigations and collaborates with the Corporate Real Estate & Workplace team to resolve issues/problem
  • Supports any stakeholder area verification or investigation request
  • Executes special area contamination audits of Supplier’s manufacturing area, warehouse, and production areas
  • Conducts machine and fixture qualification activities
  • Performs routine preventive maintenance
  • Supports the change room and laundry engineering process
  • Monitors and controls jumpsuit cleanliness and Laundry KIV/KOV monitoring activities
  • Conducts an investigation into jumpsuit and laundry-related issues
  • Conducts contamination awareness and training
  • Monitors Talc spot check activity
  • Supports contamination control projects and standardization
  • Assists with documentation and other relevant reports

Education and Work Experience:

  • Associate or Bachelor's degree in Electronics Technology, Electromechanical Technology, Industrial Technology, Electrical Technology or a related field of study.
  • Atleast 2 years of work experience in contamination control, environmental monitoring or manufacturing quality assurance.
  • Industry exposure in Electronics or Semiconductor Manufacturing setup is highly preferred.
  • Experience in conducting investigations, root cause analysis, implementing corrective and preventive actions is highly desirable.
  • Experience supporting preventive maintenance, technical cleaning, manufacturing shutdown recovery and production area readiness is an advantage

Skills and Competency Requirements:

  • Knowledge of qualification, validation, and manufacturing quality processes.
  • Strong analytical skills with attention to detail and a commitment to quality.
  • Effective planning, prioritization, and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across cross-functional teams.
