title: Software Development Engineer - macOS Endpoint
description:
Diversity. Inclusion. They’re more than just words for us. They are the guiding values of how we build our teams, cultivate leaders, and create a culture where people feel connected.

We take care of our employees so they can take care of our customers. Customers who come from all walks of life just like us. We hire incredible people from diverse backgrounds because when we are different together, we are stronger together.

The Role

As a Software Development Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in developing our endpoint security solution for macOS. You will work as part of a multi-disciplinary team, delivering outcomes primarily by directing agentic AI development tools and applying the engineering judgement to steer, challenge and rigorously review what they produce. This is an exceptional opportunity to work at the leading edge of endpoint security, on software that protects Mac users across thousands of organisations.

What You’ll Do

  • Design, build and maintain the macOS client at the heart of our endpoint security solution — code that must stay fast, resilient and unobtrusive on every user’s Mac
  • Help shape the architecture of new features and services, providing technical direction on increasingly complex projects
  • Review functional and technical requirements to identify gaps, and limitations, propose simplifications and communicate ideas effectively with cross-functional teams
  • Take accountability for code quality — whether produced by agentic AI tools or fellow engineers — through rigorous code review and pull-request feedback, ensuring unit testing and departmental guidelines are consistently met. Where no formal guidelines exist, work with peers to formulate and enforce such guidelines.
  • Develop and improve build, deployment and test automation within your team.
  • Help identify, prioritize and resolve technical debt within your team.
  • Collaborate with your team to ensure work items are well defined and understood, and that value is delivered with quality on every sprint.
  • Investigate and resolve customer issues escalated to engineering, and feed what you learn back into the product.
  • Track emerging macOS and security technologies and put forward improvements to the team’s tools and development processes.
  • Become the go-to development expert for at least one area of the product, deepening that expertise over time.

What You’ll Bring

  • A degree in a software engineering discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
  • A strong software engineering background, with significant hands-on development experience and specialist depth in at least one technical area.
  • Hands-on macOS platform development, with proficiency in Swift, Objective-C and/or C++, and experience building systems-level or endpoint security software.
  • Hands-on experience with macOS, including management and development of launch daemons and launch agents, unified logging, development of XPC components.
  • Demonstrable, hands-on experience directing agentic AI development tools such as Claude Code — framing problems well, challenging weak output, and critically reviewing generated code for correctness, security and maintainability.
  • Experience of formal software development methodologies.
  • At least 2 years’ commercial software engineering experience for the Software Development Engineer level; typically, 5 or more years, including demonstrable technical leadership, for the Senior Software Development Engineer level.

Nice To Have

  • Experience working with Qt
  • Experience working with Apple’s System Extension framework (Endpoint Protection)
  • Knowledge and experience working with Apple’s authorization system
  • Experience working with the sudo plugin framework.
  • Knowledge of macOS kernel and the Mandatory Access Control Framework (MACF)
  • Domain or product expertise in an area relevant to the role — or a demonstrated ability to build that expertise quickly.
  • Relevant professional qualifications or certifications.

Who You Are

  • Proactively learns new technologies and quickly builds the skills the role requires.
  • Mentors other team members on the workings of the product under development.
  • Adapts well to change and thrives in multi-disciplinary teams that form around a specific goal, maintaining performance and supporting others as priorities shift.
  • Identifies opportunities to improve development activities, reducing waste and increasing efficiency.
  • Actively shares knowledge with colleagues inside and outside the team.
  • Communicates clearly, verbally and in writing, tailoring the message to different audiences and stakeholders.
  • Brings a strong engineering background and consistently delivers high-quality, robust and maintainable solutions.

Better Together

Diversity. Inclusion. They’re more than just words for us. They are the guiding values of how we build our teams, cultivate leaders, and create a culture where people feel connected.

We take care of our employees so they can take care of our customers. Customers who come from all walks of life just like us. We hire incredible people from diverse backgrounds because when we are different together, we are stronger together.

About Us

BeyondTrust is the global identity security leader protecting Paths to Privilege™. Our identity-centric approach goes beyond securing privileges and access, empowering organizations with the most effective solution to manage the entire identity attack surface and neutralize threats, whether from external attacks or insiders.

BeyondTrust is leading the charge in transforming identity security to prevent breaches and limit the blast radius of attacks, while creating a superior customer experience and operational efficiencies. We are trusted by 20,000 customers, including 75 of the Fortune 100, and our global ecosystem of partners.

Learn more at www.beyondtrust.com.

Teamets ansvar og ambitioner

Udarbejde guides, instruktioner og procesdokumentation

	
Bidrage til løbende forbedring og opdatering af arbejdsgange og processer

Er nysgerrig på IT-drift, service management og digitalisering

	
Arbejder struktureret og har sans for detaljer

	
Kan koordinere opgaver og følge dem til dørs

	
Kommunikerer klart og professionelt på både dansk og engelsk

	
Har erfaring med Microsoft 365 og gerne SharePoint

Hos AJ Vaccines bliver du en del af et engageret IT-team, hvor samarbejde, vidensdeling og udvikling er en naturlig del af hverdagen. Arbejde tæt sammen med IT-ledelsen og erfarne specialister

	
Få indsigt i kontrakt- og licensstyring, dokumentation, processer og kommunikation

	
Omsætte teori fra studiet til konkrete opgaver i en international virksomhed

	
Udvikle både faglige og personlige kompetencer i et fleksibelt studiejob

	
Være en del af en uformel og samarbejdsorienteret kultur, med mulighed for løbende at få større ansvar

 Med andre ord, du får et job, hvor du og resten af teamet får en umiddelbar belønning for jeres arbejde, når I giver kunderne den gode indkøbsoplevelse med smil og kvalitet, og når I skaber den helt særlige forbindelse til en lille kunde, der får et ønske opfyldt. 

 Din opgave er først og fremmest at sikre, at kunderne får et fantastisk besøg hos os gennem god vejledning, smilende og imødekommende betjening, en indbydende og lækker butik, og du har overskud til leg, nysgerrighed og små pilfingre. 

 Skab den rette stemning 
  Din arbejdsdag foregår hos kunderne i butikken, hvor du vejleder, hjælper og sørger for, at butikken altid er indbydende. Du er en ægte teamplayer, der tager ansvar og giver en kollega en hånd med, så I sammen når i mål. 

 Hvem er vores nye kollega? 
  Vi ser gerne, at du har erfaring eller en uddannelse fra detailbranchen. Hvis du har produkterfaring vil det være en stor fordel, hvis ikke, klæder vi dig godt på til jobbet. 
 
 Du er serviceminded, fleksibel og kan bevare overblikket, når situationen kræver det. 

 Du har fokus på kunderne og en fantastisk service, og du bidrager til det gode sammenhold i teamet. 

 Du kan lide, at der er travlt og drives af den energi, en fyldt butik giver. 
 
 Vi kan tilbyde dig 
  et spændende job med masser af udfordringer for et af Danmarks mest kendte brands af både børn, deres forældre og bedsteforældre. 

 Er det dig? 
  Så send os din ansøgning hurtigst muligt gennem linket her på siden. 

 Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

title: The Hub | Head of Growth | All Gravy
description:
Head of Growth  
 Arbejdsgiver All Gravy Copenhagen Full-time 
 
 
 
 
  
 
 
 
          Salary
           Competitive  
   
  
 
   
 
  
 
   
 
 
 
   
 If you'd love to build out and scale our marketing operation, you're a real numbers- and structure person, and you'd like to own the results marketing creates, come join us! 

 We ran on intuition and gut feel to begin with. Then we got smarter, and started having success with paid ads. We know how to build the creatives, we have nailed a handful of winning concepts, and the creative engine is running smoothly. 

 Now, we're ready to build the next evolution of our growth engine: a marketing machine where every dollar is accountable, learnings get locked in, every winning concept gets scaled, every loser gets killed fast, and the whole thing compounds. 

 The creative input is there. What we need now is the person who owns the outcomes, the weekly performance, and decides what to scale, what to cut, what to test, and what to build. 

 If you want to be the technical heavyweight in All Gravy's marketing team, keep reading! 

  The mission 

 All Gravy is the frontline operating system. One platform for everything from comms to learning to handbooks and checklists, with built-in AI. Think WhatsApp meets Duolingo meets Claude for frontline workers. Used daily by brands like GAIL's, Dishoom, 7-Eleven, and Honest Burgers. 

 We're growing 3x year-over-year, backed by Moonfire, Scale Capital, and operators who've built billion-dollar companies. We just closed fresh funding. We're hiring, scaling fast, and the best is yet to come.  

  The role 

 You'll join the Marketing team as the counterweight to our creative resources. Our current team produces, writes, films, and publishes. You are what we need to level up our game: data-driven, analytical, thorough, structured. Together we develop the next iteration of All Gravy's growth engine. 

 Your main job is performance marketing. We run a lot of paid social - 95% Instagram and Facebook - and we need to constantly get better at knowing and scaling what works. 

 (That being said, you don't need a ton of experience running social ads. It's less about acing Facebook Campaign Manager, and more about owning the inbound motion as a whole.) 

 What you own: 
 
 
 Running our paid social engine end-to-end: budget, setup, monitoring, deriving next actions 
 

 
 Deciding what to scale, what to kill, and where to make variations of winning concepts 
 

 
 Building the reporting and attribution so we always know what's actually driving growth 
 

 
 Feeding creative insight back to the team: which hooks, formats, and angles convert 
 

 
 Owning the decisions on when to 2x, 3x, 5x the budget to find the limits to our growth 
 
 
 Plus the exciting bet: you'll head the growth of our new product-led (PLG) motion - a self-serve entry point into the All Gravy platform. This is a green-field track, it's going live as you read this, and it's yours to grow. Incredible early traction - huge potential in the SMB segment. 

  What you'll grow 
 
 
 Next phase of our paid engine, with a testing system that separates creative winners from noise 
 

 
 The reporting layer that turns spend into decisions - reporting the whole team trusts 
 

 
 A self-serve PLG funnel from first touch to activation, and the growth loops that make it compound 
 

 
 An operating rhythm for marketing: how we produce, test, measure, decide, and repeat at constantly higher speeds 
 
 
  You'll thrive here if you 
 
 
 Live in the data - analytics, attribution, and tooling are second nature. You can build the tool with Claude or similar, the dashboard and read the story in it 
 

 
 Have done growth inside a fast-moving B2B SaaS scale-up, so you know how to move fast without breaking anything 
 

 
 Are structured and thorough by default. You bring order, systems, and follow-through where others forget 
 

 
 Get excited by PLG and self-serve growth - even if you've not run one end-to-end, you're hungry to build it 
 

 
 Care more about impact than opinion. You want the number to move, not to win the argument 
 

 
 Speak and write excellent English - we're scaling across the UK, US, Germany, and Nordics 
 
 
   The unfair advantages 
 
 
 You'll partner up with a small, but productive marketing team who can supply the creative input needed to succeed with both the current funnel and future PLG motion 
 

 
 An in-house production house (Video Producer + Editor) shipping fresh creatives weekly 
 

 
 Best-in-class tools - and unlimited Claude tokens to move faster than teams twice your size 
 

 
 A product that frontline workers actually love - which makes it extremely fun to market 
 

 
 A green-field PLG track - most growth people wait years for a bet this size to be handed to them 
 
 
  Where this goes 

 3 months: You've got a grip on the paid engine. Reporting is trustworthy, the testing system is running, and you're already making scale/kill calls with confidence. 

 6 months: Paid is compounding, and the PLG motion has its first 100 self-serve users flowing through our funnel. 

 Beyond: As we scale into new markets, you grow the growth function - and turn the PLG track into a real, self-serve growth machine for All Gravy. 

  Perks & vibes 
 
 
 A smart, kind, ambitious team that's in the middle of winning big 
 

 
 High-pace, high-trust environment with ex-founders and scale-up pros 
 

 
 Autonomy to experiment and the budget to back it up 
 

 
 Healthy snacks & sodas in an always-stocked fridge 
 

 
 Team events - socials, offsites, and an occasional wine tasting 
 

 
 Learning culture - we give direct feedback, we give responsibility, and we learn fast 
 

 
 Competitive salary, flexible work-life, and warrant packages 
 
 
  Ready to build? 

 If you want to run a real budget, make evidence-based calls, and build a growth engine from paid to self-serve - apply. 

 We're 3 in marketing, 50 in the company. Come grow with us.

                        Description & Expectation
Quadsat is looking for a skilled Software Developer to join the Software team working on SpectraLoc, our defense product for detection, analysis, and geolocation of RF emitters.

SpectraLoc combines RF sensing payloads, drone-based operations, mission control software, signal processing, geolocation algorithms, and operator-facing workflows into one integrated product. The software you will work on is a central part of this system: it runs on the ground, controls and monitors missions, interfaces with the payload, supports analysis of collected RF data, and enables operators to turn complex RF information into actionable insight in real-world environments.

This is not a role limited to implementing isolated features. We are looking for someone who can understand the software platform as a whole, take ownership of core parts of the codebase, and help turn advanced technology into a robust operational product.

You will work closely with colleagues across software, RF, and robotics. You will contribute to technical architecture decisions, take ownership of implementation and delivery, and help shape how new capabilities are realized within SpectraLoc with high quality, maintainability, and scalability in mind.

This is an opportunity to work on software that matters beyond the codebase - software that supports real deployments, real operators, and real operational challenges.
Responsibilities:
Your main responsibility will be to develop, maintain, and mature the ground software and payload integration software used in SpectraLoc. This includes:

Developing robust, maintainable, and operationally reliable software for SpectraLoc’s ground-based control and analysis platform.

Implementing and improving the software interface towards the RF payload, including command, control, monitoring, data handling, and status reporting.

Building mission control functionality, operator workflows, and analysis features that support detection, analysis, and geolocation of RF emitters.

Taking ownership of key software features from specification and implementation through testing, release, and long-term maintenance.

Contributing to the technical and product architecture of SpectraLoc, including code structure, system interfaces, APIs, data flows, and how software, payload, RF, drone, and cloud components interact.

Collaborating closely with RF, robotics, and other teams to ensure new capabilities are integrated reliably across the full system.

Supporting the productization and deployment of SpectraLoc by improving software maturity, repeatability, reliability, observability, and ease of operation.

Contributing to strong software engineering practices, including code reviews, automated testing, CI/CD, documentation, and structured release processes.
Knowledge & Skills:
We are looking for a developer who enjoys working on complex technical products where software interacts closely with hardware, sensors, and real-world operational use cases.

We imagine that you have:

A bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, software engineering, robotics, or a similar technical field.

Experience from a software development role working on complex technical systems or products.

Strong programming skills in one or more of the following: C#, Python, C++, .NET, Rust, Go, or Java.

Experience with software architecture, or a strong interest in taking on architectural responsibility.

Experience with software that interfaces with external systems, hardware, sensors, payloads, APIs, or communication protocols.

Experience with object-oriented programming and preferably asynchronous, event-driven, or multithreaded software development.

Experience with structured software development practices, including testing, code quality, maintainability, version control, and CI/CD.

A proactive mindset, strong ownership, and the ability to work independently to follow tasks through to completion while staying aligned with the broader team.

English is our company language so fluency in English is a must.

It would be highly relevant if you have experience from defense, electronic warfare, RF systems, drones, robotics, aerospace, surveillance, test and measurement, or other mission-critical technology domains. Specifically having been directly or indirectly involved with defense or defense technology through previous employment, projects, customers, research, military experience, or adjacent industries. This is not a strict requirement, but it is a strong advantage.
Our Dynamic Work Environment:
Quadsat is at an exciting stage of our growth journey where you can make a meaningful impact with your work, and directly influence the development of advanced solutions. You will join a diverse team of innovative colleagues who are passionate about working with new technology development. Our work environment is characterised by a high degree of openness, a flat management structure, and a strong sense of community where we work closely together on tasks.

You will be part of a driven engineering team across software, RF, robotics, and product development, with opportunities for professional growth, increased responsibility, and close involvement in real product innovation. We value initiative, collaboration, high-quality engineering, and people who want their work to matter beyond the codebase.



Contact:
For recruitment related questions contact Human Resources Director, Aislinn Campbell, by mail at afc@quadsat.com or by phone at +45 71 74 97 81.

For role related questions contact R&D Director, Rasmus Hasle, by mail at rh@quadsat.com or by phone at +45 93 40 16 26.

        Salgsassistent til vores butik i Borgen i Sønderborg - 15 timer om ugen    

    


        
        




    

        



        
Vil du være en del af Europas største skokæde? Vi tager dig et skridt videre.


Hos Deichmann får du mulighed for at blive en del af et stærkt team, hvor vi arbejder sammen om at give kunderne den bedste oplevelse - hver dag.


Hvorfor arbejde hos os? 


Vi har mange gode grunde, bl.a.:



Over 100 års erfaring og et unikt koncept


En succesfuld og voksende butikskæde


Fokus på trivsel, arbejdsglæde og godt samarbejde


Du bliver en del af et dedikeret team - også selvom I arbejder på forskellige tidspunkter



 Hvorfor ansætte dig?



Du motiveres af at få kunderne til at komme igen


Du er serviceminded


Du er engageret og har lyst til at lære noget nyt


Du bidrager til det gode sammenhold i teamet



Du har ikke nødvendigvis erfaring fra detail, men gerne fra servicebranchen, så du forstår betydningen af god kundeservice.


Læs mere her: www.deichmann-jobs.dk


Jobbet:



Salgsassistent til 15 timer om ugen


Du skal kunne tage vagter i hele butikkens åbningstid, også i dagtimerne


Du skal arbejde ca. hver anden weekend


Start er hurtigst muligt



Vi sørger for, at du får den nødvendige træning og lærer Deichmanns koncept.


I butikkerne pakker vi selv varerne ud, sætter på plads og flytter rundt, så ud over, at kunderne altid er i fokus, vil en stor del af arbejdet være meget aktivt og dagligdagen vil altid være travl og afvekslende.


Hvis du har den rette indstilling, er der rigtig gode karrieremuligheder, da vi ofte rekrutterer vores ledere internt.


Kontakt:


Har du spørgsmål? Så er du velkommen til at kontakte Charlotte, som er ansvarlig for butikken, på 5221 5298 mandag til fredag i dagtimerne.


Da vi vurderer kandidaterne løbende, beder vi dig om at sende din ansøgning hurtigst muligt.


Kort om os: Deichmann er Europas største skokæde og har været familiedrevet siden grundlæggelsen i Essen i 1913. I dag har vi over 4.700 butikker i 36 lande - og har været til stede i Danmark siden 2003. Under visionen "Virksomheden skal tjene mennesket" lægger vi stor vægt på medarbejdertrivsel, gode arbejdsvilkår og et stærkt fællesskab. Vi tilbyder moderigtige kvalitetssko til fair priser gennem globalt indkøb, flade strukturer og teamwork. Læs mere på deichmann.com.

title: Lead - SCADA (E&M)
description:
About Business:

Adani Group: Adani Group is a diversified organisation in India comprising 10 publicly traded companies. It has created a world class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large scale infrastructure development in India with O & M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India.

Adani Airports Holding Limited: Adani Airports Holding Limited is reshaping the aviation landscape, transforming airports into dynamic hubs of connectivity, innovation, and service excellence. By prioritizing passenger experience, leveraging state-of-the-art technology, and enhancing operational efficiency, we are redefining airport infrastructure across India. Our vision is to create world-class airports that serve as gateways to regional development and global connectivity, positioning Adani Airports as a leader in the aviation sector with a focus on sustainable growth and community impact.

Job Purpose: Lead - SCADA is responsible for the operational integrity, maintenance, and security of the SCADA systems within assigned plant segments. This role ensures the smooth functioning of control systems essential for monitoring and managing automated processes, contributing to operational efficiency, safety, and productivity. By providing technical expertise in SCADA programming, network management, and system troubleshooting, the Associate enhances the reliability and security of plant operations. Additionally, they play a key role in supporting business development through technical advisement, compliance management, and assisting in the evaluation of new SCADA technologies, ultimately contributing to both the operational and strategic goals of the organization.

Maintenance and Operation of SCADA Systems:

Conduct regular maintenance checks on assigned SCADA systems within specific plant segments, ensuring they run smoothly and efficiently by performing system diagnostics, software updates, and addressing any minor technical issues to prevent interruptions in operations.

Identify and troubleshoot any technical malfunctions in the SCADA systems, collaborating with other team members if necessary to resolve issues quickly and prevent unplanned downtime, which could impact plant productivity and safety.

Network Security and Protocol Management:

Regularly monitor and configure network security protocols within the SCADA system to ensure safe and uninterrupted data transfer across different plant sections by managing firewalls, intrusion detection systems, and encryption protocols that protect sensitive information.

Set up, configure, and maintain essential SCADA-related infrastructure, such as servers, switches, and routers, to provide a secure and stable network environment that supports the SCADA system and prevents unauthorized access or data breaches.

Technical Support for Business Development:

Act as a technical advisor to the sales and business development teams, providing insights on SCADA system functionalities and potential upgrades that align with client needs by giving input on the feasibility, cost, and benefits of different SCADA solutions to aid in sales strategies and client presentations.

Engage in discussions about emerging technologies in SCADA and related control systems, communicating potential benefits to the business development team to support marketing initiatives and promote advanced solutions that could attract new clients.

Technical Review and Vendor Communication:

Review technical specifications, industry standards, and product brochures when considering SCADA software purchases from vendors and carefully evaluate these documents to confirm the software meets plant requirements, is compatible with existing systems, and aligns with regulatory standards for SCADA.

Maintain open communication with vendors, discussing product capabilities, licensing terms, and support services to ensure any SCADA system acquisitions are well-understood, fully documented, and meet the plant's current and future technical needs.

SCADA System Programming and Development:

Assist in developing user-friendly SCADA screens, custom databases, and reporting tools that enable efficient monitoring and analysis of plant data by designing clear, responsive interfaces that give operators real-time access to critical information and streamline workflows.

Configure and manage SCADA system networks to support data integration across various plant segments.

Safety and Compliance Management:

Ensure that all SCADA system operations adhere to established safety protocols, regulatory standards, and industry best practices by routine checks and updates to safety features and compliance documentation, which help protect both personnel and equipment.

Maintain accurate documentation for all licenses, support contracts, and compliance-related records associated with SCADA software and hardware to avoid compliance issues, supports system audits, and ensures clear tracking of all SCADA-related liabilities and assets.

Data Analysis and Reporting:

Collect and analyze SCADA data to generate insights into system performance, energy consumption, and operational efficiency.

Develop and deliver detailed reports to management, including recommendations for system improvements.

Maintain accurate logs of system events, alarms, and incidents for audit and compliance purposes.

Energy Efficiency and Sustainability:

Use SCADA data to identify opportunities for energy conservation and sustainable practices.

Implement advanced control strategies to reduce energy waste and optimize resource utilization.

Collaborate with the Energy Management team to achieve airport-wide energy reduction goals.

Key Stakeholders - Internal:

Lead -MEPF

Plant Operations Team

Maintenance Team

IT/Network Security Team

Sales and Business Development Team

Engineering Department

Compliance and Safety Team

Key Stakeholders - External:

SCADA Software Vendors

Network and Hardware Suppliers

Regulatory Authorities

Third-Party Service Providers

Clients/Customers

Industry Consultants

Educational Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Instrumentation Engineering, Control Systems, or a related field

Certifications in SCADA systems, Industrial Automation, or Network Security (preferred)

Work Experience:

5-7 years of experience in SCADA systems maintenance, operations, or control systems engineering in an industrial or plant setting

Experience with network configuration, server management, and troubleshooting in SCADA environments

Familiarity with industry standards, compliance protocols, and technical documentation

title: Bliv senior-/privatrådgiver i Nykredit og Spar Nord på Amager - og gør en forskel for vores kunder
description:
Bliv senior-/privatrådgiver i Nykredit og Spar Nord på Amager - og gør en forskel for vores kunder
             

             
            
 
                
 
                    
 
                 

             


             
             
                
 

 Som rådgiver i vores store lokale bank på Amager får du mulighed for at kombinere vores engagement i lokalområdet med alle de muligheder og fordele, vi som foreningsejet bank kan tilbyde vores kunder og kolleger. Vi er nemlig ikke helt som de andre - og det vil du også mærke, når vi kan byde dig velkommen som senior-/privatrådgiver. 

 I jobbet får du ansvaret for din egen kundeportefølje bestående af primært private boligejer, og samtidig muligheden for at arbejde med nye kunder. Du bliver en del af en spændende tid, hvor vi sammen bygger videre på Amagers bedste og største lokalbank, som er skabt gennem sammenlægningen af Nykredit og Spar Nord. Du får muligheden for at være med til at skabe den bedste arbejdsplads og et solidt fællesskab. 
                                    
  Vær med til at skabe gode kundeoplevelser
  Som senior-/privatrådgiver skal du gøre alt for at give vores kunder den bedste rådgivning. Du er nysgerrig, opsøgende og engageret i dine kunder, så du lærer hele deres økonomi at kende og kan identificere behov, som de måske ikke selv er opmærksomme på. 

 Du får adgang til en bred produktportefølje og digitale værktøjer, som sammen med din faglighed gør dig i stand til at skabe de bedste løsninger for dine kunder.
                                  
  Nogle af dine vigtigste arbejdsopgaver bliver at: 
 
 Rådgive og udvikle din egen kundeportefølje. 

 Identificere dine kunders individuelle behov og sammensætte  de rette løsninger. 

 Opbygge varige relationer gennem dialog. 

 Være på forkant med kundernes ønsker og drømme gennem løbende opfølgning. 

 Være initiativtagende, så du lykkes med de aftalte mål. 

 Skabe gode relationer til vores samarbejdspartnere, bl.a. vores mæglere. 
 
 Er det dig, vi leder efter? 
  Du har en finansiel uddannelse og motiveres af den tætte kundedialog og helhedsrådgivning, hvor boligområdet ofte spiller en central rolle. Du er nysgerrig på mennesker og trives med at forstå hele kundens økonomi, så du kan skabe de bedste løsninger til deres behov og drømme. Samtidig er du målrettet og motiveres af at skabe resultater, men du er også en holdspiller, der tror på, at de bedste resultater skabes i fællesskab, og at vi lykkes som et team. Bor du lokalt på Amager, vil det være en fordel, men det er på ingen måde et krav.   
                 
  Dit nye team
  Du bliver en del af øens bedste bank, og du kommer til at være med til at sætte dit præg på vores lokale bank på Amager. Vi har en rigtig god beliggenhed midt i lokalområdet, hvor du og kunderne nemt kan komme til. Du bliver en del af en succes, hvor høj kundetilfredshed, glade medarbejdere samt flotte resultater går hånd i hånd. Med rigtig mange gode kolleger og fagligt højt niveau skaber vi de bedste vilkår for samarbejdet og arbejdsglæden, hvor stor fleksibilitet er et af nøgleordene. Du bliver en del af et stort team bestående af ca. 30 gode kolleger. Vi værdsætter fællesskabet højt og tror på, at de bedste resultater skabes sammen. Har du et positivt mindset og trives i et motiverende og aktivt arbejdsmiljø, vil du passe rigtig godt ind hos os. 

 Vil du vide mere?
  Du er velkommen til at kontakte mig, lokalbankdirektør Jesper Olsen på tlf. 51 23 28 74, hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen. Du kan også finde mig LinkedIn her:  Jesper Olsen | LinkedIn  

 Har du spørgsmål til rekrutteringsprocessen, kan du kontakte rekrutteringsteamet på nytjob@nykredit.dk 

 Vi ser frem til at modtage din ansøgning og dit CV og inviterer løbende til samtaler.

 Amager

title: Senior BIM Engineer - Mechanical (DK)

Technical

• Develop the technical capabilities of the team
• Contribute to technical solutions on projects
• Initiate and participate in design peer reviews
• Ensure internal quality procedures are followed
• Keep up to date with industry developments with respect to own discipline and appreciate the basic technical principles and drivers of other disciplines
• Assist and support mentorship for junior engineers within the team
• Attending project meetings with the various other teams in India

Manage project delivery and leadership

• Minimum of 12 years relevant work experience
• Experience of MS Office Suite of Programs
• Comprehensive experience of technical design and associated discipline software

title: Psychiatrist (part-time) - Crisis Stabilization Unit/CSU (63039)
location: Potomac Pavilion: 1290 S. Potomac St, Aurora, CO 80012 - Aurora, CO 80012
description:
Aurora Mental Health & Recovery (AMHR) is seeking a compassionate, collaborative, and highly skilled Part-Time Psychiatrist (20 hours/week) to join our innovative Crisis Services team. In this in-person daytime role, you will provide comprehensive psychiatric care to adults in our Crisis Stabilization Unit (CSU), conducting psychiatric assessments, medication evaluations, medication management, and substance use treatment while partnering with a multidisciplinary team of nurses, prescribers, clinicians, and case managers dedicated to delivering exceptional crisis care. Supported by fellow prescribers who provide coverage during off-hours, you will play a vital role in helping individuals navigate acute mental health and substance use challenges in a state-of-the-art, five-day overnight stabilization program. When CSU census allows, you will also support the Psychiatric Access Clinic, providing timely evaluations and treatment for individuals needing rapid access to care. The ideal candidate is an empathetic clinician, lifelong learner, and experienced medical leader who is passionate about serving individuals in crisis, values teamwork, enjoys solving complex clinical and systems-level challenges, and is committed to advancing recovery-oriented, person-centered behavioral health care.

Schedule. This position is fully Onsite/In-person. The schedule is 8:00 am - 6:00 pm, 2 days/week, specific days are negotiable.

Salary for this role.

Salary is based on 0.5 FTE (full-time equivalent) or 20 hours per week. Fewer than 20 hours/week will be prorated and adjusted to the appropriate FTE. Salary is also based on years of licensure and company equity.

  • $122,116.33 - $183,174.485 per annum

Essential Functions:

  • Provide direct medical and psychiatric services through the comprehensive evaluation, diagnosis, treatment planning and treatment of patients assigned, on a regular basis as within the scope of State care.
  • Assure clinicians in assigned services receive appropriate clinical supervision, as necessary.
  • Work with multidisciplinary staff to evaluate and triage according to level of acuity, as needed.
  • Share 24-hour on-call responsibilities with other psychiatrists for residential, outpatient and emergency care, as assigned.
  • Maintain availability by telephone for face-to-face evaluation of emergency patients, as appropriate.
  • Provide utilization review of all patients in continuing care to ensure appropriate medical/psychiatric services are received, as needed.
  • Attend team and other meetings, as necessary.
  • Provide consultation with other physicians and staff on patient care and difficult cases, as needed.
  • Attend continuing medical education conferences to maintain excellent standards of care, on a regular basis.
  • Understand and comply with organizational goals around quality, compliance, standards, and policies.
  • Complete required education and training in a timely manner.
  • Provide information to credentialing, payroll, etc. in a timely manner.
  • Complete required education and training in a timely manner.
  • Accurately and completely document patient care.
  • Monitor and coordinate care for assigned clients in partnership with the other members of the client's care team.

title: Intern Key Accounts Italy
description:
YOUR MISSION

You will play a key role in supporting the National Account Team in managing and growing Glovo Italy’s top-tier partners. Your mission is to assist in building strong, long-lasting relationships with our most strategic accounts, supporting their performance growth and operational excellence. This is a 360-degree role where you will dive deep into data analysis, strategic presentations, and business development initiatives, working side-by-side with senior National Account Managers (NAMs).

This position is based in Milan and does not require travelling.

THE JOURNEY

title: The Hub | Founding CTO — Humanity Pacts® | HumanityPacts®
description:
Founding CTO — Humanity Pacts®  
 Arbejdsgiver HumanityPacts® Copenhagen Cofounder 
 
 
 
 
  
 
 
 
          Salary
           Unpaid  
 
 
          Equity
           To be negotiated  
 
  
 
   
 
  
 
   
 
 
 
   
 Founding CTO — Humanity Pacts® 

 Copenhagen, Denmark · Co-founder Equity · Full-time 

 
  

 Building the Interaction Intelligence layer for teams 

 
  

 Humanity Pacts is an AI-powered Interaction Intelligence platform that helps teams intentionally design how they work together instead of leaving collaboration to habit or chance. 

 Organizations invest heavily in strategy, processes, and technology. Yet the human operating system that determines whether those investments succeed—how people communicate, challenge ideas, make decisions, navigate tension, and coordinate work—is rarely designed with the same intention. 

 
  

 We believe this is one of the largest untapped opportunities in the future of work. 

 
  

 Humanity Pacts combines AI, behavioural science, and a proprietary methodology to help teams identify recurring interaction patterns and transform them into TeamPacts®: practical agreements that make better ways of working visible, actionable, and sustainable. 

 The methodology has been developed over several years through real facilitation, supported by patented IP, and refined with organisations including IKEA, Maersk, WHO, UNDP, UNOPS, Novo Nordisk, Médecins Sans Frontières, LEGO School, and others. 

 The methodology has been proven in practice. Now we're building the technology that can scale it. 

 
  

 The Role 

 As Founding CTO, you'll work alongside founder Analá Farías to build Humanity Pacts from an early stage. 
 
 
 This is a builder-founder role. 
 

 
 The product vision, methodology, and customer problem are already well defined (with room for creation). 
 

 
 Your role is to transform that vision into a robust, scalable technology platform. 
 

 
 During the first stage, you'll be deeply hands-on—designing the architecture, building key parts of the platform, and making the engineering decisions required to move from a validated methodology to a production-ready product. 
 

 
 As the company grows, you'll build the engineering function and lead the technical direction of the company. 
 

 
 You'll work closely with product, design, and behavioural science to translate complex human interactions into intuitive, reliable software. 
 
 
 You will 
 
 
 Co-own the technical vision and contribute to major company decisions. 
 

 
 Define the technology roadmap and architectural foundations. 
 

 
 Design and build an AI-powered Interaction Intelligence platform. 
 

 
 Transform validated concepts into secure, scalable, production-ready systems. 
 

 
 Build the infrastructure for AI orchestration, structured behavioural data, traceability, privacy, and responsible AI. 
 

 
 Work directly with pilot customers to learn from real-world usage and continuously improve the product. 
 

 
 Establish engineering principles, technical standards, and future hiring. 
 

 
 Represent the technical vision with customers, partners, and investors as the company grows. 
 
 
 
  

 Who We're Looking For 

 We're looking for a technical founder who enjoys building products where AI, technology, and human behaviour meet. 

 You enjoy turning ambiguity into systems. You combine technical depth with product thinking and are comfortable moving between architecture, implementation, customer conversations, and strategic decisions. 

 
  

 You'll likely bring many of these qualities: 
 
 
 Experience building and shipping production software, ideally SaaS, AI-enabled platforms, or data-intensive products. 
 

 
 Strong systems thinking and the ability to design secure, reliable, and scalable architectures. 
 

 
 Confidence making pragmatic technical decisions in fast-moving environments. 
 

 
 Experience working closely with product and design to translate user needs into iterative, testable products. 
 

 
 Curiosity about AI, behavioural science, and human-centred technology. 
 

 
 A founder mindset—you enjoy ownership, uncertainty, and building from first principles. 
 
 
 
  

 Experience with LLM applications, structured generation, knowledge systems, enterprise software, collaboration platforms, or modern web technologies is valuable. 

 
  

 More important than any specific technology is your ability to learn quickly, challenge assumptions, and build thoughtfully. 

 
  

 You don't need to match every requirement. We're looking for someone who wants to help build a company—not simply fill a role. 

 
  

 About the Founder 

 Humanity Pacts was created by Analá Farías, inventor of the Humanity Tiles® methodology. 

 Over the last five years, Analá has focused on understanding the science behind effective teams—how trust, psychological safety, decision-making, communication patterns, and social dynamics shape collective performance. 

 
  

 Her work combines behavioural science, innovation strategy, human-centred design, organisational development, and communication to create a new category of people technology: systems that help teams move from default ways of working to intentionally designed interactions. 

 The methodology has been developed and refined through real facilitation with organisations navigating genuine transformation. The interaction patterns, behavioural rules, language libraries, and AI rulesets behind Humanity Pacts are grounded in practice—not theory. 

 
  

 What We Offer 

 This is a genuine technical co-founder opportunity with meaningful ownership of both the company and the product. 
 
 
 The role includes co-founder equity with a standard vesting schedule and one-year cliff. 
 

 
 Ownership areas, decision-making responsibilities, intellectual property, compensation, and future dilution will be discussed openly and agreed before commitment. 
 

 
 Humanity Pacts is currently preparing an Innofounder application for August 2026. If successful, the programme will support a 12-month period of focused company building. 
 

 
 Before funding is secured, we expect a close part-time collaboration to build trust, validate technical direction, and develop the first production-ready version of the platform together. 
 

 
 If funding takes longer than expected, we'll continue through a combination of grants, early-stage investment, and revenue from existing workshop activities while remaining transparent about pace, priorities, and commitments. 
 

 
 The role is based in Copenhagen. Hybrid working is possible, but close founder collaboration is important. 
 
 
 
  

 Join Us 

 If you're excited by building AI that strengthens human collaboration—not replaces it—and want to help create a new category of people technology, we'd love to hear from you. 

 Send a short introduction, links to products or systems you've built, and tell us what excites you most about the opportunity. 
   
 
   For more information or questions please contact us at   ana@humanitytiles.com

title: Transportation Management Trainee 2026
description:
Be part of a team that values safety, inclusion, and excellence

We are one of the largest U.S. railroads transporting the nation’s freight across 28 western states and 3 Canadian provinces. As a member of our team, you will play a role in supporting the movement of essential products and materials that help feed, clothe, supply, and power communities throughout America and the world.

We are committed to a culture where all employees are included, belong, and have equal opportunity to achieve their full potential. Come make a difference with us!

Learn more about BNSF and our Benefits

Job Location: Barstow, CA; Amarillo, TX; Corwith, IL; Haslet, TX; Logistics Park Chicago IL; Oklahoma City, OK; Phoenix, AZ; San Bernardino, CA; Temple, TX
Anticipated Start Date: 2/9/2026, 6/1/2026, or 9/21/2026
Number of Positions: 20
Salary Range: 80,000

Transportation Management Trainee hiring rate of $80,000. Within approximately 6 months, opportunity to promote to Supervisor of Terminal Operations at rate of $113,000.


A Transportation Management Trainee position at BNSF Railway offers recent graduates a comprehensive introduction to the rail transportation industry, focusing on operations, logistics, safety, and customer service. This role focuses on managing daily operations, enforcing safety standards, and guiding a team toward operational excellence. Candidates must demonstrate robust decision-making, advanced problem-solving abilities, and a dedication to fostering a safety-first work environment. This opportunity significantly impacts the efficiency and success of BNSF's operations, positioning it as a key role within one of North America's premier railroad companies.

Learn more about our Management Trainee Program

This is a full-time position in a 24x7 operations environment, subject to on-call, nights, alternating shifts, weekends, and holidays.

Accelerate your career with our 6-month training program that begins with a one-week orientation at our Fort Worth headquarters, where you'll immerse yourself in BNSF culture and connect with industry leaders.

Next, spend two non-consecutive months at our Technical Training Center in Overland Park to sharpen your technical and personnel management skills. During this time, we'll focus on developing you as a safety and operations leader:

  • The safety leader phase will provide you with knowledge of operating and safety rules. You'll then receive on-the-job training where you'll observe and learn from train crews in the field, strengthening the knowledge gained in the classroom. This position requires that all Management Trainee must obtain their rules qualification by week 12 of the 26-week training program.
  • The operations leader phase will teach you the program and leadership skills needed to successfully navigate on-the-job training at your assigned training location for the remainder of the program.

By the end of the program, you'll have gained valuable technical skills and leadership abilities that will propel your career forward.

Travel and Relocation is required for this program, Trainees must be flexible with their location, as they could be moved depending on business needs. Must have reliable transportation to and from work.

Applicants will be notified via e-mail regarding potential interviews, testing, and hiring events for this position. Please check your e-mail daily.

Key responsibilities may include:

Leading safety briefings and ensuring compliance with Federal Railroad Administration and BNSF rules as well as conducting safety meetings, investigate accidents, monitor costs, and ensure compliance with regulations and company policies.

Facilitating crew discussions on safety, managing compliance with attendance policies, and conducting operational audits while riding trains.

Assisting crews with personnel paperwork, vacation requests, and providing transportation for timely operations.

Corresponding with customers regarding shipments and planning the movement of cars, locomotives, and crews within terminals in addition to coordinating with various departments to execute the operations plan and provide efficient service.

Implementing policies, supervise employees, and manage daily train and switching operations.

Possess leadership, teamwork, clear communication, adaptability, and resilience to overcome obstacles and meet deadlines in a dynamic work environment.

Daily work is conducted in a mixed indoor office and outdoor safety-sensitive environment, where working conditions can include diverse and extreme weather conditions (hot, cold, rain, snow, and sleet), walking and performing work on uneven surfaces, and working around loud noises, fumes, and heavy/moving machinery. Personal protective equipment, a hard hat, safety glasses, and gloves are required and provided by BNSF.

The duties and responsibilities in this posting are representative categories to be used in deciding whether to apply for this position. This is not an exhaustive list of the position’s duties.

At BNSF Railway, we encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply, showcasing their skills, experiences and development. We provide resources and tools to help you reach your full potential, fostering a supportive and inclusive environment.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Legally authorized to work in the United States and will be at least eighteen (18) years old upon hire.
  • Does not require BNSF’s assistance, now or in the future, (whether monetary, through sponsorship, or otherwise) to obtain, maintain, or extend employment authorization (including H-1B, STEM OPT/CPT, or TN nonimmigrant status).
  • Capable of visually distinguishing among red, blue, green, yellow and lunar (clear light) colors & able to see at night AND I am able to hear and, with training, distinguish auditory signals.
  • Capable of working in a 24/7 environment, including nights, weekends, and holidays, and can safely perform duties outdoors in all weather conditions or in a shop, terminal, or field environment. Role includes climbing ladders and navigating uneven surfaces, with the ability to travel up to 25% of the time based on business needs.
  • Able and willing to relocate anywhere on the BNSF Railway operating system (western 28 states) upon hire, for the summer, and travel to other locations as required. If you have any location restrictions, please answer "No."
  • Pursuing a Bachelors or Graduate degree in Logistics, Transportation, Supply Chain Management, Business, Communication, Technical, OR a similar degree program from an accredited university.
  • Have and will maintain at least a 2.75 cumulative GPA.
  • Have LESS THAN three (3) years of professional work experience/military service, EXCLUDING internships, part-time jobs, or positions held while pursuing my undergraduate and/or graduate degree.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Prior internship experience or less than 3 years of work experience in Supply Chain, Business, Logistics, or a related field.
  • Have or have held a leadership position in a campus, community, or extracurricular organization.

At BNSF, you will have access to a comprehensive and competitive benefits package including:

  • An industry-leading 401(k) and renowned Railroad Retirement program.
  • A range of robust health care options for you and your dependents (including domestic partners), including medical, dental, vision, telemedicine, mental health, cancer support, and high-quality care network options.
  • Health care spending accounts (HSA) with employer contributions, as well as life and disability insurance, provided at no cost.
  • Family benefits including parental, pediatric and family building support, adoption and surrogacy reimbursement, and dependent care spending account (with employer match).
  • Access to discounts on travel, gym memberships, counseling services and wellness support.
  • Annual bonus (Incentive Compensation Program)
  • Generous leave / time off policies.
  • For more information, visit Benefits.

Please be aware of potential fraud that can occur when searching for new career opportunities. Please review our FAQ for more information and awareness.

All positions require pre-employment background verification, medical review and pre-employment drug screen. You can find more information by reviewing the Hiring Process. Federal authority requires BNSF employees, whose work requires unescorted access to secure areas of port facilities, to obtain a TWIC. More information is available at https://www.tsa.gov/for-industry/twic

BNSF Railway is an Equal Opportunity Employer, all qualified applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.

title: Behavior Clinician II
description:
The Clinician II will work to address the unique needs of individuals with intellectual/developmental disabilities (I/DD) in our Habilitative Skill Building (HSB) Program in Tacoma, WA. Individuals receiving services are adults with often times multiple diagnoses and present with significant challenging behaviors. Many individuals supported in the HSB program have transitioned out of more restrictive settings, such as residential habilitation centers, state hospitals, correctional facilities, and diversion programs. Supported individuals may also be part of the WA Community Protection Program and may have criminal backgrounds requiring increased clinical support in order to thrive in a community setting.

  • Manage caseload of individuals for treatment implementation
  • Conduct Functional Behavior Assessments and develop Positive Behavior Support Plans (PBSPs)
  • Provide clinical guidance to Direct Support Professionals and Program Managers
  • Conduct frequent program visits to interact with supported individuals and staff
  • Complete progress reports, documentation and data collection, updating plans as necessary
  • Review data to ensure care meets individual's current needs
  • Assist in providing crisis intervention and outreach as needed.
  • Foster positive rapport with individuals, parents, and guardians
  • Participate in the debriefing of significant incidents of individuals on caseload when requested
  • Attend person-centered planning meetings, referral/intake meetings, and home staffing meetings
  • Develop and maintain collaborative relationships with external service providers including DDA, Consultants, Hospitals, external providers, etc.

What Makes You a Great Fit:

  • Must have a master's degree in psychology, behavior analysis, mental health, special education, social work, or other related discipline; or be graduating with master's degree within the next 6 months.
  • 2+ years of professional experience with individuals with intellectual developmental disabilities (IDD) is required
  • Relevant experience in designing and implementing support plans for individuals with developmental disabilities, autism, and/or challenging behaviors
  • Experience with Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA) preferred

We believe in supporting not only those we serve but also each other, ensuring a collaborative and supportive work environment for all. Dungarvin is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, protected veteran status, disability, genetic information, national origin, age, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any legally protected status per federal and/or state law.

                             Jobbeskrivelse 
                         
                        
 Er du interesseret i en stilling,
hvor du får mulighed for at tage ansvar, udvikle dig og gøre en reel forskel for
kunderne? Så kan det være, at dit livs måske vigtigste job venter på dig her
hos os. Seriøst! 


 Hos Q8 bliver du en del af et fællesskab, hvor vi
passer på hinanden og sørger for, at du trives i dit arbejde. Når du har det
godt, kan du give kunderne den bedste oplevelse - og det er præcis det, vi
brænder for. Vores gode samarbejde internt er samtidig med til at drive den
udvikling, vi som virksomhed er i fuld gang med. Q8 står nemlig midt i en
spændende transformation, hvor vi arbejder aktivt med at reducere vores
klimapåvirkning. Lyder det som noget for dig? Så bliv en del af Q8 familien. 


  


 Hvad kommer du til at lave? 


 Som salgsassistent får du en hverdag, hvor ingen dage er ens. Du sørger for, at stationen altid er indbydende og klar til at tage imod kunderne. Det ene øjeblik hjælper du på forpladsen, det næste betjener du kunder ved kassen, tilbereder og serverer mad eller fylder varer op. Der er fart på - men også plads til grin med kollegaerne og tid til at give kunderne en god service. 


 Det praktiske 

 
 Ansættelsesform: timelønnet 

 Omfang: Ca. 8 timer pr. uge 

 Arbejdstid: Vagterne vil ligge i weekenden, typisk i både dag -og aftentimerne. Hver anden weekend. En morgenvagt er fra 6.30-15. Aftenvagten er fra 15-23.15 

 Start: Efter aftale 

 Løn: Grundløn for ufaglærte: 142,17 kr. Grundløn for faglærte: 151,53 kr. Derudover får du aften-, nat-, weekend- og helligdagstillæg i henhold til butiksoverenskomsten.  

 Pension: 10,7% firmabetalt pension gennem PFA. Gælder efter 3 måneders ansættelse og for medarbejdere over 20 år - med mindre du allerede er omfattet af en pensionsordning, så får du pension fra start. 
 

 OBS! Du skal kunne fremvise en straffeattest, hvis du går videre i processen. 

                     

                 

             

         

        
            



    


        
        
            
 
                
 
                    
 
                        
 
                             
                                 Dine kvalifikationer 
                             
                            
 Hvad tilbyder vi dig? 

 
 En arbejdsplads med alsidige opgaver og mulighed for at lære nyt hver dag 

 Et stærkt fællesskab, hvor vi hjælper hinanden og har det sjovt 

 En medarbejderapp med mulighed for fleksibel lønudbetaling, indflydelse gennem vores ungeministerium samt gode fordele og rabatter 

 En struktureret onboardingproces, der sikrer, at du kommer godt fra start - understøttet af vores medarbejderapp, hvor du finder guides, træning og nyttige værktøjer 
 

 Hvis du vil vide mere om, hvordan det er at være medarbejder i Q8, så læs mere på  karrierestationen . 


  


 Hvem passer jobbet til? 


 Vi leder efter dig, der har lyst til at tage ansvar og give kunderne en god oplevelse. Erfaring er ikke afgørende - det vigtigste er din energi og dit engagement. 


 OBS! For at søge skal du være fyldt 18 år og tale flydende dansk, da kundekontakt er en stor del af jobbet. 


  


 Klar på at blive en del af Q8? 


 I ansøgningen har du flere
muligheder, men for at vi kan lære dig bedre at kende, så skal du besvare nogle
enkelte spørgsmål. Derudover skal du optage en kort video, hvor du fortæller om
dig selv og hvorfor du gerne vil arbejde hos Q8. Vi ved godt, at det kan lyde
lidt grænseoverskridende, men det behøver ikke at være perfekt eller
professionelt, og du kan bare filme på mobilen. 


 Du kan også vedhæfte dit CV, hvis
du har et, men det er helt frivilligt. Vi håber at høre fra dig!

Administrativ driftsplanlægger med el-teknisk forståelse







Vær med til at sikre, at elnettet fungerer for vores kunder - hver eneste dag.



Hos Nexel søger vi en administrativ driftsplanlægger med erfaring indenfor "elverdenen", der har lyst til at være bindeled mellem planlægning, drift og vores montører i marken. 



Nexel - vi er på opgaven

Vi bygger og varetager driften af forsyningsanlæg, der sikrer strøm til alle - på jobbet, i skolen og derhjemme. Læs mere om os på nexel.dk 



"Vi spiller en vigtig rolle i elektrificeringen af samfundet, og derfor har vi brug for dygtige kolleger, som har lyst til at være med," fortæller Manager Nicklas Hørning Olsen.



Du bliver en del af Kundefokuserede Opgaver

Hvor vi hver dag sikrer, at planlægning, drift og udførelse går hånd i hånd. Her får du en central rolle i den daglige drift af elnettet, hvor du er med til at sørge for, at vores opgaver bliver planlagt og udført sikkert, effektivt og til gavn for både forsyningssikkerheden, vores kunder og den grønne omstilling.



Du bliver en del af et engageret team, hvor samarbejde, faglig sparring og en uformel omgangstone er en naturlig del af hverdagen.



Din hverdag

Du får en central rolle i planlægningen af vores driftsopgaver i Cerius-området (Sydvestsjælland og Øerne). Din daglige base bliver vores lokation i Haslev, hvor du arbejder tæt sammen med både montører, planlæggere og kolleger på tværs af organisationen.



Afdelingen samles fast én dag om ugen på kontoret i Virum. Her prioriterer vi faglig sparring, videndeling, udvikling og det gode kollegaskab - fordi vi tror på, at de bedste løsninger skabes, når vi mødes ansigt til ansigt.



Dine opgaver bliver blandt andet at:



	
Planlægge og koordinere drifts- og vedligeholdelsesopgaver.

	
Sikre, at montørerne har de nødvendige oplysninger for at kunne løse opgaverne.

	
Koordinere med interne og eksterne samarbejdspartnere.

	
Bidrage til løbende forbedring af vores planlægningsprocesser.




Eksempler på de opgaver, som du sender montørerne ud for at løse:



	
Udskiftning af kabelskabe.

	
Nedgravning og etablering af nye elforsyninger.

	
Udskiftning af lavspændingsanlæg (0,4 kV).

	
Arbejde i transformerstationer og kabelskabe.




Hvem er du?

Vi forestiller os, at du har en el-teknisk baggrund. For eksempel som elektriker, el-tekniker, eller lignende. Det vigtigste er, at du har forståelse for elnet eller elanlæg og lyst til at arbejde med planlægning.



Derudover leder vi efter dig, der



	
Arbejder metodisk og formår at bevare overblikket, selv i travle perioder.

	
Trives med koordinering og samarbejde.

	
Er en erfaren bruger af Microsoft Office.

	
Har kendskab til SAP 

	
Kommunikerer klart på dansk og kan begå dig på engelsk.




"Som person trives du i et kollegialt fællesskab, hvor vi både hjælper og udvikler hinanden, når vi løser vores opgaver", fortsætter Nicklas.



Vi kombinerer formål, faglighed og fællesskab 

Hos os bliver du en del af en arbejdsplads, der engagerer sig i den grønne omstilling og aktivt sætter positive spor i samfundet. Vi er ikke kun et demokratisk-ejet andelsselskab, men også et fællesskab der tænker langsigtet og formålsdrevet, og hvor forandringer er velkomne, som en vigtig del af dagligdagen. 



Vores andelskultur er kendetegnet ved et sammenhold og relationer, der bunder i tillid. Når vi mødes i kantinen, taler vi uformelt med hinanden, og i arbejdet mødes vi med en ligeværdig tilgang på tværs af koncernen, fordi vi ved, at hver person bidrager med noget særligt og værdifuldt.

 

Et andelsselskab i bevægelse - vil du med på rejsen? 

Lyder stillingen som noget for dig, så send din ansøgning og dit CV hurtigst muligt via annoncen her. Hvis du har spørgsmål, er du velkommen til at kontakte manager Nicklas Hørning Olsen på 23 42 48 35.



Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig.



For at sikre gældende GDPR-lovgivning modtager vi kun ansøgninger via jobannoncen. 



#Nexel

 












  
  Share



  
  Share



  
  Post



  
  Email



  
  Share




  











Vi er specialisterne, der rykker ud, når strømmen går




I Nexel er vi specialisterne, der hjælper netselskaberne med at sikre, at elanlæggene virker, så strømmen kommer frem til elforbrugeren. Vi er ca. 800 kollegaer, der overvåger, vedligeholder, udbygger og udvikler elnettet i et samspil med netselskaberne Cerius og Radius - og vi gør det døgnet rundt. Vi er synlige i hverdagen, når vi rykker ud i by og på land i vores biler med det karakteristiske X, og når vi arbejder på store anlægsprojekter. Er du klar til at rykke ud sammen med os?


Nexel er en del af Andel-koncernen, der er en andelsejet energi- og fibernetkoncern.


I Nexel hylder vi fællesskabet og forskelligheden og opfordrer alle kvalificerede ansøgere uanset alder, køn, religion eller etnisk tilhørsforhold at søge vores ledige stillinger.

Har du en stemme, der smiler og ører, der virkelig lytter? Bliv kunderådgiver i Medlemsservice







Når et medlem ringer, handler det sjældent kun om pension. Det handler om mennesker, livssituationer og de valg, der følger med. Derfor nøjes vi ikke med at besvare spørgsmål - vi hjælper medlemmerne med at få overblik over deres muligheder og træffe de beslutninger, der passer til deres liv. Hos Industriens Pension bliver du en del af et fællesskab, hvor vi rådgiver ud fra medlemmets situation frem for standardløsninger.



Vi søger dig, der vil arbejde med alle hjørner af pension og samtidig er en menneskeklog rådgiver - og vi kan ikke vente med at få dig om bord!



Et varmt velkommen til Medlemsservice

Du får mange kolleger, som deler viden, spørger, sparrer og hjælper hinanden for at gøre det bedste for vores medlemmer. Hvis vi mener noget kan forbedres i hverdagen, en arbejdsgang, oplevelsen for medlemmerne eller vores samarbejde i afdelingen, så bliver det sagt højt og fulgt op. Det er sådan, vi arbejder.



Hos os tror vi på, at den bedste rådgivning opstår, når faglighed, nysgerrighed og omtanke går hånd i hånd. Derfor udvikler vi hele tiden vores rådgivning, så vi kan skabe endnu mere værdi for vores medlemmer - både når de kontakter os, og når vi tager initiativet først.



"Det, der karakteriserer os bedst er, at der er plads til alle. Vi hjælper hinanden for at få det hele til at hænge sammen, og der er sparring hele vejen rundt. Der er masser af viden og erfaring i afdelingen, og du kan både som ny og erfaren byde ind med ideer og viden."



Sådan sætter Carina ord på at arbejde i Medlemsservice. Mød Carina og flere IP’ere her.



I hele Medlemsservice og Virksomhedsservice kan du se frem til at få i alt 50 nye kolleger, som du vil lære godt at kende, og som glæder sig til at arbejde sammen med dig.



Du gør en forskel - én samtale ad gangen

Når Peter ringer, fordi han er usikker på sin ordning, nøjes du ikke med at besvare hans spørgsmål. Du lytter, stiller de rigtige spørgsmål og hjælper ham med at få overblik over sine muligheder. Måske opdager I sammen noget, han ikke selv havde tænkt over. Det er den forskel, vi gerne vil gøre for vores medlemmer.



Dine dage bliver desuden fyldt op med at:



	
skabe trygge og værdifulde medlemsoplevelser via telefon, mail og chat

	
rådgive om pension og forsikringer med udgangspunkt i det enkelte medlems livssituation

	
være nysgerrig og proaktiv, så du hjælper medlemmet med mere end det, de selv ringer om

	
samarbejde tæt med kolleger og dele viden på tværs af teams

	
løse administrative opgaver og sagsbehandling - fx i forbindelse med dødsfald, udbetalinger og ændringer i medlemmers ordning.




Vi søger en rådgiver, der ikke nøjes med at besvare spørgsmål, men som er nysgerrig, ser mulighederne og hjælper medlemmerne videre - også når de ikke selv ved, hvad de har brug for.



Vi tror, du har:



	
erfaring fra kundeservice, medlemsrådgivning eller pensions-/forsikringsbranchen

	
en naturlig lyst til at hjælpe, skabe tryghed og kommunikere klart

	
evne til at bevare ro og overskud, også når tempoet stiger og telefonerne gløder

	
lyst til at skabe gode relationer og mod på at være nysgerrig, så du hjælper medlemmerne med mere end deres oprindelige spørgsmål

	
følgende moduler fra FOAK: 3.24,4.15,4.22, 4.23 - og hvis ikke sørger vi for, at du får dem.




Hvis du vil bruge en tredjedel af dine vågne timer sammen med os, får du desuden:



	
en karriere i balance, hvor du kan prioritere din fritid, venner og familie

	
mulighed for at arbejde hjemmefra 1-2 dage om ugen

	
en arbejdsplads, hvor sammenhold og fællesskab er nøgleord - du kan ikke snige dig forbi en af dine 250 kolleger på trappen uden at blive mødt med et:  "godmorgen" eller "god weekend"

	
en arbejdsplads, som for 5. år i træk har det bedste omdømme i branchen

	
En afdeling, der altid summer af liv- og hvor der aldrig er langt til et smil.




Har du spørgsmål? 

Så ring til Naja Klastrup, teamleder i MSVS, på +45 33 66 80 61 eller Maria Schioldann, afdelingschef i MSVS, på +45 60 95 18 16



… Eller er du allerede klar til at gribe muligheden? 

Så sving musen, ram "ansøg"-knappen og send os allerede din ansøgning i dag - vi indkalder løbende til samtale og ansætter så snart, vi har fundet vores nye kollega.



Hils på afdelingschef Maria Edelmark Schioldan:







Hver dag skaber vi Kundeservice i topklasse, og for mig er det helt naturligt, at vi er sammen om at skabe de bedste resultater. 



Det er vigtigt for mig, at alle har en god arbejdsdag. Jeg prøver at gøre mit til at skabe en positiv forskel, og et godt produktivt arbejdsmiljø. 



Jeg har det godt med at have ansvar for vores store afdeling, og træffe de beslutninger, som er nødvendige. 










		
		
		
		

  






Industriens Pension er blandt Danmarks største arbejdsmarkedspensionsselskaber med omkring 440.000 medlemmer og næsten 8.000 virksomheder, der indbetaler til pensionsordningen.

Vi er en veldrevet virksomhed med god trivsel og høj medarbejdertilfredshed. Vores investeringer har givet et gennemsnitligt årligt afkast på 8,4 procent for den samlede portefølje siden etableringen af ordningen i 1993. Det er blandt de absolut højeste i branchen. De samlede investeringer udgør ca. 245 mia. kr.


Industriens Pension landede både i 2023, 2024 og 2025 på førstepladsen i analysehuset EPSI Rating Danmarks årlige tilfredshedsundersøgelse blandt danske pensionsopsparere. Samtidig blev Industriens pension kåret som selskabet med pensionsbranchens bedste image og den højeste troværdighed i den årlige imageundersøgelse, ’Finansimage 2025’, der udarbejdes af FinansWatch og Wilke. Industriens Pension vandt ligeledes priserne ’Bedste digitale kundeservice’ og ’Bedste serviceorganisation’ ved prisuddelingen Kundeserviceaward 2025, der blev uddelt af konsulenthuset Wilke.

Maria Schioldann

title: Laboratory Technician - Juvenile Products
description:
The Technician, Laboratory, CP, under general supervision performs routine laboratory tests to determine the performance, chemical and/or physical composition of Furniture or Toys and Juvenile Products.

Job Functions

  • Works under general supervision to perform the following job functions, generally:
  • Performs routine laboratory testing, following relevant company’s Standard Operating Procedures (SOP’s) and methods. Validate performance on methods as required.
  • Test to applicable standards (ASTM, CSPA, ISO, SSC, etc.) and customer specific protocols.
  • Under supervision, develop, write, review, perform and validate test methods, laboratory SOPs, and other department level operating and quality documents.
  • Ensure compliance with all required local and federal safety processes and procedures.
  • May assist in limited internal support to marketing, sales, customer service and laboratory operations regarding test, report and other technical information.
  • Demonstrates good and safe work habits and enforces a clean working environment.
  • Perform general upkeep and housekeeping of the laboratory
  • Accurately complete and maintain all laboratory reports.
  • May also have prep or field responsibilities, as required by business needs.
  • May be required to receive, sort, log client samples into the data base, and prepare sample labels.
  • May be required to archive, return, or dispose of client samples as per established procedure.
  • Perform daily, weekly, and monthly Quality Assurance/Quality Control checks on equipment.
  • Assist in keeping inventory of laboratory chemicals and equipment necessary for the day to day functioning of the laboratory and in compiling list of supplies to be ordered when needed.
  • Assists in calibration / verification tasks and other ISO 17025 related activities.
  • Ensure all personal protective equipment (PPE) relevant for tasks is worn at all times.
  • Adheres to internal standards, policies and procedures.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.
  • Toy and Juvenile product Lab- This position performs performance, chemical and physical testing of toy, juvenile products, children's products, and furniture consumer products learning multiple industry methods
  • Associate degree or higher in Mechanical Engineering OR equivalent combination of education and experience (Required)
  • 2-5 years working in relevant SBU industrial/lab/field setting with experience following strict safety standards (Preferred)

Benefits

  • Competitive salary.
  • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance for full time employees.
  • Retirement savings plan.
  • Continuous professional development and training opportunities.
  • A dynamic, collaborative work environment.
  • Access to cutting-edge cryptographic technology and tools.

Physical Demands of the Job

  • Stand: Occasionally
  • Move or traverse: Frequently
  • Sit: Constantly
  • Use hands: Constantly
  • Reach with hands and arms: Occasionally
  • Climb or balance: Occasionally
  • Stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl: Occasionally
  • Talk/hear: Constantly
  • Taste/Smell: Occasionally
  • Lift/carry/push or pull: Occasionally 30 lbs

Pay Range: $21.00-26.00/ hour

Compensation

The expected salary for this position is $21.00 to $26.00 per hour. This range represents the minimum and maximum base salary we reasonably expect to pay for this role. Actual compensation within the range will depend on skills, experience, and qualifications.

Our Benefits

We care about your total well-being and will support you with the following, subject to your location and role.

  • Health: Medical, dental and vision insurance, life insurance, employee assistance programs.
  • Wealth: In addition to base pay, we offer 401(k) with company match (immediate vesting upon enrollment).
  • Happiness:
    • Professional Growth: Online training courses, virtual and classroom development experiences, tuition reimbursement program
    • Work-Life Balance: Paid-time off and family leave

In compliance with applicable state and local pay transparency laws, we provide clear and equitable compensation information for all applicants.

Position anticipated to close August 31, 2026.

Additional information

SGS is an Equal Opportunity Employer, and as such we recruit, hire, train, and promote persons in all job classifications without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, age, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetics, status as a protected veteran, or any other characteristics protected by law.

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily with or without reasonable accommodations. The requirements listed above are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities required.

title: Senior Associate, Supplier Quality Engineering
description:
L3Harris is dedicated to recruiting and developing high-performing talent who are passionate about what they do. Our employees are unified in a shared dedication to our customers’ mission and quest for professional growth. L3Harris provides an inclusive, engaging environment designed to empower employees and promote work-life success.
