L3Harris is the Trusted Disruptor in defense tech. With customers’ mission-critical needs always in mind, our employees deliver end-to-end technology solutions connecting the space, air, land, sea and cyber domains in the interest of national security.

Job Title: Senior Associate, Supplier Quality Engineering

Job Code: 41915

Job Location: Alpharetta, GA (Onsite)

Job Schedule: 9/80

Job Description:

Ensure delivery of quality parts from supply base. Monitors/maintains necessary metrics, procedures, controls to assure compliance/conformance to regulatory, customer, and company requirements. Will work closely with internal teams, suppliers, and customers to analyze and resolve part issues, identifying root causes and implementing corrective actions.

Essential Functions:

  • Coordinate and track with supply base for containment, root cause, and proper corrective and preventive actions on non-conformances and customer returns.
  • Interfacing with customers and program personnel.
  • Review, understand, ensure communication of quality flow down requirements to the supply base.
  • Ensure Supplier First Article Inspections are accurate and per AS9102 standards prior to approval.
  • Perform audits in support of onboarding new suppliers or proactive surveillance audits for critical suppliers.
  • Analyze supplier performance and develop improvement plans for identified problem areas to drive down supplier COPQ and nonconformance rates.
  • Manage KPI data and metrics using existing tools – report functional performance to leadership on monthly basis.
  • Material Review Board/Engineering Change Notice review representation.
  • Responsible for participating in continual improvement activities to enhance the quality system.
  • Employ mistake-proofing techniques with supply base.
  • Implement thorough RFQ and PO reviews with supply chain, quality, and engineering prior to awarding supplier POs.
  • Responsible for performing job duties in a manner consistent with established L3Harris Ethics Standards. Responsible for working in a manner consistent with established safety rules and regulations.
  • Ability to travel (typically around 25%), Onsite support in Alpharetta facility when not travelling.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a DoD security clearance.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree and a minimum of 2 years of prior related experience. Graduate Degree or equivalent with 0 to 2 years of prior related experience. In lieu of a degree, minimum of 6 years of prior related experience.
  • Must be a US citizen.

Preferred Additional Skills:

  • ASQ certification (CQE, CQA).
  • Six Sigma Green Belt.
  • 2+ years of experience in Aerospace/Defense parts manufacturing or Automotive parts manufacturing.
  • Knowledgeable of concepts, practices, policies/procedures in engineering.
  • Working knowledge of basic quality concepts and tools (i.e., 8D, 5 Why, etc.).
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills, strong interpersonal skills. Excellent team player with ability to interface with all levels of the organization.
  • Interact effectively with management, peers, and other employees relative to quality and technical issues.
  • Experience in Aerospace/Defense parts manufacturing or Automotive parts manufacturing.
  • Proficient in MS Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.

Unity Developer Intern  
 Arbejdsgiver Heka VR Copenhagen Internship 
 
 
 
 
  
 
 
 
          Salary
           Unpaid  
   
  
 
   
 
  
 
   
 
 
 
   
 Do you have a passion for cutting-edge technology and an interest in using it to help people with severe mental disorders through VR-based avatar therapy? 

 Then join our team and help us develop a medical device that improves the lives of patients. 
   About HEKA VR 
 HEKA VR is a pioneering health-tech company based in the meatpacking district of Copenhagen. We are a producer of Software as a Medical Device, specialising in avatar therapy for severe mental disorders. Our product is currently being used in Denmark and we are participating in clinical studies across 14 countries.   
 Job Description 
 We are looking for a Unity Developer Intern to help us build and improve our Unity-based application. 

 You will primarily work on the development of the Unity application. Your main tasks will involve creating user interfaces, implementing UI interactions, and connecting the interface to an existing REST API. The backend and API integration are already in place, so your focus will be on building a clean, responsive, and user-friendly experience. 

 You will work closely with, and be mentored by our developer throughout the internship. We are a small team of five people, which means you will have the opportunity to contribute directly to the product and gain experience working on a real software project from prototype to production. 
 Your responsibilities  
 
 Develop and maintain UI features in Unity. 
 

 
 Create responsive and intuitive user interfaces. 
 

 
 Implement UI interactions and application flow. 
 

 
 Integrate existing REST API endpoints into the application. 
 

 
 Write clean, maintainable, and well-structured C# code. 
 

 
 Participate in discussions about implementation and software design. 
 
  What we're looking for  
 
 Experience with C# and Unity. 
 

 
 Understanding of object-oriented programming principles. 
 

 
 Familiarity with software design principles such as SOLID. 
 

 
 Interest in writing clean, maintainable code. 
 

 
 Ability to work independently while asking questions when needed. 
 
 
 This internship is well suited for a university student who wants practical experience developing a real Unity application in a small and collaborative team. You will have the opportunity to take ownership of features, receive regular feedback, and strengthen your skills in Unity development, software architecture, and professional development practices.  
 Practical info 
 It is a requirement that you are able to work a majority of days at our office in Copenhagen. 

 The internship is 37 hours a week and will run from early September 2026 to mid-December 2026. 

 This is an unpaid internship, but lunch, coffee, and snacks at the office are on us. 

 Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis until the position is filled. 

 If you believe you’ve got these skills and more, we look forward to hearing from you! 
   
 
   For more information or questions please contact us at   andras@hekavr.com

Genopslag - Kommunikations- og formidlingsmedarbejder til Isfjordskontoret
Stillingen er ledig til besættelse 1. september 2026 eller efter nærmere aftale.Isfjordskontoret søger en engageret og selvstændig kommunikationsmedarbejder til en fuldtidsstilling. 

Stillingen giver mulighed for at arbejde med formidling af UNESCO Verdensarven Ilulissat Isfjord og bidrage til at skabe forståelse for områdets unikke natur- og kulturværdier blandt både borgere, skoler og besøgende.

Dine primære opgaver:

Varetage Isfjordskontorets kommunikation og fungere som kontorets ansigt udadtil

Vedligeholde og udvikle Isfjordskontorets hjemmeside og sociale medier

Have kontakt til forskere og indhente resultater fra igangværende forskningsprojekter med henblik på formidling til offentligheden

Udarbejde nyheder, informationsmateriale og øvrigt formidlingsindhold

Varetage Isfjordskontorets skoletjeneste i tæt samarbejde med skoler og uddannelsesinstitutioner i Ilulissat

Udarbejde undervisnings- og informationsmateriale til skoletjenesten

Besøge skoler og informere om UNESCO Verdensarven, Isfjordskontorets arbejde og betydningen af at beskytte området

Bidrage til at styrke børn og unges kendskab til og medejerskab af verdensarvsområdet

Holde foredrag og informationsmøder for turister om Ilulissat Isfjord, UNESCO-arbejdet samt gletsjerens og fjordens aktuelle tilstand

Opretholde løbende kontakt med turistaktører, guider og øvrige samarbejdspartnere inden for turismeerhvervet

Bidrage til at styrke kendskabet til UNESCO Verdensarven blandt guider, turoperatører og andre formidlere i området

Udarbejde informationsmateriale og afholde informationsmøder for guider og turistaktører om verdensarvsområdet, gældende regler samt aktuelle forhold ved Isfjorden

Medvirke til at sikre en ensartet og korrekt formidling af verdensarven over for områdets besøgende

Vi søger dig, der:

Har erfaring med kommunikation, formidling eller undervisning

Er god til at skrive og formidle komplekse emner til forskellige målgrupper

Har interesse for natur, kulturarv og UNESCO Verdensarv

Er selvstændig, struktureret og initiativrig

Trives med både kontorarbejde og formidling i direkte kontakt med mennesker

Er fleksibel og indstillet på at løse opgaver uden for Isfjordskontorets kerneområde, herunder kommunikations- og formidlingsopgaver for andre afdelinger i Avannaata Kommunia

Behersker grønlandsk, dansk og engelsk i skrift og tale

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår:

Stillingen er en fuldtidsstilling ved Isfjordskontoret i Ilulissat.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår sker i henhold til gældende overenskomst.

Der stilles ikke bolig til rådighed i forbindelse med stillingen.

Om os:

Isfjordskontoret er en del af Avannaata Kommunia og fungerer som verdensarvskontor for Ilulissat Isfjord. Kontoret arbejder med forvaltning, overvågning, forskning, information og formidling af UNESCO Verdensarven. Isfjordskontoret er ikke en del af Isfjordscentret.

Ansøgning med oplysninger om uddannelse og tidligere beskæftigelse, vedlagt relevante bilag medsendes, ved at trykke på "Søg denne stilling" på Avannaata Kommunias hjemmeside.

Ønskes yderligere information om arbejdet, kontakt Site Manager Bo Albrechtsen: boal@avannaata.gl

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor of Science in Pharmacy, Registered Medical Representative at PRC, and other allied medical courses.
  • Minimum one (1) year working experience in Pharmaceutical and/or Medical Device selling.
  • Basic knowledge in computer software application
  • Selling skills, Account Management
  • Proactive, independent and Results Oriented

                Vil du stå i spidsen for udvikling og drift af Danmarks ældste forlystelsespark?
                

Som parkchef bliver du en central del af Bakkens særlige univers, hvor drift, sikkerhed, service og værtskab, relationer og kulturarv skal gå op i en højere enhed. Stillingen er nyoprettet, og du får et bredt mandat til at samle, udvikle og professionalisere parkdriften og gæsteservice. Du får overordnet ansvar for alt fra den ikoniske træ-rutschebane og parkens fysiske rammer og drift til gæsteservice, sikkerhed, myndighedsdialog, leverandørsamarbejder, IT-infrastruktur i parken og koordinering med
Bakkens mange interessenter.


Du refererer til Dyrehavsbakkens administrerende direktør og indgår tæt i den daglige ledelse med reference fra driftschefen og gæsteservicechefen, der tilsammen leder ca. 10 fastansatte og 100
sæsonansatte.

Dine vigtigste ansvarsområder

Som parkchef får du ansvar for at skabe struktur, fremdrift og kvalitet i en kompleks driftsorganisation med mange samarbejdsflader. Dine hovedopgaver vil blandt andet være:

Drift, udvikling og gæsteoplevelse

Overordnet ansvar for en effektiv, stabil og professionel drift af parkens fysiske rammer, gæsteflow samt service- og værtskabsfunktioner - med blik for både kvalitet, bæredygtighed, økonomi og den samlede gæsteoplevelse.

Facility management, sikkerhed og myndighedskontakt

Overordnet ansvar for faciliteter, serviceaftaler, sikkerheds- og beredskabsrelaterede aftaler samt koordinering med politi, beredskab, vagtkorps og relevante myndigheder. Du skal sikre, at Bakken lever
op til gældende krav, tilladelser og dokumentationsforpligtelser.

IT, digital infrastruktur og compliance

Du bliver ansvarlig for Bakkens IT-infrastruktur og digitale driftsplatforme i samarbejde med eksterne leverandører. Det omfatter blandt andet IT-sikkerhed, GDPR, kameraovervågning, fiberring, telefonsystemer og løbende udvikling af driftsunderstøttende systemer.

Teltholderrelationer, leverandører og fælles serviceprogrammer

Du fungerer som et centralt kontaktled mellem A/S Dyrehavsbakken, teltholdere, leverandører og samarbejdspartnere. Du skal sikre professionel koordinering, tydelig kommunikation og stærke samarbejdsrelationer på tværs af parkens mange aktører.

Ledelse, medarbejderudvikling og servicekultur

Du får overordnet ledelsesansvar for relevante medarbejdere og sæsonansatte. En vigtig del af rollen er at skabe en tydelig retning for mellemledere til deres prioriteringer, god planlægning, stærke arbejdsgange, som tilsammen skal give en servicekultur og et værtskab, der kan mærkes i hele parken.

Vi forestiller os, at du


har solid erfaring med driftsledelse, gerne fra oplevelses-, service/hospitality-, detail-, ejendoms- eller facility management-området.


har erfaring med personaleledelse, sæsonorganisationer og tværgående koordinering.


kan skabe struktur, overblik og fremdrift i en kompleks organisation med mange interessenter.


har erfaring med leverandørstyring, kontrakter og driftsøkonomi.


har forståelse for myndighedskontakt, sikkerhed og compliance.


er relationelt stærk og digitalt funderet.


har blik for både de strategiske linjer og de driftsnære detaljer.


Vi tilbyder

En central og meningsfuld lederrolle i hjertet af Bakken, hvor du får mulighed for at præge drift, gæsteoplevelse og den langsigtede udvikling af en historisk forlystelsespark med stærke traditioner, højt engagement og mange forskellige interessenter.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår

Stillingen er en fuldtidsansættelse. Løn og ansættelsesvilkår aftales individuelt efter kvalifikationer og erfaring.

Lyder det som noget for dig?

- så glæder vi os til at høre fra dig. Send gerne din ansøgning og dit CV til jobbet@bakken.dk


Ansøgningsfrist d. 30. august 2026.


Forventet opstart d. 1. november 2026.


Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte administrerende direktør Malina Lebrecht Hye: malina@bakken.dk


Hos Bakken er vi stolte af at være et sted, hvor mennesker mødes - både som gæster og kolleger. Vi tror på, at forskellighed gør os stærkere, og vi ønsker at skabe et arbejdsmiljø, hvor alle føler sig velkomne, respekterede og inkluderede. Vi opfordrer derfor til at søge jobbet uanset alder, køn, etnicitet m.v.

Om Dyrehavsbakken

A/S Dyrehavsbakken er fællesselskabet bag Bakken og har ansvar for administration, drift, økonomi, salg og markedsføring. Bakken er verdens ældste forlystelsespark, et stærkt dansk brand og en levende kulturhistorisk destination placeret midt i Jægersborg Dyrehave, som er optaget på UNESCOs verdensarvsliste.


Hvert år besøges Bakken af omkring 2 mio. gæster. Parken består af ca. 150 forretninger fordelt på omkring 50 selvstændige teltholdere, hvilket skaber en helt særlig struktur, kultur og dynamik. Her mødes stærke traditioner, selvstændigt entreprenørskab, fælles gæsteoplevelser og et tæt samarbejde mellem A/S Dyrehavsbakken, teltholdere, medarbejdere, myndigheder og eksterne partnere.

   Souschef - Harlev J 
  Souschef med ambitioner - er det dig? 
 I Netto vil vi være kendt for at levere gode kundeoplevelser - og vil du også være med til det, så er denne stilling måske noget for dig? 

 Som souschef kan du se frem til en masse selvudvikling, karrieremuligheder og ikke mindst fællesskab. Som souschef har du flere ansvarsområder. Til daglig fungerer du både som butikschefens højre hånd og sparringspartner. Og er butikschefen ude af huset, syg eller på ferie, så er det altså dig, der har det overordnede ansvar. 

 Helt kort så skal du 
 
 udvikle og træne medarbejdere, og sikre at de er glade og motiverede 

 gå forrest ude i butikken og vise det gode eksempel for dine kolleger 

 løse forskellige administrative opgaver 

 supportere butikschefen i alle typer af opgaver 

 være med til at sikre, at butikken opnår de ønskede driftsresultater 

 være rollemodel for Nettos værdisæt og medarbejderoplevelse, vi kalder det NEX: Netto Employee Experience 
 
 Alle de gode grunde
  Stillingen er en rigtig god mulighed for at være med i et dagligvareeventyr. Du bliver del af en stærk kultur præget af god energi, engagement og Netto-ånd. Vi har fokus på din personlige udvikling som leder. Du kan også glæde dig til 
 
 konkurrencedygtig løn, pension og bonusordning 

 sundhedsforsikring 

 masser af gode personaleordninger fx rabatter i Bilka, føtex, Netto, Carl’s Jr. og Starbucks og leje af vores feriehuse og lejligheder i ind- og udland 
 
 Leder- og livserfaring
 I stillingen som souschef er det vigtigt, at du først og fremmest er et ordentligt menneske og har erfaring med at lede mennesker. Og du elsker at sprede trivsel og glæde omkring dig. Mere præcist så forestiller vi os, at du 
 
 har ledererfaring 

 er åben over for Nettos holdning til ledelse ved at skabe resultater igennem høj medarbejdertrivsel 

 er nysgerrig og villig til at lære nye ting 
 
 Souschef - blot en begyndelse?
 Du får selvfølgelig en masse god erfaring fra din dagligdag som souschef, men der er også mulighed for at komme på uddannelse og kurser. Måske kan du blive butikscheftrainee, hvor du får helt styr på teorien bag god ledelse. Netto er en del af Salling Group-familien, så det kan også være, du på sigt ønsker en stilling hos føtex, Bilka eller på hovedkontoret. Du kan også sigte mod en international karriere. 

 Er du vores nye kollega?
 Send din ansøgning til os via linket nedenfor. Vi inviterer løbende til samtale, så søg allerede i dag. 

 Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig! 

   

 Netto - vi bærer vores logo med stolthed  

 Du kender måske allerede Netto som Danmarks største dagligvarekæde - men vidste du også, at vores medarbejdere er rigtig glade for at arbejde her? 

 Du bliver nemlig del af et helt specielt sammenhold med masser af opbakning, og hvor vi alle løfter i flok. For det vi laver er vigtigt, men dem, vi laver det med, er endnu vigtigere. 

 Vi håber, du er lige så begejstret for dyrevelfærd, reduktion af madspild og en bæredygtig fremtid, som vi er. Vi har bl.a. vores eget økologiske brand: ØGO. Og det er naturligvis til gode Netto-priser.

title: Project Coordinator (Work from Home)
description:
We are looking for a Project Coordinator who will play a key role in connecting with clients and fostering strong relationships across a variety of business-to-business campaigns. This role requires excellent English communication skills, confidence, and polished presentation skills, as you will be representing our brand and ensuring clients have a seamless experience.

This is a full-time, remote, and night shift role (9pm to 6am PH time).

Life at Key Media: Where every story matters

Join us in our mission to inform, connect, educate, and inspire business people around the world. At Key Media, we're proud to be the home of trusted B2B media brands, where excellence is recognized and celebrated every day.

Perks and Benefits: Because we value you

  • ComprehensiveHMO coverage with no waiting period, ensuring your health and well-being.
  • Family coverage options after two years of dedicated service.
  • Extra vacation time as a token of appreciation for your hard work and commitment.
  • Access to ourEmployee Assistance Program for confidential counseling services.
  • Continuouslearning opportunities through our E-learning support with LinkedIn learning.
  • Employee recognition programs, including quarterly awards, vouchers, and travel incentives.
  • 100%remote arrangement; work where it suits you best.
  • Great culture (98% employees think we are a ‘great place to work’)

What you'll do:

Support and coordinate B2B campaigns, ensuring smooth execution of client initiatives. Manage campaign reporting and performance metrics.

What you'll bring:

  • Solid experience managing client relationships and B2B project coordination.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills for engaging with clients and cross-functional teams.
  • Strong organizational and time-management abilities, capable of handling multiple priorities under tight deadlines.

About Key Media

At Key Media, your next role comes withglobal exposure. With teams acrossAustralia, Canada, New Zealand, the Philippines, the US, the UK, and Europe, we give you the chance to grow your career while collaborating with colleagues from around the world. From cross-border teamwork to supporting major live events, you'll be part of something international, fast-moving, and meaningful.

We’re a thriving B2B media company creating award-winning content and events across industries like legal, HR, insurance, finance, education, property, and more. With over 350 talented team members, we connect professionals through digital platforms, in-person events, and print, always delivering high-impact work that informs, celebrates, and brings business communities together.

People stay at Key Media for one big reason: the culture. We call it orange energy. We're collaborative, full of energy, and kind. We offer the flexibility to work hybrid or fully remote, plus regular socials, DEI initiatives, and a sense of belonging. We give people the freedom to take ownership, share ideas, and grow their careers quickly. If you want to do great work, be yourself, and explore global opportunities, we would love to hear from you.

Learn more about culture in this short video aboutlife at Key Media.

title: CX intelligence Senior Specialist
description:
We're looking for a curious, data-driven, and customer-obsessed Senior Specialist to join our Customer Experience team at Talabat. In this role, you’ll be the go-to person for customer feedback analytics—specifically around Net Promoter Score (NPS), Resolution Metrics, and deep-dive discovery pieces that drive customer-centric decision-making across the business.

WHAT’S ON YOUR PLATE?

  • Translate qualitative and quantitative feedback into compelling narratives and insights for leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.

  • Own and analyze key customer feedback programs and key metrics, including NPS, resolution feedback, and post-interaction surveys.

  • Conduct data deep dives across different customer segments and journeys to surface actionable insights that inform strategy and improve user satisfaction.

  • Collaborate with CX, product, operations, and analytics teams to identify root causes of negative experiences and track the impact of improvements over time.

  • Support the Voice of the Customer (VoC) program by ensuring data integrity, running feedback loops, and highlighting emerging trends such as AI and advanced text analytics.

  • Contribute to discovery research that helps us better understand evolving customer needs, especially in high-impact areas like cancellations, order issues, and support experience.

  • Prepare customer experience insight decks for senior leadership and monthly business reviews with MDs, ensuring clear storytelling, strategic recommendations, and data accuracy.

  • Assist in building and optimizing dashboards, alerts, and tracking tools that enable teams to monitor sentiment and resolution performance in real-time.

WHAT DID WE ORDER?

Qualifications & Experience:

  • 3–5 years of experience in customer insights, CX research, analytics, or a related field.
    Strong analytical skills with experience using tools like Excel, SQL, Tableau, or Looker.

  • A working knowledge of survey platforms (e.g., Qualtrics).

  • Ability to turn complex data into simple, actionable insights.
    Excellent communication and storytelling skills; comfort presenting to cross-functional teams and senior leadership.

  • Curiosity, proactivity, and a drive to improve customer experience at scale.

  • Bonus: Experience working in tech, e-commerce, or logistics industries.

Skills & Competencies:

  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills; comfortable navigating ambiguity and turning data into clear insights.

  • High attention to detail; ability to detect subtle behavioral trends and anomalies.

  • Excellent communication skills; able to present complex findings clearly to non-technical stakeholders.

  • Proactive, self-driven, and capable of working across teams to drive cross-functional alignment.

  • Strong organizational and time management abilities in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

title: Finance Systems Project Manager (SAP)
description:
Join our dynamic team and contribute your expertise to drive the successful delivery of complex finance systems projects within our organisation. As a Finance Systems Manager leading our project management team for APAC, you will play a pivotal role in leading our regional initiatives, managing requirements, and ensuring seamless collaboration across teams to achieve smooth finance systems go-lives.

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Finance Systems Manager to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for managing the requirements intake and prioritisation process for the Finance Systems team in the region. You will lead a small, but effective team of project managers, bridging the gap between various business and technology teams to deliver fast, optimised, and impactful finance system solutions.

Responsibilities

  • Project manage complex finance systems projects across the APAC region, ensuring on-time and within-scope delivery.
  • Manage the requirements intake and prioritisation process for the Finance Systems team in APAC, aligning regional business needs with technology roadmaps.
  • Lead, mentor, and manage a small, but highly effective team of project managers across APAC to drive project excellence.
  • Close the gap between different business units and technology teams to facilitate fast, smooth, and successful finance systems go-lives.
  • Collaborate with key stakeholders to understand their regional needs and provide expert advice on project management best practices and finance system workflows.
  • Conduct risk assessments, manage dependencies, and support end-to-end testing phases to safeguard the integrity of finance system deployments.
  • Partner with cross-functional and global teams to ensure successful localisation and integration of finance systems across APAC countries.
  • Stay pro-active in identifying bottlenecks and driving continuous improvements to existing project management frameworks and ways of working.

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration, Finance, or a related field. Professional project management certifications (e.g., PMP, Prince2, Agile) are highly desirable.
  • A good general understanding of SAP ecosystems and how they integrate within a broader corporate finance landscape.
  • Very strong project management skills with a proven track record of successfully delivering complex systems projects within a regional or multinational setup.
  • Very strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate with both technical teams and senior business leaders at all levels of the organization.
  • A highly pro-active mindset, always driving to optimize processes, challenge the status quo, and improve existing ways of working.
  • Proven leadership experience managing and developing a small team of project managers or business analysts.
  • Excellent problem-solving, communication, and interpersonal skills to seamlessly bridge the gap between business and technology.
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic hub environment and manage multiple regional priorities simultaneously.

What we offer

  • A dynamic and challenging work environment.
  • A company committed to developing you personally and professionally.
  • A great working atmosphere with regular company and team events.
  • A vibrant and international team committed to diversity and inclusion.
  • Responsibility from day one in a fast growing and global company.
  • Other benefits include free food, health and dental insurance, and learning and development opportunities!

title: Systems Analyst III
description:
Worker Type

Regular

Job Description

AV is looking for a highly talented Systems Analyst III to join our team! In this role you will support the MDA Chief Engineer (MDA/CE) in transforming the way in which the agency approaches engineering. The ideal candidate has strong experience working with Model-based Systems Engineering (MBSE) tools and is interested in utilizing those tools to help move the agency away from document-driven engineering.

  • Assist with capturing and developing new system models to become the backbone for how MDA will approach future engineering efforts.

  • Leverage your skills with a variety of MBSE tools.

  • Coordinate with internal and external teams to collaborate on models.

Required:

  • Bachelor's Degree.

  • 7+ years of relevant experience.

  • Active Secret Clearance.

  • Strong MBSE experience.

  • Ability to excel in a team setting.

  • Experience with Interface or Interoperability engineering domains.

Desired:

  • Expertise in MBSE Tools (SysML, Cameo, MathWorks Simulink, MATLAB, Visio, ModelCenter, etc.).

  • MDA Experience.

  • Expertise in command and control (C2), data transport, Position, Navigation and Timing (PNT), or interoperability.

ITAR Requirement:

This position requires access to information that is subject to compliance with the International Traffic Arms Regulations (“ITAR”) and/or the Export Administration Regulations (“EAR”). In order to comply with the requirements of the ITAR and/or the EAR, applicants will be asked to provide specific documentation to verify U.S. person status under the ITAR and the EAR. A “U.S. person” according to their definition is a U.S. citizen, U.S. lawful permanent resident (green card holder), or protected individual such as a refugee, or asylee. See 22 CFR § 120.15. Some positions will require current U.S. Citizenship due to contract requirements.

Benefits: AV offers an excellent benefits package including medical, dental vision, 401K with company matching, a 9/80 work schedule and a paid holiday shutdown. For more information about our company benefit offerings please visit: http://www.avinc.com/myavbenefits.

We also encourage you to review our company website at http://www.avinc.com to learn more about us.

Principals only need apply. NO agencies please.

Who We Are

Based in California, AeroVironment (AVAV) is a global leader in unmanned aircraft systems (UAS) and tactical missile systems. Founded in 1971 by celebrated physicist and engineer, Dr. Paul MacCready, we’ve been at the leading edge of technical innovation for more than 45 years. Be a part of the team that developed the world’s most widely used military drones and created the first submarine-launched reconnaissance drone, and has seven innovative vehicles that are part of the Smithsonian Institution’s permanent collection in Washington, DC.

Join us today in developing the next generation of small UAS and tactical missile systems that will deliver more actionable intelligence to our customers so they can proceed with certainty – and succeed.

What We Do

Building on a history of technological innovation, AeroVironment designs, develops, produces, and supports an advanced portfolio of unmanned aircraft systems (UAS) and tactical missile systems. Agencies of the U.S. Department of Defense and allied military services use the company’s hand-launched UAS to provide situational awareness to tactical operating units through real-time, airborne reconnaissance, surveillance, and target acquisition.

We are proud to be an EEO/AA Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability/veterans. AeroVironment, Inc. is an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) employer and welcomes all qualified applicants. Qualified applicants will receive fair and impartial consideration without regard to race, sex, color, religion, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, genetic data, sexual orientation, gender identity or other legally protected status.
